augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p02.plain: I have met many people who would deceive others, but no one who wants to be deceived.
augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p02.core_idea: Many deceive, but no one wants to be deceived

augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p03.plain: People love truth when it shines on them and hate it when it rebukes them. Wanting not to be deceived, yet wanting to deceive, they love truth when it reveals itself and hate it when it reveals them.
augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p03.core_idea: We love truth until it exposes us

augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p04.plain: O Truth, you answer all who ask, clearly, though not all hear clearly or hear what they want. Your best servant does not seek to hear what he wants, but wants what he hears from you.
augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p04.core_idea: Want what God says, not what you wish

augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p05.plain: I loved you too late, God, Beauty ancient and ever new! You were within and I searched outside. You called and broke my deafness, shone and ended my blindness; you touched me, and I burned for your peace.
augustine-confessions-pusey-031-p05.core_idea: God was within me while I searched outside

judge.issue: Drops 'You were with me, but I was not with you' and things holding him from God.

augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p01.plain: Is not human life one long trial? No one wants troubles; God asks us to endure them, not love them. In hard times I long for good ones; in good times I fear hard ones. Where is the middle?
augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p01.core_idea: Life is trial: we crave good times and fear bad

judge.issue: Drops 'no man loves what he endures'; open question loses the point that there is no middle.

augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p02.plain: Self-restraint gathers us into one after we were scattered among many things. Whoever loves anything alongside God not for God's sake loves God too little. O love that burns and never consumes, my God, set me alight.
augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p02.core_idea: Love nothing beside God that is not loved for God

augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p03.plain: No one should feel safe in this life, which is all trial: whoever could be made better from worse can also become worse from better. Our only hope and sure promise is God's mercy.
augustine-confessions-pusey-032-p03.core_idea: No one is safe from falling; trust only God's mercy

augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p01.plain: Lord my God, listen, look, have mercy and heal me; before you I have become a puzzle to myself, and that is my weakness.
augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p01.core_idea: Before God I have become a puzzle to myself

augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p02.plain: At home, a lizard catching flies or a spider trapping them often grabs my attention. I may then praise God the Creator, but that is not what first draws me. Rising quickly is one thing; not falling, another.
augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p02.core_idea: Recovering quickly differs from not falling at all

judge.issue: Drops the question whether smallness of the creatures makes the distraction any different.

augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p03.plain: God, you know how far you have changed me: first healing my urge to justify myself, so you could forgive and heal the rest. You curbed my pride and gave me your yoke; it is light, though I feared it.
augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p03.core_idea: God's yoke proved light, though I feared it

augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p04.plain: When someone praised for a gift God gave him enjoys the praise more than the gift, God disapproves, and the one who gives praise is better than the one praised: one delights in God's gift, the other in human approval.
augustine-confessions-pusey-033-p04.core_idea: Value God's gift more than praise for it

judge.issue: Drops qualifier excluding praise of sinners; 'gift of man' rendered loosely as human approval.

augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p01.plain: Lord, I enjoy praise, but truth more: I would rather be right and blamed by all than wrong and praised by all. Still, I wish approval did not add to my joy, yet it does, and blame lessens it.
augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p01.core_idea: I love truth more than praise, yet praise moves me

augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p02.plain: Our words and deeds tempt us to seek praise and others' approval. The temptation works even when I rebuke it in myself, and often takes empty pride in despising empty pride, which is then no contempt at all.
augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p02.core_idea: Pride can boast even of despising pride

augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p03.plain: Sometimes God lets me feel a rare inner sweetness, like a taste of the life to come. But old habits drag me back down, and I weep. Here I can stay but would not; there I would but cannot.
augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p03.core_idea: Bad habit holds me where I would not stay

judge.issue: Drops 'both ways, miserable' and the weight of bad custom holding him.

augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p04.plain: My weaknesses are many and great, but God's medicine is stronger.
augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p04.core_idea: God's remedy is stronger than my weaknesses

augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p05.plain: Frightened by my sins and misery, I planned to flee to the wilderness, but God stopped and strengthened me: Christ died for all so we would live for him. Lord, I cast my care on you; teach and heal me.
augustine-confessions-pusey-034-p05.core_idea: Instead of fleeing, I cast my cares on God

augustine-confessions-pusey-035-p01.plain: God knows our needs before we ask, yet we pray, opening our hearts, confessing our misery and God's mercy, so God will fully free us to be happy in him, as he calls us to be humble, merciful and pure.
augustine-confessions-pusey-035-p01.core_idea: We pray to open our hearts, not to inform God

judge.issue: Beatitude list cut to three; drops meek, mourners, hungering for righteousness, peacemakers.

augustine-confessions-pusey-035-p02.plain: Lord my God, light and strength of the blind and the weak, and of the seeing and the strong, hear my soul crying from the depths. If you do not hear us there, where can we go?
augustine-confessions-pusey-035-p02.core_idea: A cry to God from the depths

augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p01.plain: What light shines through me and strikes my heart without hurting it, so that I shudder and burn? I shudder because I am unlike it, burn because I am like it. It is Wisdom itself, breaking through my clouds, though the darkness my sins earn settles over me again.
augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p01.core_idea: I shudder where unlike God, burn where like

extension.text: What is that which gleams through me, and strikes my heart without hurting it; and I shudder and kindle? I shudder, inasmuch as I am unlike it; I kindle, inasmuch as I am like it. It is Wisdom, Wisdom's self which gleameth through me; severing my cloudiness which yet again mantles over me, fainting from it, through the darkness which for my punishment gathers upon me.

augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p01.plain_v1: What shines through me and strikes my heart without hurting it, so that I shudder and burn? I shudder because I am unlike it, and burn because I am like it.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the answer, 'It is Wisdom', the passage's main point, and the returning darkness.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Omits that the light is Wisdom itself, and the returning darkness.

augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p02.plain: We are saved in hope, so we wait patiently for God's promises.
augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p02.core_idea: In hope we wait patiently for God's promises

augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p03.plain: Answering a question is one thing; mocking the questioner is another. I would rather say "I do not know" than raise a laugh at someone asking deep things and win praise for a false answer.
augustine-confessions-pusey-036-p03.core_idea: Better to say "I don't know" than mock a question

augustine-confessions-pusey-037-p01.plain: God, you have made my days grow old, and they slip away, and I do not know how.
augustine-confessions-pusey-037-p01.core_idea: My days slip away, and I don't know how

augustine-confessions-pusey-037-p02.plain: How miserable that I do not even know what I do not know. Before you, God, I do not lie; I speak as my heart is. You will light my lamp; Lord my God, you will brighten my darkness.
augustine-confessions-pusey-037-p02.core_idea: I don't know what I don't know; God enlightens

augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p01.plain: Courage, my mind, keep pressing on. God is our helper; he made us, we did not make ourselves. Push on to where truth is starting to dawn.
augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p01.core_idea: Take courage and press on toward the dawning truth

augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p02.plain: My years are spent in mourning. You, Lord, eternal Father, are my comfort, but I am scattered among times I do not understand, my inmost thoughts torn by turmoil, until your love's fire melts me into you.
augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p02.core_idea: Scattered by time, I long to be gathered into God

augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p03.plain: How high God is, and yet the humble in heart are his home, for he lifts up those who are bowed down, and those he raises do not fall.
augustine-confessions-pusey-038-p03.core_idea: The highest God dwells with the humble

augustine-confessions-pusey-039-p01.plain: Moved by Scripture, Lord, my poor understanding is wordy, because seeking says more than finding and knocking takes more work than receiving. Yet your promise holds: ask and receive, seek and find, knock and it opens. Truth does not deceive.
augustine-confessions-pusey-039-p01.core_idea: Seek and knock; God's promise will not deceive

judge.issue: Drops 'If God be for us, who can be against us?'

augustine-confessions-pusey-039-p02.plain: Let God, my heart's light, speak to me, not my darkness. I strayed yet still loved you, and barely heard you calling me back. Now I return, thirsting for your fountain. Living from myself was death; in you I revive.
augustine-confessions-pusey-039-p02.core_idea: Living from myself I died; in God I revive

augustine-confessions-pusey-040-p01.plain: How wonderfully deep are your words, God! Their surface invites even children, yet they are a marvellous depth. It is awe-inspiring to look into them, an awe of reverence and a trembling of love.
augustine-confessions-pusey-040-p01.core_idea: Scripture's simple surface hides wondrous depth

augustine-confessions-pusey-042-p01.plain: Lord, your judgments are fearsome, because your truth belongs to no one person but to all of us. Whoever claims as his own what you offer everyone is driven from shared truth into a private lie.
augustine-confessions-pusey-042-p01.core_idea: Truth belongs to all; claiming it privately breeds lies

augustine-confessions-pusey-042-p02.plain: Let us not puff ourselves up against one another, but love the Lord our God with all our heart, soul and mind, and our neighbour as ourselves.
augustine-confessions-pusey-042-p02.core_idea: Love God fully and your neighbour as yourself

augustine-confessions-pusey-043-p01.plain: I call on you, my God, my mercy, who made me and did not forget me when I forgot you. I call you into my soul, which you prepare for yourself through the longing you inspire in it.
augustine-confessions-pusey-043-p01.core_idea: God remembered me when I forgot him

augustine-confessions-pusey-043-p02.plain: We do not sink or rise in space but through our loves: love of worries drags our spirit down, and God's holiness lifts us through love of untroubled rest, toward the highest rest.
augustine-confessions-pusey-043-p02.core_idea: Our loves sink us or lift us toward rest

judge.issue: Drops lifting hearts to God where the Spirit moves above the waters.

augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p01.plain: Give yourself to me, my God. I love you, and if it is too little, I want to love more. I only know I am miserable without you, and all abundance that is not my God is emptiness to me.
augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p01.core_idea: Everything but God is emptiness to me

judge.issue: Drops 'restore yourself to me', not knowing how much love is lacking, and misery within.

augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p02.plain: Fire rises and stones fall; each is pulled by its own weight to its proper place, restless when out of place and at rest when restored. My weight is my love; wherever I am carried, love carries me there.
augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p02.core_idea: My love is my weight; it carries me

augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p03.plain: I too ask, my God, where You are. In You I breathe a little when I pour out praise, then sink back into sadness. My faith says: hope in the Lord and endure the night of the wicked and his wrath, still bearing sin in us, until day breaks.
augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p03.core_idea: When sad, hope in the Lord until day breaks

extension.text: Behold, I too say, O my God, Where art Thou? see, where Thou art! in Thee I breathe a little, when I pour out my soul by myself in the voice of joy and praise, the sound of him that keeps holy-day. And yet again it is sad, because it relapseth, and becomes a deep, or rather perceives itself still to be a deep. Unto it speaks my faith which Thou hast kindled to enlighten my feet in the night, Why art thou sad, O my soul, and why dost thou trouble me? Hope in the Lord; His word is a lanthorn unto thy feet: hope and endure, until the night, the mother of the wicked, until the wrath of the Lord, be overpast, whereof we also were once children, who were sometimes darkness, relics whereof we bear about us in our body, dead because of sin; until the day break, and the shadows fly away.

judge.issue: Garbles the night and wrath imagery; 'his wrath' is ambiguous.

augustine-confessions-pusey-044-p03.plain_v1: My God, in you I breathe a little when I pour out my soul in praise, yet my soul grows sad again. My faith answers: why are you sad, my soul? Hope in the Lord and endure until day breaks.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the night of the wicked, the Lord's wrath and sin's relics; hard part softened away.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the soul's question 'where art Thou', the lantern, and the night of wrath.

augustine-confessions-pusey-045-p01.plain: Let us share our bread with the hungry and bring homeless poor people into our homes. Let us clothe the naked and not look down on our own kin.
augustine-confessions-pusey-045-p01.core_idea: Feed the hungry, shelter the homeless, clothe the naked

augustine-confessions-pusey-046-p01.plain: Do not shape yourselves to the world; hold back from it, for the soul lives by avoiding what kills it when desired. Restrain wild pride, lazy indulgence and false knowledge, so the beasts within are tamed.
augustine-confessions-pusey-046-p01.core_idea: The soul lives by avoiding what kills it

augustine-confessions-pusey-047-p01.plain: I know how to live with little and with plenty; in every situation I have learned to be full or hungry, to have much or go without. I can do everything through Christ, who strengthens me.
augustine-confessions-pusey-047-p01.core_idea: Content in plenty or need, strengthened by Christ

judge.issue: Names 'Christ' where the passage says only 'Him'.

augustine-confessions-pusey-047-p02.plain: God taught me to tell a gift from its fruit. The gift is the thing given, such as money, food, drink, clothing, shelter or help; the fruit is the good and right will of the person giving.
augustine-confessions-pusey-047-p02.core_idea: The giver's goodwill matters more than the gift

augustine-confessions-pusey-048-p01.plain: Lord God, who have given us everything, give us peace: the rest of the Sabbath that has no evening. For this whole beautiful, very good world will pass away when its course is done.
augustine-confessions-pusey-048-p01.core_idea: Pray for God's peace that has no evening

bib-1corinthians-001-p01.plain: God's foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and God's weakness is stronger than human strength.

bib-1corinthians-001-p02.plain: Do not fool yourself. If you think you are wise by this world's standards, become a fool so that you may become truly wise.
bib-1corinthians-001-p02.core_idea: Become a fool to become truly wise

bib-1corinthians-001-p03.plain: It matters little to me if you or any human court judges me; I do not even judge myself. A clear conscience does not acquit me; the Lord judges. So judge nothing before he comes and reveals hearts.
bib-1corinthians-001-p03.core_idea: Leave judgment to the Lord, not people

judge.issue: Drops the Lord exposing hidden things and each receiving praise from God.

bib-1corinthians-001-p04.plain: Who makes you better than anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you received it, why boast as if you had not?
bib-1corinthians-001-p04.core_idea: Everything you have was given; why boast?

judge.issue: 'Makes you different' rendered as 'makes you better than anyone else', a slight shift.

bib-1corinthians-002-p01.plain: Everything is permitted to me, but not everything is helpful. Everything is permitted to me, but I will not let anything master me.
bib-1corinthians-002-p01.core_idea: Not everything allowed is good for you

bib-1corinthians-002-p02.plain: Knowledge makes people proud, but love builds them up. Anyone who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he should.
bib-1corinthians-002-p02.core_idea: Knowledge puffs up; love builds up

bib-1corinthians-002-p03.plain: In a race all runners run, but only one wins the prize, so run to win. Athletes train with strict self-control for a crown that fades; we do it for one that lasts forever.
bib-1corinthians-002-p03.core_idea: Run with discipline for a lasting prize

bib-1corinthians-002-p04.plain: If you think you stand firm, be careful not to fall. Every temptation you face is common to people. God is faithful: he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear, and will provide a way out.
bib-1corinthians-002-p04.core_idea: God never lets temptation exceed what you can bear

bib-1corinthians-003-p01.plain: No one should seek their own good; each should seek their neighbour's good.
bib-1corinthians-003-p01.core_idea: Seek others' good, not just your own
bib-1corinthians-003-p01.plain_v1: No one should look out only for themselves; each should seek the good of others.

judge_v1.issue: Adds 'only', softening 'let no one seek his own' into a milder saying.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Adds 'only', softening 'seek not his own' to not looking out only for oneself.

bib-1corinthians-003-p02.plain: The eye cannot tell the hand it does not need it, nor the head tell the feet. In fact, the parts of the body that seem weaker are essential.
bib-1corinthians-003-p02.core_idea: The parts that seem weakest are essential

bib-1corinthians-003-p03.plain: When one part of the body suffers, every part suffers with it; when one part is honoured, every part rejoices with it.

bib-1corinthians-003-p04.plain: If I speak every human and angelic language but lack love, I am just a noisy gong. With prophecy, all knowledge and mountain-moving faith but no love, I am nothing. Giving everything away without love gains me nothing.
bib-1corinthians-003-p04.core_idea: Without love, every gift is worthless

judge.issue: Drops giving one's body to be burned.

bib-1corinthians-003-p05.plain: Love is patient and kind; it does not envy, boast or act proud. It is not rude, selfish or easily angered, and keeps no record of wrongs. It delights in truth and bears, hopes and endures everything. Love never fails.
bib-1corinthians-003-p05.core_idea: Love is patient and kind, and never fails

judge.issue: Drops 'believes all things' and 'does not rejoice in unrighteousness'.

bib-1corinthians-003-p06.plain: As a child I spoke and thought like a child; grown up, I put childish ways aside. Now we see dimly, as in a mirror, then face to face. Faith, hope and love remain, and the greatest is love.
bib-1corinthians-003-p06.core_idea: Faith, hope and love remain; love is greatest

judge.issue: Drops knowing in part now, fully then, as I am fully known.

bib-1corinthians-004-p01.plain: By God's grace I am what I am. His grace toward me was not wasted; I worked harder than all the others, yet it was not I but God's grace working with me.
bib-1corinthians-004-p01.core_idea: By God's grace I am what I am

bib-1corinthians-004-p02.plain: Do not be fooled: bad company corrupts good character.

bib-1corinthians-004-p03.plain: When our mortal bodies become immortal, the saying comes true: death is swallowed up in victory. Death, where is your sting? Sin is death's sting, and the law gives sin power. Thank God for victory through Jesus Christ.
bib-1corinthians-004-p03.core_idea: Through Christ, death loses its sting

bib-1corinthians-004-p04.plain: So, dear brothers and sisters, stand firm and unshakable, always giving yourselves fully to the Lord's work, knowing that your work in the Lord is never wasted.
bib-1corinthians-004-p04.core_idea: Stand firm; work for the Lord is never wasted

judge.issue: Widens 'brothers' to 'brothers and sisters'.

bib-1corinthians-004-p05.plain: Stay alert, stand firm in the faith, be brave and strong. Do everything in love.
bib-1corinthians-004-p05.core_idea: Be brave and strong, and do everything in love

bib-1esdras-002-p01.plain: The first speaker said: how strong wine is! It leads drinkers astray, makes king and orphan, rich and poor alike, drowns sorrow and debt, turns friends to drawn swords, and afterwards they remember nothing. Is wine not strongest?
bib-1esdras-002-p01.core_idea: Wine overpowers everyone, making them forget and err

bib-1esdras-002-p02.plain: All the earth calls on truth and heaven blesses it. Wine, kings, women and all people are unjust and will perish, but truth stays strong forever, takes no bribes and does what is just. Blessed be the God of truth.

judge.issue: Drops truth as the strength, kingdom, power and majesty of all ages.

bib-1esdras-003-p01.plain: When the new temple was founded, old priests and elders who remembered the first one wept aloud, while many others shouted for joy with trumpets, so that weeping and joy could not be told apart, and the noise carried far.
bib-1esdras-003-p01.core_idea: Weeping for the past mingled with joy for the new

bib-1esdras-005-p01.plain: I said: Lord, I am ashamed and confused before you, for our sins are piled above our heads and our wrongs reach up to heaven, from our ancestors' time until today.
bib-1esdras-005-p01.core_idea: Ashamed before God of sins piled high

bib-1esdras-005-p02.plain: As the people wept on hearing the law, they were told: this day is holy to the Lord, so go and feast, send portions to those who have nothing, and do not grieve, for the Lord will bring you honour.
bib-1esdras-005-p02.core_idea: On a holy day, feast, share and stop grieving

bib-1john-001-p01.plain: If we claim to have no sin, we fool ourselves and the truth is not in us. If we confess our sins, God is faithful and just, and will forgive us and cleanse us of all wrongdoing.
bib-1john-001-p01.core_idea: Confess your sins and God will forgive

bib-1john-001-p02.plain: Whoever claims to be in the light but hates a brother is still in darkness. Whoever loves a brother stays in the light and does not stumble; whoever hates walks blind in darkness, not knowing where he goes.
bib-1john-001-p02.core_idea: Hatred blinds; love keeps you in the light

bib-1john-001-p03.plain: Do not love the world or its things; whoever loves the world lacks the Father's love. Its lusts and pride do not come from the Father. The world and its desires are passing, but whoever does God's will lives forever.
bib-1john-001-p03.core_idea: The world passes; doing God's will lasts forever

bib-1john-001-p04.plain: Dear children, let us not love just with words or talk, but with actions and in truth.
bib-1john-001-p04.core_idea: Love in deeds, not just words

bib-1john-001-p05.plain: Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God; everyone who loves is born of God and knows God. Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
bib-1john-001-p05.core_idea: God is love, so love one another

bib-1john-001-p06.plain: There is no fear in love; perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. Whoever is afraid has not been made perfect in love.

bib-1john-001-p07.plain: Anyone who says "I love God" but hates his brother is a liar, for if he does not love the brother he can see, how can he love God, whom he has not seen?
bib-1john-001-p07.core_idea: You cannot love God while hating others

bib-1kings-001-p01.plain: Dying, David told his son Solomon: I am going the way of all the earth. Be strong and act like a man; keep God's law and walk in his ways, so you prosper in all you do, wherever you go.
bib-1kings-001-p01.core_idea: Be strong and walk in God's ways

bib-1kings-002-p01.plain: Solomon prayed: Lord my God, you made me king after my father, but I am like a little child who does not know how to lead. Give me an understanding heart to judge your people and tell good from evil.
bib-1kings-002-p01.core_idea: Ask God for an understanding heart

bib-1kings-004-p01.plain: My father David longed to build a house for God's name. God told him it was good that he had it in his heart, but he would not build it; his son would.
bib-1kings-004-p01.core_idea: A good intention honoured, though another fulfils it

bib-1kings-005-p01.plain: King Rehoboam asked his father's old advisers how to answer the people. They said: if you serve these people today and speak kindly to them, they will serve you forever.
bib-1kings-005-p01.core_idea: Serve people kindly and they will follow you

bib-1kings-007-p01.plain: A widow told Elijah she had only enough flour and oil for a last meal before she and her son died. He said: do not fear; feed me first, for God says your flour and oil will last until rain.
bib-1kings-007-p01.core_idea: Do not fear; give first, and God will provide

bib-1kings-008-p01.plain: Elijah asked the people: how long will you keep wavering between two sides? If the Lord is God, follow him; if Baal is, follow Baal. The people said nothing.
bib-1kings-008-p01.core_idea: Stop wavering; choose whom you will follow

bib-1kings-008-p02.plain: God passed by: a mighty wind tore the mountains and smashed rocks, but God was not in the wind. Nor was God in the earthquake that followed, nor in the fire. After the fire came a still, small voice.
bib-1kings-008-p02.core_idea: God came not in the storm but quietly

bib-1kings-009-p01.plain: The messenger urged Micaiah to agree with the other prophets and tell the king good news. Micaiah answered: as the Lord lives, I will say whatever the Lord tells me.
bib-1kings-009-p01.core_idea: Speak what is true, not what pleases

bib-1maccabees-002-p01.plain: Do not fear the words of a sinful man, for his glory will end in dung and worms. Today he is raised up; tomorrow he is gone, returned to dust, and his plans have perished.
bib-1maccabees-002-p01.core_idea: Don't fear the boasting of the wicked; they pass

bib-1maccabees-002-p02.plain: Judas said: it is easy for many to be defeated by a few. To heaven it is all one to save with many or few, for victory in battle does not come from a large army; strength comes from heaven.
bib-1maccabees-002-p02.core_idea: Strength comes from heaven, not numbers

bib-1maccabees-010-p01.plain: Simon told his two eldest sons: my family and I have fought Israel's battles since youth and often won. Now I am old and you are grown; take our place and fight for our nation, and may heaven help you.
bib-1maccabees-010-p01.core_idea: The old hand on the struggle to the young

bib-1peter-001-p01.plain: All people are like grass, and all human glory like a wildflower. The grass dries up and the flower falls, but the Lord's word lasts forever.
bib-1peter-001-p01.core_idea: Human glory fades; God's word endures

bib-1peter-001-p02.plain: Let your beauty come not only from outward things like braided hair, gold jewellery or fine clothes, but from your inner self, the lasting beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious to God.
bib-1peter-001-p02.core_idea: True beauty is a gentle, quiet spirit

bib-1peter-001-p03.plain: Be united, compassionate, loving and kind; don't repay evil or insult in kind, but bless, since you were called to inherit a blessing. Whoever wants a good life must guard their tongue, turn from evil, do good and pursue peace; the Lord watches over the righteous but opposes evildoers.
bib-1peter-001-p03.core_idea: Repay insult with blessing and pursue peace
bib-1peter-001-p03.plain_v1: Be united, compassionate, loving and courteous. Do not repay evil or insult in kind, but bless instead. Whoever wants a good life should guard their tongue, turn from evil, do good and pursue peace, for the Lord watches the righteous.

judge_v1.issue: Drops 'the face of the Lord is against those who do evil' and the called-to-blessing line.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the calling to inherit a blessing and the Lord set against evildoers.

bib-1peter-001-p04.plain: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers many sins. Welcome one another without complaining. Use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as good stewards of God's many kinds of grace.
bib-1peter-001-p04.core_idea: Love deeply, for love covers many sins

bib-1peter-001-p05.plain: Dear friends, do not be surprised by the fiery trial that has come to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.
bib-1peter-001-p05.core_idea: Do not be surprised when trials come

bib-1peter-001-p06.plain: So humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, and he will lift you up in time. Throw all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
bib-1peter-001-p06.core_idea: Cast your worries on God; he cares for you

bib-1peter-001-p07.plain: After you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to eternal glory in Christ, will himself make you complete, firm, strong and settled.
bib-1peter-001-p07.core_idea: After brief suffering, God will make you strong

bib-1samuel-001-p01.plain: Hannah answered: no, my lord, I am a deeply sorrowful woman. I have not been drinking; I was pouring out my soul to the Lord. Do not think me wicked; I have been speaking out of great grief and distress.
bib-1samuel-001-p01.core_idea: Pouring out a grieving soul to God

bib-1samuel-001-p02.plain: Stop talking so proudly, and do not let arrogance come out of your mouth, for the Lord is a God who knows, and he weighs every action.
bib-1samuel-001-p02.core_idea: Drop arrogance; God weighs every deed

bib-1samuel-001-p03.plain: The Lord makes some poor and some rich; he brings low and lifts up. He raises the poor from the dust and the needy from the rubbish heap to sit with princes and inherit a seat of honour.
bib-1samuel-001-p03.core_idea: God lifts the poor from the dust

bib-1samuel-004-p01.plain: Samuel told the people: do not be afraid. You have done all this wrong, yet do not turn away from the Lord; serve him with all your heart. Do not chase empty things that cannot help or save you.
bib-1samuel-004-p01.core_idea: Despite wrongdoing, don't turn from God

bib-1samuel-005-p01.plain: Samuel said: does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to his voice? Obeying is better than sacrifice, and listening better than the fat of rams.

bib-1samuel-005-p02.plain: Saul told Samuel: I have sinned. I broke the Lord's command and your instructions because I was afraid of the people and did what they wanted.
bib-1samuel-005-p02.core_idea: Fear of people led me to disobey God

bib-1samuel-005-p03.plain: People look at outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.
bib-1samuel-005-p03.core_idea: God looks at the heart, not appearances

bib-1samuel-006-p01.plain: The women sang that Saul had killed thousands and David tens of thousands. Saul was furious: they credit David with more than me; what is left for him but the kingdom? From that day Saul eyed David with suspicion.

bib-1samuel-007-p01.plain: David bowed to the ground three times, and he and Jonathan kissed and wept together, David most of all. Jonathan said: go in peace, for we have sworn in the Lord's name that he binds us and our descendants forever.
bib-1samuel-007-p01.core_idea: Friends part in tears, bound by a lasting vow

bib-1samuel-008-p01.plain: Saul wept and told David: you are more righteous than I, for you repaid my evil with good. The Lord put me in your hands and you spared me. Who lets an enemy go unharmed? May the Lord reward you.
bib-1samuel-008-p01.core_idea: David spared his enemy, repaying evil with good

bib-1samuel-008-p02.plain: David praises God for sending Abigail, and thanks her for her good sense, which stopped him that day from shedding blood and taking revenge himself.
bib-1samuel-008-p02.core_idea: Good counsel can stop us from taking revenge.

bib-1samuel-009-p01.plain: Saul admits he has done wrong. Because David spared his life, he promises to stop harming him and confesses he has acted like a fool and gone badly astray.
bib-1samuel-009-p01.core_idea: Being spared can bring an honest admission of wrong.

bib-1samuel-009-p02.plain: David was in deep trouble: his grieving people, who had lost their children, talked of stoning him. Yet he found strength in the Lord his God.
bib-1samuel-009-p02.core_idea: In crisis, strength can be drawn from God.

bib-1samuel-010-p01.plain: Those who stay behind to guard the supplies get the same share as those who go into battle. Everyone shares equally.
bib-1samuel-010-p01.core_idea: Those who support the work share equally in reward.

bib-1thessalonians-001-p01.plain: Paul wants believers to understand what happens to those who have died, so they do not grieve without hope: as Jesus died and rose, God will bring the dead in Jesus with him.
bib-1thessalonians-001-p01.core_idea: Grief need not be hopeless for those in Jesus.

judge.issue: Recasts direct address to 'you, brothers' as a report about Paul and believers.

bib-1thessalonians-001-p02.plain: Paul urges correcting the unruly, encouraging the timid, helping the weak and being patient with everyone. Never repay wrong with wrong; always seek good. Rejoice always, pray constantly, and give thanks in everything, as God wills.
bib-1thessalonians-001-p02.core_idea: Be patient, do good, rejoice, pray and give thanks.

judge.issue: Reported as 'Paul urges' rather than direct exhortation; drops 'for one another, and for all'.

bib-1timothy-001-p01.plain: It is true and worth accepting that Christ Jesus came to save sinners, and Paul counts himself the worst. He was shown mercy so Jesus could display his patience in him as an example for future believers.
bib-1timothy-001-p01.core_idea: Even the worst sinner can receive mercy.

judge.issue: Recast in third person; drops 'for eternal life'.

bib-1timothy-001-p02.plain: Do not let anyone look down on you for being young. Instead, set an example for believers in how you speak, live, love, and in your spirit, faith and purity.
bib-1timothy-001-p02.core_idea: Being young is no bar to setting an example.

bib-1timothy-001-p03.plain: Living for God with contentment is real wealth. We bring nothing into the world and take nothing out, so food and clothing are enough. Chasing riches leads to ruin; loving money is a root of every kind of evil.
bib-1timothy-001-p03.core_idea: Contentment is wealth; love of money brings ruin.

judge.issue: Drops those led from the faith by greed, pierced with many sorrows.

bib-1timothy-001-p04.plain: Tell the rich not to be proud or trust uncertain wealth, but to trust the living God who gives everything to enjoy. They should do good, be generous and share, building a foundation for eternal life.
bib-1timothy-001-p04.core_idea: The rich should trust God and be generous.

bib-2chronicles-001-p01.plain: God tells Solomon to ask for anything. Solomon thanks God for his kindness to David and, feeling the weight of ruling a vast people, asks only for wisdom and knowledge to lead them.
bib-2chronicles-001-p01.core_idea: Asked for anything, Solomon asks for wisdom.

bib-2chronicles-002-p01.plain: David wanted to build a temple for God. God told him it was good that he wanted to, but that his son, not he, would build it.
bib-2chronicles-002-p01.core_idea: A good intention matters even if another fulfils it.

bib-2chronicles-002-p02.plain: God says that when he brings drought, locusts or plague, if his people humble themselves, pray, seek him and turn from their wrongdoing, he will hear them, forgive them and heal their land.
bib-2chronicles-002-p02.core_idea: Humility and turning from wrong bring God's healing.

bib-2chronicles-003-p01.plain: King Rehoboam asked his father's old advisers what to do; they said that if he was kind to the people, they would serve him forever. But he rejected their advice and turned to the young men he grew up with.
bib-2chronicles-003-p01.core_idea: Rejecting wise elders' counsel for peers' approval.

bib-2chronicles-004-p01.plain: A prayer to the Lord: only you can help the weak against the strong. Help us, for we rely on you and face this huge army in your name. Do not let mere people win against you.
bib-2chronicles-004-p01.core_idea: The weak rely on God against overwhelming odds.

bib-2chronicles-004-p02.plain: Be strong and do not let your hands go limp, because your work will be rewarded.
bib-2chronicles-004-p02.core_idea: Keep going; your work will be rewarded.

bib-2chronicles-005-p01.plain: I swear by the living Lord: I will say whatever my God tells me to say.
bib-2chronicles-005-p01.core_idea: Speak only what God says, whatever the pressure.

bib-2chronicles-005-p02.plain: We do not know what to do, but we are looking to you.

bib-2chronicles-005-p03.plain: Do not be afraid or discouraged by this huge army, because the fight is not yours; it is God's.
bib-2chronicles-005-p03.core_idea: The battle belongs to God, not you.

bib-2chronicles-007-p01.plain: Amaziah worries about the large sum he already paid to hire an army. The man of God replies that the Lord can give him far more than that.
bib-2chronicles-007-p01.core_idea: God can give far more than what you lose.

bib-2chronicles-008-p01.plain: A prayer that the good Lord will forgive everyone who sincerely seeks God, even if they have not met the temple's purity rules.
bib-2chronicles-008-p01.core_idea: A heart seeking God matters more than ritual purity.

bib-2chronicles-009-p01.plain: Be strong and brave; do not fear the king of Assyria and his huge army. One greater is with us: he has only human strength, but the Lord our God is with us to help and fight for us.
bib-2chronicles-009-p01.core_idea: God with us outweighs any human power.

bib-2corinthians-001-p01.plain: Praise to God, the Father of mercies and source of all comfort, who comforts us in every trouble so that we can comfort others in theirs with the comfort God gave us.
bib-2corinthians-001-p01.core_idea: Comfort received from God is meant to be passed on.

bib-2corinthians-001-p02.plain: Our treasure is held in fragile clay jars, so the great power is shown to be God's, not ours. Pressed, confused, hunted and knocked down, we are never crushed, despairing, abandoned or destroyed, so Jesus' life shows in us.
bib-2corinthians-001-p02.core_idea: Fragile people, sustained by God's power, are not crushed.

judge.issue: Drops carrying in the body the dying of Jesus.

bib-2corinthians-001-p03.plain: So we do not lose heart. Our bodies wear out, but inside we are renewed daily. Brief troubles produce lasting glory, as we look not at what is seen, which passes, but at what is unseen, which is eternal.
bib-2corinthians-001-p03.core_idea: Outer decay, inner renewal; the unseen is eternal.

judge.issue: Loses 'light' affliction weighed against an eternal weight of glory.

bib-2corinthians-001-p04.plain: Anyone who is in Christ is made new. The old has gone; everything has become new.
bib-2corinthians-001-p04.core_idea: In Christ, a person is made entirely new.

bib-2corinthians-002-p01.plain: Sorrow that comes from God leads to a change of heart and to salvation, with nothing to regret. But the world's kind of sorrow leads to death.
bib-2corinthians-002-p01.core_idea: Godly sorrow heals; worldly sorrow kills.

bib-2corinthians-002-p02.plain: If you are willing, your gift is welcome for what you have, not judged by what you do not have.
bib-2corinthians-002-p02.core_idea: Willingness counts; give from what you have.

bib-2corinthians-002-p03.plain: Whoever sows little reaps little; whoever sows generously reaps generously. Each should give what they have decided in their heart, not reluctantly or under pressure, because God loves a cheerful giver.
bib-2corinthians-002-p03.core_idea: Give generously and gladly; God loves a cheerful giver.

bib-2corinthians-002-p04.plain: Paul will not class or compare himself with those who praise themselves. People who measure themselves against themselves and compare themselves with each other show they lack understanding.
bib-2corinthians-002-p04.core_idea: Measuring yourself by yourself shows a lack of understanding.

bib-2corinthians-003-p01.plain: The Lord told Paul his grace is enough, because his power is made complete in weakness. So Paul gladly boasts of and takes pleasure in his weaknesses and hardships for Christ, because when he is weak, he is strong.
bib-2corinthians-003-p01.core_idea: God's power shows most in our weakness.

bib-2corinthians-003-p02.plain: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Grow toward maturity, be comforted, agree with one another, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
bib-2corinthians-003-p02.core_idea: Live in peace; the God of peace is with you.

bib-2esdras-001-p01.plain: The Lord says: you have not really abandoned me; you have abandoned yourselves.
bib-2esdras-001-p01.core_idea: Turning from God is abandoning yourself.

bib-2esdras-001-p02.plain: God commands: treat widows rightly, defend the fatherless and orphans, give to the poor, clothe the naked, heal the broken and weak, never mock the lame, protect the maimed, help the blind, and look after old and young.
bib-2esdras-001-p02.core_idea: Care for the vulnerable is God's command.

judge.issue: 'Let the blind come to the sight of my glory' reduced to 'help the blind'.

bib-2esdras-001-p03.plain: Be still, my people, and rest, because your peace is coming.

bib-2esdras-001-p04.plain: Do not worry too much. When the time of trouble and anguish comes, others will weep and grieve, but you will be glad and have plenty.
bib-2esdras-001-p04.core_idea: Do not overworry; God's people will be cared for.

bib-2esdras-002-p01.plain: The angel answers that you cannot hurry ahead of the Most High: your haste is for yourself alone, but God's timing serves many.
bib-2esdras-002-p01.core_idea: God's timing serves many; our haste serves ourselves.

judge.issue: 'Hastens on behalf of many' recast as God's timing; loses that the Most High also hastens.

bib-2esdras-002-p02.plain: I know what has already happened, but I do not know what is still to come.
bib-2esdras-002-p02.core_idea: The past is known; the future is not.

bib-2esdras-002-p03.plain: Waking from a vision, he shook all over and his mind was so troubled it gave way. The angel held him, comforted him and helped him back onto his feet.
bib-2esdras-002-p03.core_idea: In terror, comfort lifts us back to our feet.

bib-2esdras-003-p01.plain: He asks the Lord why he was born at all, and why he did not die at birth, so he would not have to see the suffering and weary toil of Israel's people.
bib-2esdras-003-p01.core_idea: Despair asks why one was born to see suffering.

bib-2esdras-003-p02.plain: On the eighth night his heart was troubled again and he began to speak before the Most High, his spirit burning and his soul in distress.
bib-2esdras-003-p02.core_idea: A troubled soul pours itself out before God.

bib-2esdras-004-p01.plain: The angel compares it to a vast sea whose only entrance is narrow like a river: whoever wants to reach the open sea must first pass through the narrow way.
bib-2esdras-004-p01.core_idea: The broad place is reached only through the narrow.

bib-2esdras-004-p02.plain: Why are you so troubled, when you are only a mortal who will perish? Why have you not thought about what is to come rather than only about what is happening now?
bib-2esdras-004-p02.core_idea: Mortals should look to what comes, not only now.

bib-2esdras-004-p03.plain: He asks the earth why it brought forth a mind from dust. It would be better if the dust had never been, because the mind grows with us, and so we suffer: we die and we know it.
bib-2esdras-004-p03.core_idea: Knowing we will die torments the human mind.

bib-2esdras-005-p01.plain: He tells his soul to take in understanding and his heart to feed on wisdom, because we arrive without choosing it, leave when we do not wish to, and are given only a short time to live.
bib-2esdras-005-p01.core_idea: Life is short; seek understanding while you can.

bib-2esdras-005-p02.plain: He asks God why he should be so angry with frail, mortal humans, since truly no one ever born has not done wrong and fallen short.
bib-2esdras-005-p02.core_idea: Every human does wrong; God, why such anger?

bib-2esdras-006-p01.plain: So keep your grief to yourself, and face the misfortunes that have come to you with courage.

bib-2esdras-006-p02.plain: Shake off your heavy grief and set aside your many sorrows, so that the Mighty One may show you mercy again and the Most High may give you rest from your troubles.
bib-2esdras-006-p02.core_idea: Letting go of sorrow opens the way to God's rest.

bib-2esdras-007-p01.plain: I am still weary in mind and very weak in spirit; I have no strength left at all because of the great terror I felt tonight.
bib-2esdras-007-p01.core_idea: Fear can leave us utterly drained.

bib-2esdras-007-p02.plain: Take comfort, Israel, and do not grieve, people of Jacob: the Most High remembers you, and the Mighty One has not forgotten you forever.
bib-2esdras-007-p02.core_idea: God has not forgotten his people.

bib-2esdras-008-p01.plain: You have ordered your life by wisdom, and have treated understanding as your mother.
bib-2esdras-008-p01.core_idea: A life guided by wisdom and understanding.

bib-2esdras-008-p02.plain: The world has lost its youth, and the ages are starting to grow old.
bib-2esdras-008-p02.core_idea: The world itself is growing old.

bib-2esdras-009-p01.plain: Do not be afraid of what they plot against you, and do not let the disbelief of those who speak against you upset you.
bib-2esdras-009-p01.core_idea: Do not let critics' disbelief trouble you.

bib-2esdras-009-p02.plain: The Lord God says: do not be afraid or doubt, for God guides you. You who keep my commands, do not let your sins weigh you down or your wrongdoings rise up over you.
bib-2esdras-009-p02.core_idea: Do not fear; God guides; sins need not crush you.

bib-2john-001-p01.plain: I have much to write to you, but I would rather not use paper and ink. I hope to visit and talk face to face, so our joy can be complete.
bib-2john-001-p01.core_idea: Joy is fullest face to face.

bib-2kings-001-p01.plain: Elijah asks Elisha to stay behind, as the Lord has sent him on to Bethel. Elisha swears by the Lord and by Elijah's life that he will not leave him, so they go on together.

bib-2kings-002-p01.plain: Naaman storms off, angry the prophet only told him to wash in the Jordan instead of healing him with ceremony. His servants reason that he would have done something great if asked, so why not something simple?
bib-2kings-002-p01.core_idea: Pride can make us refuse simple remedies.

judge.issue: Adds 'the Jordan', not in the passage; drops the rivers of Damascus comparison.

bib-2kings-002-p02.plain: Seeing an army surrounding the city, Elisha's servant panics. Elisha tells him not to fear, since more are with them than against them, and prays; the Lord opens the servant's eyes to hills full of fiery horses and chariots.
bib-2kings-002-p02.core_idea: Unseen help is greater than the visible threat.

bib-2kings-003-p01.plain: Four men with leprosy at the city gate reason that staying put or entering the starving city both mean death. So they decide to go to the enemy camp: if spared they live, and if killed they only die.
bib-2kings-003-p01.core_idea: When every option risks death, take the one with hope.

bib-2kings-005-p01.plain: King Jehoash warns Amaziah with a fable of a thistle that asked a cedar for a marriage and was trampled by a beast. Proud of beating Edom, Amaziah should enjoy his glory at home rather than invite ruin.
bib-2kings-005-p01.core_idea: Pride after success invites a fall.

bib-2kings-007-p01.plain: Hezekiah is dying, and Isaiah brings word from the Lord to put his affairs in order. Hezekiah turns to the wall and prays, asking the Lord to remember his faithful, wholehearted life, and weeps bitterly.
bib-2kings-007-p01.core_idea: Facing death, a faithful man weeps and prays.

bib-2maccabees-003-p02.plain: A mother tells her sons that she does not know how they came to be in her womb; she did not give them breath and life, nor shape the parts of their bodies.
bib-2maccabees-003-p02.core_idea: Life comes from beyond the parents who bear it.

bib-2maccabees-004-p01.plain: The mother begs her son to look at the heavens and the earth and all that is in them, and see that God made them out of nothing, and that people come into being the same way.
bib-2maccabees-004-p01.core_idea: God made everything, and us, from nothing.

bib-2maccabees-007-p01.plain: If I have told my story well and to the point, that is what I wanted; if it is poor and ordinary, it is the best I could do.
bib-2maccabees-007-p01.core_idea: Offering one's best, whether good or ordinary.

bib-2peter-001-p01.plain: Do not forget that to the Lord a day is like a thousand years and a thousand years like a day. He is not slow to keep his promise, but patient, wanting no one to perish and everyone to repent.
bib-2peter-001-p01.core_idea: God's delay is patience, not slowness.

bib-2samuel-001-p01.plain: David laments: how the mighty have fallen in battle! He grieves for his brother Jonathan, who was dear to him, whose love for him was wonderful, greater than the love of women.
bib-2samuel-001-p01.core_idea: Grief for a beloved friend fallen in battle.

bib-2samuel-001-p02.plain: Abner calls to Joab: must the killing go on forever? Don't you know it will end in bitterness? How long before you call your people back from chasing their own brothers?
bib-2samuel-001-p02.core_idea: Endless fighting between brothers ends in bitterness.

bib-2samuel-002-p01.plain: King David sits before the Lord and asks who he is, and what his family is, that God has brought him this far.
bib-2samuel-002-p01.core_idea: Humble wonder at how far God has brought us.

bib-2samuel-003-p01.plain: Be brave, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God, and may the Lord do what he thinks best.
bib-2samuel-003-p01.core_idea: Do your part bravely; leave the outcome to God.

bib-2samuel-003-p02.plain: The Lord sends Nathan to David with a story: a rich man with huge flocks, wanting to feed a guest, took instead a poor man's only lamb, which he had raised like a daughter, and served it.
bib-2samuel-003-p02.core_idea: The powerful taking the little the poor have.

bib-2samuel-004-p01.plain: David fasted and wept while his child lived, hoping the Lord might spare him. Once the child died, he ate. He cannot bring the child back; David will go to him, but the child will not return.
bib-2samuel-004-p01.core_idea: Hope while there is hope; then accept death.

bib-2samuel-004-p02.plain: We must all die, like water spilled on the ground that cannot be gathered again. Yet God does not take life away, but finds ways so that the banished one is not cut off from him.
bib-2samuel-004-p02.core_idea: We are mortal, but God makes ways back for outcasts.

bib-2samuel-005-p01.plain: Ittai swears by the Lord and by the king's life that wherever the king goes, in life or death, he will be there too.
bib-2samuel-005-p01.core_idea: Loyalty that follows in life or death.

bib-2samuel-005-p02.plain: Fleeing, King David sends God's ark back to the city. If the Lord favours him, he will bring him back to see it; if not, David says, here I am, let God do with me what he thinks good.
bib-2samuel-005-p02.core_idea: Surrendering one's fate to God's will.

bib-2samuel-006-p01.plain: Deeply shaken, the king goes up to the room over the gate and weeps, crying out for his son Absalom and wishing he had died in his place.
bib-2samuel-006-p01.core_idea: A father's grief, wishing to have died instead.

bib-2samuel-006-p02.plain: Old Barzillai tells the king he is eighty and has few years left: he can no longer tell good from bad, taste food or drink, or hear singers. Why should he go to Jerusalem and be a burden?
bib-2samuel-006-p02.core_idea: In old age, not wanting to be a burden.

bib-2samuel-007-p01.plain: Please let me go back home so I can die in my own town, near the grave of my father and mother.
bib-2samuel-007-p01.core_idea: Wishing to die at home, near one's parents.

bib-2samuel-007-p02.plain: Death and evil surrounded me like waves and floods, and its snares caught me. In my distress I called to the Lord, my God, and he heard my voice and my cry from his temple.
bib-2samuel-007-p02.core_idea: In overwhelming distress, God hears our cry.

bib-2samuel-007-p03.plain: Lord, you are my lamp; the Lord will light up my darkness.

bib-2samuel-008-p01.plain: God, the Rock of Israel, said that one who rules people justly and in awe of God is like morning light at sunrise on a cloudless day, like grass sprouting in the clear shine after rain.
bib-2samuel-008-p01.core_idea: Just rule in awe of God is like morning light.

bib-2samuel-008-p02.plain: After taking a census, David's conscience strikes him. He tells the Lord he has sinned greatly and acted very foolishly, and begs him to take away his guilt.
bib-2samuel-008-p02.core_idea: A troubled conscience confesses and asks forgiveness.

bib-2samuel-008-p03.plain: The king refuses Araunah's gift and insists on paying, saying he will not offer the Lord his God sacrifices that cost him nothing.
bib-2samuel-008-p03.core_idea: A true offering must cost you something.

bib-2thessalonians-001-p01.plain: But you, brothers, do not grow tired of doing what is right.
bib-2thessalonians-001-p01.core_idea: Do not tire of doing right.

bib-2thessalonians-001-p02.plain: May the Lord of peace himself give you peace always and in every way. The Lord be with you all.
bib-2thessalonians-001-p02.core_idea: May the Lord give you peace always.

bib-2timothy-001-p01.plain: God did not give us a spirit of fear, but one of power, love and self-control.
bib-2timothy-001-p01.core_idea: God gives power, love and self-control, not fear.

bib-2timothy-001-p02.plain: My life is already being poured out, and the time for me to depart has come. I have fought the good fight, finished the race and kept the faith.
bib-2timothy-001-p02.core_idea: Facing death having lived faithfully to the end.

bib-2timothy-001-p03.plain: At my first trial everyone deserted me; may it not be held against them. But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so the message could be fully preached, and I was rescued from the lion's mouth.
bib-2timothy-001-p03.core_idea: Deserted by all, but the Lord stood by me.

judge.issue: Drops the purpose that all the Gentiles might hear.

bib-3john-001-p01.plain: Dear friend, I pray that all goes well with you and that you are healthy, just as your soul is doing well.
bib-3john-001-p01.core_idea: Wishing body and life to thrive as the soul does.

bib-3john-001-p02.plain: Dear friend, do not copy what is evil, but what is good. Whoever does good is from God; whoever does evil has not seen God.
bib-3john-001-p02.core_idea: Imitate good; doing good shows you are of God.

bib-3maccabees-001-p01.plain: A prayer asking God to wipe out our sins and mistakes, to show compassion now, to send mercy quickly ahead of us, and to grant peace so that the downcast and broken-hearted may praise him.
bib-3maccabees-001-p01.core_idea: Plea for mercy and peace for the broken-hearted.

bib-3maccabees-003-p01.plain: A prayer recalling that when Jonah was wasting away inside the sea monster, God the Father watched over him and brought him back to his own people.
bib-3maccabees-003-p01.core_idea: God sees and rescues even from the depths.

bib-4maccabees-001-p01.plain: You may not be able to remove anger or malice from your soul, but you can resist them. Reason does not wipe out the passions; it stands against them and helps you not give in.
bib-4maccabees-001-p01.core_idea: Reason cannot erase passions, but can resist them.

bib-4maccabees-001-p02.plain: Desire comes before pleasure, and joy after it. Fear comes before pain, and sorrow after it.
bib-4maccabees-001-p02.core_idea: Pleasure and pain each have feelings before and after.

bib-4maccabees-002-p01.plain: Only the wise and brave person is master of their passions.
bib-4maccabees-002-p01.core_idea: Only the wise and brave master their passions.

bib-4maccabees-004-p01.plain: Birds on our rooftops defend their chicks; others nest on mountaintops, cliffs and trees and drive off intruders. If they cannot, they circle overhead crying out in anguished love, saving their young however they can.
bib-4maccabees-004-p01.core_idea: Even birds fight with love to protect their young.

bib-acts-001-p01.plain: All the believers lived together and shared everything, selling their property to give to anyone in need. Every day they met in the temple, ate together at home with glad, sincere hearts, praised God, and were liked by everyone.
bib-acts-001-p01.core_idea: Early believers shared everything with glad hearts.

judge.issue: Drops 'with one accord' and steadfast continuance; small loss of nuance.

bib-acts-002-p01.plain: If this plan or movement is merely human, it will fail. But if it comes from God, you will not be able to stop it, and you may even find yourselves fighting against God.
bib-acts-002-p01.core_idea: What is from God cannot be overthrown.

bib-acts-004-p01.plain: I now truly see that God has no favourites; in every nation, anyone who reveres him and does what is right is accepted by him.
bib-acts-004-p01.core_idea: God accepts the upright of every nation.

bib-acts-006-p01.plain: God, who made the world, does not live in temples or need anything; he gives all life and breath. He made every nation to seek and find him, though he is near each of us, for in him we live.
bib-acts-006-p01.core_idea: God is near us; in him we live and move.

judge.issue: Compresses heavily: drops 'one blood', appointed seasons, 'move and have our being'.

bib-acts-007-p01.plain: Paul says the Spirit compels him to Jerusalem; he knows only that prison and hardship await. He does not value his life, if only he can joyfully finish his race and the work Jesus gave him.
bib-acts-007-p01.core_idea: Finishing one's calling matters more than one's life.

judge.issue: Drops testifying to the Good News of God's grace; looser on 'bound by the Spirit'.

bib-acts-007-p02.plain: Paul says his life showed them that, by working hard, we should help the weak and remember Jesus' words: giving brings more blessing than receiving.
bib-acts-007-p02.core_idea: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

bib-amos-001-p01.plain: Can two people walk together unless they have agreed to?

bib-amos-001-p02.plain: Seek good and not evil so that you may live, and then the Lord, the God of Armies, will truly be with you, as you claim. Hate evil, love good, and make sure there is justice in the courts.
bib-amos-001-p02.core_idea: Seek good, hate evil, establish justice.

bib-amos-001-p03.plain: Let justice flow like rivers, and right living like a mighty stream that never stops.
bib-amos-001-p03.core_idea: Let justice flow like a river.

judge.issue: Adds 'that never stops', not in this translation.

bib-amos-002-p01.plain: The Lord says a time is coming when he will send a famine, not of food or water, but of hearing his words. People will wander everywhere searching for the Lord's word and will not find it.
bib-amos-002-p01.core_idea: A famine of hearing God's word.

bib-baruch-001-p01.plain: Lord Almighty, God of Israel, a soul in anguish and a troubled spirit cries out to you.
bib-baruch-001-p01.core_idea: A soul in anguish cries out to God.

bib-baruch-001-p02.plain: Learn where wisdom, strength and understanding are found, so you also know where to find long life, the light of the eyes, and peace.
bib-baruch-001-p02.core_idea: Seek wisdom, and with it life and peace.

bib-baruch-001-p03.plain: Where are the rulers of nations, those who mastered beasts and birds, those who hoarded endless silver and gold that people trust in, and the skilled craftsmen? They have vanished into the grave, and others have taken their place.
bib-baruch-001-p03.core_idea: The powerful and rich all pass into the grave.

bib-baruch-002-p01.plain: Jerusalem, as a mother, tells her children to go on their way, since she is left desolate. She has taken off the clothes of peace and put on sackcloth, and will cry to the Everlasting as long as she lives.
bib-baruch-002-p01.core_idea: In desolation, crying to God for life.

judge.issue: Adds Jerusalem-as-mother speaker, which the passage itself does not name.

bib-colossians-001-p01.plain: Fix your thoughts on the things above, not on earthly things.
bib-colossians-001-p01.core_idea: Set your mind on things above.

bib-colossians-001-p02.plain: As God's chosen, loved people, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility and patience. Bear with and forgive one another as Christ forgave you. Above all, love, which binds everything together; let God's peace rule your hearts; be thankful.
bib-colossians-001-p02.core_idea: Clothe yourself in compassion, forgiveness and love.

judge.issue: Drops lowliness, the complaint condition and 'called in one body'.

bib-colossians-001-p03.plain: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so that they do not lose heart.
bib-colossians-001-p03.core_idea: Don't provoke your children into discouragement.

bib-colossians-001-p04.plain: Whatever you do, put your whole heart into it, as working for the Lord rather than for people, knowing the Lord will reward you, since it is Christ you serve.
bib-colossians-001-p04.core_idea: Work wholeheartedly, as for the Lord.

judge.issue: Drops 'inheritance' from the reward.

bib-colossians-001-p05.plain: Act wisely toward outsiders, making the most of your time. Let your speech always be gracious and flavoured with salt, so you know how to answer each person.
bib-colossians-001-p05.core_idea: Speak with grace and use time wisely.

bib-daniel-001-p01.plain: Daniel praises God forever, for wisdom and power are his. He changes times and seasons, removes and sets up kings, gives wisdom to the wise, reveals deep secrets, and knows what lies in darkness, for light lives with him.
bib-daniel-001-p01.core_idea: God holds wisdom, power and the course of history.

judge.issue: Drops 'knowledge to those who have understanding'.

bib-daniel-002-p01.plain: Three young men tell King Nebuchadnezzar their God can save them from the blazing furnace and will rescue them. But even if he does not, they will never serve the king's gods or worship his golden statue.
bib-daniel-002-p01.core_idea: Faithful even if God does not rescue.

judge.issue: Drops 'we have no need to answer you' and the conditional 'if it happens'.

bib-daniel-004-p01.plain: A figure like a man touched Daniel again and strengthened him, saying: greatly loved one, do not fear; peace be with you; be strong, be strong. As he spoke, Daniel was strengthened and told him to speak.
bib-daniel-004-p01.core_idea: Be strong, you are loved; peace be with you.

bib-daniel-005-p01.plain: The wise will shine like the bright sky, and those who lead many to do right will shine like the stars forever.
bib-daniel-005-p01.core_idea: The wise and those who lead others rightly will shine.

bib-deuteronomy-001-p01.plain: How can I carry all your problems, burdens and quarrels on my own?
bib-deuteronomy-001-p01.core_idea: No one can carry everyone's burdens alone.

bib-deuteronomy-001-p02.plain: Do not take sides when judging; hear the humble and the powerful the same. Do not be afraid of anyone, because judgment belongs to God.
bib-deuteronomy-001-p02.core_idea: Judge fairly and fear no one; judgment is God's.

bib-deuteronomy-001-p03.plain: The Lord your God has blessed all your work and watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. For forty years he has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.
bib-deuteronomy-001-p03.core_idea: God was with you through the wilderness; you lacked nothing.

bib-deuteronomy-003-p01.plain: Listen, Israel: the Lord is our God, the Lord alone. Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul and all your strength.
bib-deuteronomy-003-p01.core_idea: Love the one God with everything you have.

bib-deuteronomy-003-p02.plain: Remember how the Lord led you forty years in the wilderness to humble and test you. He let you hunger, then fed you manna, to teach that people live not by bread alone but by every word from the Lord.
bib-deuteronomy-003-p02.core_idea: People live not by bread alone but by God's word.

judge.issue: Drops testing what was in their heart, whether they would keep commandments.

bib-deuteronomy-003-p03.plain: Take it to heart that the Lord your God disciplines you just as a parent disciplines a child.
bib-deuteronomy-003-p03.core_idea: God disciplines us as a parent does a child.

bib-deuteronomy-004-p01.plain: Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you? Only to revere him, follow all his ways, love him, serve him with all your heart and soul, and keep his commands, which are for your own good.
bib-deuteronomy-004-p01.core_idea: God asks for reverence, love and wholehearted service.

bib-deuteronomy-004-p02.plain: The Lord your God is the great, mighty, awesome God of gods. He takes no bribes and plays no favourites; he defends orphans and widows and loves foreigners, feeding and clothing them. So love foreigners; you were foreigners in Egypt.
bib-deuteronomy-004-p02.core_idea: Love the foreigner, as God does; you were one too.

bib-deuteronomy-005-p01.plain: If any of your fellow people in your land is poor, do not harden your heart or close your hand to them. Open your hand freely and lend them enough for whatever they need.
bib-deuteronomy-005-p01.core_idea: Don't harden your heart; open your hand to the poor.

bib-deuteronomy-005-p02.plain: Give freely and without resentment, and the Lord your God will bless all your work. There will always be poor people in the land, so I command you to be open-handed toward the needy and poor among you.
bib-deuteronomy-005-p02.core_idea: Give freely and gladly to the poor.

bib-deuteronomy-006-p01.plain: Do not twist justice or play favourites. Do not take bribes, because a bribe blinds the wise and corrupts the words of the righteous. Pursue justice and only justice, so you may live in the land God gives you.
bib-deuteronomy-006-p01.core_idea: Pursue justice; bribes blind even the wise.

bib-deuteronomy-007-p01.plain: When you go to war and face horses, chariots and an army larger than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, is with you.
bib-deuteronomy-007-p01.core_idea: Facing greater forces, do not fear; God is with you.

bib-deuteronomy-007-p02.plain: If you see your neighbour's donkey or ox fallen on the road, do not look away. You must help him get it back on its feet.
bib-deuteronomy-007-p02.core_idea: Don't look away; help your neighbour up.

bib-deuteronomy-008-p01.plain: Be careful to do what you have said. Whatever you freely vowed to the Lord your God with your own mouth, you must carry out.

bib-deuteronomy-008-p02.plain: Do not exploit a poor hired worker, whether Israelite or foreigner. Pay them each day before sunset, since they are poor and counting on it; otherwise they may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty.
bib-deuteronomy-008-p02.core_idea: Pay the poor worker promptly and fairly.

bib-deuteronomy-008-p03.plain: When you harvest and forget a bundle of grain in the field, do not go back for it. Leave it for foreigners, orphans and widows, so the Lord your God will bless all your work.
bib-deuteronomy-008-p03.core_idea: Leave something for the poor and the stranger.

bib-deuteronomy-009-p01.plain: Your life will hang in doubt; you will be afraid day and night, never sure you will live. In the morning you will wish for evening, and at evening for morning, because of the dread in your heart.
bib-deuteronomy-009-p01.core_idea: Constant dread makes every hour unbearable.

judge.issue: Drops 'the sights which your eyes will see'.

bib-deuteronomy-010-p01.plain: Hidden things belong to the Lord our God, but what has been revealed belongs to us and our children forever, so that we may live by all the words of this law.
bib-deuteronomy-010-p01.core_idea: Leave the hidden to God; live by what is revealed.

bib-deuteronomy-010-p02.plain: This command is not too hard or out of reach. It is not in heaven or across the sea for someone to fetch. The word is very near you, in your mouth and heart, so you can do it.
bib-deuteronomy-010-p02.core_idea: God's word is near, in your mouth and heart.

bib-deuteronomy-010-p03.plain: With heaven and earth as witnesses, Moses sets before the people life and death, blessing and curse. So choose life, for you and your children, by loving the Lord, obeying him and clinging to him, for he is your life.
bib-deuteronomy-010-p03.core_idea: Choose life by loving and holding to God.

judge.issue: Drops 'length of days' and the promised land sworn to the fathers.

bib-deuteronomy-010-p04.plain: The Lord himself goes ahead of you and will be with you. He will never fail or abandon you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
bib-deuteronomy-010-p04.core_idea: God goes ahead and will never abandon you.

bib-deuteronomy-011-p01.plain: The eternal God is your home, and his everlasting arms are underneath you.
bib-deuteronomy-011-p01.core_idea: God's everlasting arms hold you up.

bib-deuteronomy-011-p02.plain: Your strength will last as long as your days.
bib-deuteronomy-011-p02.core_idea: You will have strength for each day.

bib-ecc-001-p01.plain: Everything is wearisome beyond words. The eye never has enough of seeing, nor the ear of hearing. What has been will be again, and what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun.
bib-ecc-001-p01.core_idea: Nothing is new; desire is never satisfied.

bib-ecc-001-p02.plain: What is crooked cannot be straightened, and what is missing cannot be counted.
bib-ecc-001-p02.core_idea: Some things simply cannot be fixed.

bib-ecc-001-p03.plain: I set my mind to understand wisdom as well as madness and folly, and saw that this too was chasing the wind. For with much wisdom comes much grief; whoever increases knowledge increases sorrow.

bib-ecc-001-p04.plain: I denied myself nothing my eyes wanted and no pleasure, and enjoyed my work as my reward. But when I looked at all I had done, it was all empty, chasing the wind, with no real gain under the sun.
bib-ecc-001-p04.core_idea: Getting everything you want still leaves you empty.

bib-ecc-001-p05.plain: Nothing is better for a person than to eat, drink and find enjoyment in their work. I saw that this too comes from God's hand.
bib-ecc-001-p05.core_idea: Enjoying simple things and work is God's gift.

bib-ecc-001-p06.plain: There is a right time for everything under heaven: to be born and to die, to plant and uproot, to weep and laugh, to mourn and dance, to be silent and speak, to love and hate, for war and peace.
bib-ecc-001-p06.core_idea: Everything in life has its season.

judge.issue: Drops several pairs, including the hard 'time to kill, time to heal'.

bib-ecc-001-p07.plain: One handful with peace and quiet is better than two handfuls with toil and chasing the wind.
bib-ecc-001-p07.core_idea: Less with peace beats more with toil.

bib-ecc-001-p08.plain: A man is all alone, with no son or brother, yet his work never ends and his wealth never satisfies him. He asks whom he is toiling for, depriving himself of joy. This too is meaningless, a miserable business.
bib-ecc-001-p08.core_idea: Endless toil for no one is empty and miserable.
bib-ecc-001-p08.plain_v1: Someone alone, with no son or brother, works without end and is never satisfied with his wealth. He never asks who he is working for, depriving himself of enjoyment. This too is empty, a miserable business.

judge_v1.issue: Says he never asks whom he works for; in the passage he does ask.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Says he never asks whom he works for; in the passage he asks it.

bib-ecc-001-p09.plain: Two are better than one; they gain more from their work. If one falls, the other lifts them up; pity the one who falls alone. Two keep warm and resist attackers; a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
bib-ecc-001-p09.core_idea: Companions lift, warm and defend each other.

bib-ecc-001-p10.plain: Whoever loves money never has enough, and whoever loves wealth is never satisfied; this too is empty. More goods bring more mouths to feed. A worker sleeps soundly, but the rich man's plenty keeps him awake.
bib-ecc-001-p10.core_idea: Love of wealth never satisfies and costs sleep.

judge.issue: Drops owner only feasting his eyes, and 'whether he eats little or much'.

bib-ecc-002-p01.plain: It is better to enjoy what is in front of your eyes than to let your desires roam. Yet this too is empty, a chasing of the wind.
bib-ecc-002-p01.core_idea: Enjoy what you have rather than craving more.

bib-ecc-002-p02.plain: Better to visit a house of mourning than a feast, since death is everyone's end and the living should take it to heart. Sorrow is better than laughter; it improves the heart. The wise think on mourning, fools on fun.
bib-ecc-002-p02.core_idea: Facing death and sorrow makes the heart wiser.

bib-ecc-002-p03.plain: The end of a matter is better than its beginning, and patience better than pride. Do not be quick to anger; anger lives in fools. Do not ask why the old days were better; that is not wise.
bib-ecc-002-p03.core_idea: Be patient, slow to anger, and don't idealise the past.

bib-ecc-002-p04.plain: When times are good, be glad; when times are bad, reflect. God has made both, side by side, so that no one can discover what lies ahead.
bib-ecc-002-p04.core_idea: Enjoy good days; reflect in bad ones; God made both.

bib-ecc-002-p05.plain: No one on earth is so righteous that they do only good and never sin. So do not listen to everything people say, or you may hear your servant curse you; you know you have often cursed others yourself.
bib-ecc-002-p05.core_idea: Everyone sins; don't take every word to heart.

judge.issue: Adds a causal 'So' linking universal sin to not heeding gossip.

bib-ecc-002-p06.plain: Eat and drink with joy, for God already approves what you do. Enjoy life with the wife you love through your fleeting days. Do everything with all your might; in the grave there is no work or wisdom.
bib-ecc-002-p06.core_idea: Enjoy life and work fully; the grave ends all.

judge.issue: Drops white garments, oil, 'your portion', and Sheol 'where you are going'.

bib-ecc-002-p07.plain: I saw that the race is not won by the fastest, nor the battle by the strongest; food does not always go to the wise, wealth to the clever, or favour to the skilled. Time and chance happen to everyone.
bib-ecc-002-p07.core_idea: Time and chance happen to everyone.

bib-ecc-002-p08.plain: If a ruler becomes angry with you, do not leave your post, because calmness can put great offences to rest.

bib-ecc-002-p09.plain: Whoever waits for perfect weather will never sow or reap. You cannot know how the wind moves or a baby grows, nor God's work. So sow morning and evening; you do not know which will succeed, or whether both.
bib-ecc-002-p09.core_idea: Don't wait for certainty; act, since outcomes are unknown.

bib-ecc-002-p10.plain: Light is sweet and seeing the sun is good. However many years a person lives, they should enjoy them all, yet remember that dark days will be many, and everything that comes passes away.
bib-ecc-002-p10.core_idea: Enjoy every year, but remember dark days will come

bib-ephesians-001-p01.plain: You may be angry, but do not let it lead you into sin. Settle your anger before the day ends, and give the devil no foothold.
bib-ephesians-001-p01.core_idea: Do not let anger last past sundown

bib-ephesians-001-p02.plain: Say nothing harmful. Speak only words that build others up when they need it, so that your words are a gift to those who hear them.
bib-ephesians-001-p02.core_idea: Speak only words that build others up

bib-ephesians-001-p03.plain: Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander and malice. Be kind and tender-hearted to one another, and forgive each other just as God forgave you in Christ.
bib-ephesians-001-p03.core_idea: Drop bitterness; forgive as God forgave you

bib-ephesians-001-p04.plain: Fathers, do not push your children into anger; raise them with the discipline and teaching of the Lord.
bib-ephesians-001-p04.core_idea: Do not provoke children; raise them in the Lord

bib-esther(greek)-002-p01.plain: Lord, you alone are our king. Help me: I am alone, with no one to help me but you, and danger is close.
bib-esther(greek)-002-p01.core_idea: A plea to God when alone and in danger

bib-esther(greek)-002-p02.plain: God who rules over all, hear those who have lost hope. Save us from those plotting harm, and free me from my fear.
bib-esther(greek)-002-p02.core_idea: A prayer to God for rescue from fear

bib-esther-001-p01.plain: Who knows whether you came to your position for exactly this moment?
bib-esther-001-p01.core_idea: You may be where you are for this moment

bib-exodus-001-p01.plain: The king of Egypt ordered the Hebrew midwives to kill every baby boy at birth. But the midwives feared God more than the king, refused the order, and let the boys live.
bib-exodus-001-p01.core_idea: Fear of God gave the midwives courage to disobey

bib-exodus-001-p02.plain: Moses told God he was a poor speaker. God replied that he made every human mouth, and told Moses to go, promising to be with his mouth and teach him what to say.
bib-exodus-001-p02.core_idea: God helps the one who feels unable to speak

judge.issue: Drops God's claim to make people mute, deaf, seeing or blind.

bib-exodus-002-p01.plain: Moses went back to God and complained: why have you brought trouble on this people and sent me? Since I spoke to Pharaoh for you, things have got worse, and you have not rescued them.
bib-exodus-002-p01.core_idea: Moses honestly complains to God when things worsen

bib-exodus-004-p01.plain: God will fight for you; you only need to be still.
bib-exodus-004-p01.core_idea: God will fight for you; be still

bib-exodus-005-p01.plain: God is my strength and my song, and has saved me. He is my God and my father's God, and I will praise him.
bib-exodus-005-p01.core_idea: God is my strength, song and salvation

bib-exodus-006-p01.plain: Moses' father-in-law told him that what he was doing was not good: he would wear out himself and the people, because the load was too heavy to carry alone.
bib-exodus-006-p01.core_idea: The load is too heavy to carry alone
