bib-luke-007-p02.core_idea: Heaven rejoices over one lost one found

bib-luke-007-p03.plain: Whoever is faithful in small things is faithful in big things too. Whoever is dishonest in small things is dishonest in big things too.
bib-luke-007-p03.core_idea: Faithful in little, faithful in much

bib-luke-007-p04.plain: No servant can serve two masters; he will hate one and love the other, or be loyal to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
bib-luke-007-p04.core_idea: You cannot serve God and money

bib-luke-007-p05.plain: Watch yourself. If your brother wrongs you, tell him so; if he is sorry, forgive him. Even if he wrongs you seven times in one day and comes back each time saying sorry, forgive him.
bib-luke-007-p05.core_idea: Forgive a brother who repents, however often he returns.

judge.issue: 'Rebuke him' softened to 'tell him so'.

bib-luke-007-p06.plain: Asked by the Pharisees when God's Kingdom would arrive, Jesus said it is not something you can watch for or point to here or there, because God's Kingdom is within you.
bib-luke-007-p06.core_idea: God's Kingdom is within you, not out there.

bib-luke-008-p01.plain: Whoever tries to hold on to their life loses it, and whoever lets go of their life keeps it.
bib-luke-008-p01.core_idea: Clinging to life loses it; letting go keeps it.

judge.issue: 'Loses his life' softened to 'lets go of their life'.

bib-luke-008-p02.plain: Jesus told a story to show that people should keep praying and never give up: a widow kept pleading with a judge who cared for neither God nor people, until he helped her just to stop her pestering.
bib-luke-008-p02.core_idea: Keep praying persistently and do not give up.

bib-luke-008-p03.plain: A proud Pharisee thanked God he was better than others; a tax collector stood far off begging mercy as a sinner. The humble man went home right with God, for the proud will be humbled and the humble raised.
bib-luke-008-p03.core_idea: The humble are lifted up; the self-exalting are humbled.

bib-luke-008-p04.plain: Jesus said that what people cannot do, God can.
bib-luke-008-p04.core_idea: What is impossible for people is possible for God.

bib-luke-009-p01.plain: Jesus watched the rich give to the temple treasury and a poor widow drop in two small coins. She gave more than all of them, he said: they gave from surplus, she gave all she had.
bib-luke-009-p01.core_idea: A poor person's whole gift outweighs the rich's surplus.

bib-luke-009-p02.plain: Jesus told his followers that rulers lord it over people, but among them the greatest should act like the youngest and the leader like a servant, just as he lives among them as one who serves.
bib-luke-009-p02.core_idea: True greatness means serving others, as Jesus served.

judge.issue: Drops the ironic 'benefactors' title and the table-versus-servant question.

bib-luke-009-p03.plain: Jesus went a little apart, knelt, and prayed: Father, if you are willing, take this suffering away from me; yet let your will be done, not mine.
bib-luke-009-p03.core_idea: Surrender your own will to God's, even in anguish.

bib-luke-010-p01.plain: Jesus prayed, Father, forgive them, because they do not know what they are doing.
bib-luke-010-p01.core_idea: Forgive those who harm you without understanding.

bib-malachi-001-p01.plain: Don't we all share one father, made by the one God? So why do we betray one another and dishonour the covenant our ancestors made?
bib-malachi-001-p01.core_idea: One God made us all, so why betray each other?

bib-malachi-001-p02.plain: You complain that serving God is pointless, since the proud seem happy and the wicked prosper unpunished. Then Yahweh heard those who revered him, had their names recorded, and promised to keep and spare them as his own.
bib-malachi-001-p02.core_idea: When the wicked prosper, God still remembers the faithful.

extension.text: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies? Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’ Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written before him, for those who feared Yahweh, and who honored his name. They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make, and I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

judge.issue: Drops the image of sparing them as a father spares a serving son.

bib-mark-001-p01.plain: Healthy people don't need a doctor; sick people do. Jesus said he came to call not the righteous but sinners to turn back.
bib-mark-001-p01.core_idea: Jesus came for sinners, as doctors come for the sick.

bib-mark-001-p02.plain: Nobody patches an old garment with new cloth, or it shrinks and tears a worse hole. Nobody pours new wine into old wineskins, or they burst and both are lost; new wine goes into new skins.
bib-mark-001-p02.core_idea: The new cannot be forced into old forms.

bib-mark-001-p03.plain: The Sabbath was made to serve people, not people to serve the Sabbath.
bib-mark-001-p03.core_idea: Rules exist for people, not people for rules.

bib-mark-001-p04.plain: A kingdom split against itself cannot last, and neither can a household split against itself.
bib-mark-001-p04.core_idea: A divided kingdom or house cannot stand.

bib-mark-002-p01.plain: God's Kingdom is like a man who scatters seed and goes on sleeping and waking while it sprouts and grows without his knowing how. The earth produces the crop by itself, step by step, from shoot to full grain.
bib-mark-002-p01.core_idea: God's Kingdom grows quietly, beyond our understanding or control.

bib-mark-002-p02.plain: God's Kingdom is like a mustard seed: the smallest of seeds when planted, it grows into the largest of plants, with branches big enough for birds to shelter in its shade.
bib-mark-002-p02.core_idea: God's Kingdom starts tiny and grows great.

bib-mark-002-p03.plain: Jesus said a prophet is honoured everywhere except in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own home.
bib-mark-002-p03.core_idea: Prophets go unhonoured among their own people.

bib-mark-002-p04.plain: Jesus told his followers to come away with him to a quiet place and rest for a while, because so many people were coming and going that they had no time even to eat.
bib-mark-002-p04.core_idea: Step away from the crowd and rest awhile.

bib-mark-003-p01.plain: Nothing that enters a person from outside can make them unclean; what makes a person unclean is what comes out of them.
bib-mark-003-p01.core_idea: What comes out of you defiles, not what goes in.

bib-mark-003-p02.plain: What good is it to win the whole world and lose your own life? What could anyone give in exchange for their life?
bib-mark-003-p02.core_idea: Gaining the world is worthless if you lose your life.

bib-mark-003-p03.plain: Jesus told a father that everything is possible for someone who believes. At once the father cried out in tears, I do believe; help me with my unbelief!
bib-mark-003-p03.core_idea: Faith can be honest about its own doubt.

bib-mark-003-p04.plain: Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and the servant of everyone.
bib-mark-003-p04.core_idea: To be first, be last and serve all.

bib-mark-004-p01.plain: Jesus said that anyone who does not receive God's Kingdom the way a little child does will never enter it.
bib-mark-004-p01.core_idea: Receive God's Kingdom like a little child.

bib-mark-004-p02.plain: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter God's Kingdom.
bib-mark-004-p02.core_idea: Wealth makes entering God's Kingdom very hard.

bib-mark-004-p03.plain: When you stand to pray and hold something against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven will also forgive your wrongs.
bib-mark-004-p03.core_idea: Forgive others when you pray, so God forgives you.

bib-mark-005-p01.plain: The greatest commandment is that the Lord our God is one, and you must love God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength. The second is to love your neighbour as yourself. No commandment is greater than these.
bib-mark-005-p01.core_idea: Love God wholly and your neighbour as yourself.

bib-mark-005-p02.plain: Jesus watched the rich put large sums into the temple treasury and a poor widow put in two tiny coins. She gave more than all of them, he said: they gave from surplus, she gave everything she had.
bib-mark-005-p02.core_idea: A poor person's whole gift outweighs the rich's surplus.

bib-mark-005-p03.plain: When you hear of wars and rumours of wars, don't be alarmed. These things must happen, but they are not yet the end.
bib-mark-005-p03.core_idea: Don't be alarmed by wars; the end is not yet.

bib-matthew-001-p01.plain: A cry was heard in Ramah, weeping and deep mourning: Rachel crying for her children, refusing to be comforted, because they are gone.
bib-matthew-001-p01.core_idea: A mother's grief for lost children refuses comfort.

bib-matthew-001-p02.plain: People do not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from God's mouth.
bib-matthew-001-p02.core_idea: People live by God's word, not bread alone.

bib-matthew-001-p03.plain: Blessed are the poor in spirit and those persecuted for righteousness, for heaven is theirs; mourners will be comforted, the gentle inherit the earth, those hungry for righteousness be filled, the merciful receive mercy, the pure in heart see God, and peacemakers be called God's children.
bib-matthew-001-p03.core_idea: God blesses the humble, grieving, merciful and peacemaking.
bib-matthew-001-p03.plain_v1: Blessed are the humble in spirit, the grieving, the gentle, those who long for what is right, the merciful, the pure in heart, the peacemakers and the persecuted: God's Kingdom, comfort and mercy will be theirs.

judge_v1.issue: Merges the distinct promises; drops inheriting the earth, being filled, seeing God, children of God.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Collapses the distinct promises into one vague list.

bib-matthew-001-p04.plain: You are the light of the world, like a city on a hill that cannot be hidden. No one hides a lamp; so let your light shine, that people see your good deeds and praise your Father in heaven.
bib-matthew-001-p04.core_idea: Let your light shine so others see good.

bib-matthew-002-p01.plain: You were taught an eye for an eye, but Jesus says don't fight back against someone who wrongs you. Struck on one cheek, offer the other; sued for your coat, give your cloak; forced one mile, go two.
bib-matthew-002-p01.core_idea: Do not retaliate; answer wrong with more generosity.

bib-matthew-002-p02.plain: You were taught to love your neighbour and hate your enemy, but Jesus says love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, to be children of your Father, who sends sun and rain on good and bad alike.
bib-matthew-002-p02.core_idea: Love your enemies, as God gives to all alike.

judge.issue: Drops 'bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you'.

bib-matthew-002-p03.plain: When you pray, don't be like hypocrites who pray in public to be seen; that attention is all the reward they get. Instead pray privately behind a closed door, and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
bib-matthew-002-p03.core_idea: Pray in private, not to be seen by others.

bib-matthew-002-p04.plain: If you forgive others the wrongs they do, your heavenly Father will forgive you too; but if you don't forgive them, your Father will not forgive your wrongs.
bib-matthew-002-p04.core_idea: God forgives you as you forgive others.

bib-matthew-002-p05.plain: Don't store up treasures on earth, where they decay or get stolen; store up treasures in heaven, where they are safe. Your heart will be wherever your treasure is.
bib-matthew-002-p05.core_idea: Your heart follows what you treasure.

bib-matthew-002-p06.plain: Don't worry about what you will eat, drink or wear; life is more than food and clothes. The birds don't farm, yet your heavenly Father feeds them, and you are worth more. Worrying cannot add a moment to your life.
bib-matthew-002-p06.core_idea: Don't worry; God cares for you, and worry adds nothing.

bib-matthew-002-p07.plain: So don't worry about tomorrow; tomorrow will bring its own worries. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
bib-matthew-002-p07.core_idea: Don't worry about tomorrow; today has enough trouble.

bib-matthew-002-p08.plain: Don't judge, or you will be judged by the standard you use. Why notice the speck in your brother's eye and ignore the plank in your own? Remove your own plank first; then you can help him.
bib-matthew-002-p08.core_idea: Fix your own faults before judging others'.

judge.issue: Drops the rebuke 'You hypocrite!' and the idea of seeing clearly.

bib-matthew-002-p09.plain: Ask and you will be given; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened. Everyone who asks receives, whoever seeks finds, and whoever knocks has the door opened.
bib-matthew-002-p09.core_idea: Ask, seek and knock, and you will receive.

bib-matthew-002-p10.plain: So treat other people the way you want them to treat you; this sums up the law and the prophets.
bib-matthew-002-p10.core_idea: Treat others as you want to be treated.

bib-matthew-002-p11.plain: Go in through the narrow gate. The gate and road to destruction are wide and easy, and many take them; but the gate and road to life are narrow and hard, and few find them.
bib-matthew-002-p11.core_idea: The road to life is narrow and few find it.

bib-matthew-003-p01.plain: Healthy people don't need a doctor; sick people do.
bib-matthew-003-p01.core_idea: Help is for those who need it.

bib-matthew-003-p02.plain: You were given freely, so give freely.
bib-matthew-003-p02.core_idea: Give freely, as you freely received.

bib-matthew-003-p03.plain: Two sparrows sell for a small coin, yet not one falls to the ground without your Father's will, and every hair on your head is counted. So don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
bib-matthew-003-p03.core_idea: God cares for you, so do not fear.

bib-matthew-003-p04.plain: Jesus invites everyone who is worn out and weighed down to come to him for rest. Take on his yoke and learn from him, for he is gentle and humble; his yoke is easy and his load is light.
bib-matthew-003-p04.core_idea: Come to Jesus when weary and find rest.

bib-matthew-004-p01.plain: Any kingdom split against itself is ruined, and any city or household split against itself will not last.
bib-matthew-004-p01.core_idea: Division brings any kingdom or house to ruin.

bib-matthew-004-p02.plain: The mouth speaks from what fills the heart. A good person brings good things out of the good stored inside, and an evil person brings evil things out of the evil stored inside.
bib-matthew-004-p02.core_idea: Words reveal what fills the heart.

bib-matthew-004-p03.plain: A farmer sowed seed. Some fell on the path and birds ate it; some on rocky ground, sprang up fast and withered without roots; some among thorns and was choked; and some on good soil, yielding a rich harvest.
bib-matthew-004-p03.core_idea: The same seed thrives only in good soil.

bib-matthew-004-p04.plain: The Kingdom of Heaven is like a mustard seed a man planted: the smallest of all seeds, it grows into a tree big enough for birds to nest in its branches.
bib-matthew-004-p04.core_idea: The Kingdom of Heaven starts tiny and grows great.

bib-matthew-004-p05.plain: A prophet is honoured everywhere except in his hometown and his own home.
bib-matthew-004-p05.core_idea: Prophets go unhonoured among their own people.

bib-matthew-005-p01.plain: What goes into a person's mouth does not make them unclean; what comes out of their mouth does.
bib-matthew-005-p01.core_idea: What you say defiles you, not what you eat.

bib-matthew-005-p02.plain: If a blind person leads a blind person, both will fall into a ditch.
bib-matthew-005-p02.core_idea: The blind cannot lead the blind.

bib-matthew-005-p03.plain: What good is it to win the whole world and lose your own life? What could anyone give in exchange for their life?
bib-matthew-005-p03.core_idea: Gaining the world is worthless if you lose your life.

bib-matthew-005-p04.plain: Jesus said that with faith as small as a mustard seed you could tell a mountain to move and it would move; nothing would be impossible for you.
bib-matthew-005-p04.core_idea: Even tiny faith can move mountains.

bib-matthew-006-p01.plain: Jesus said that unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the Kingdom of Heaven.
bib-matthew-006-p01.core_idea: Become like a child to enter the Kingdom.

bib-matthew-006-p02.plain: If a man with a hundred sheep loses one, won't he leave the ninety-nine and search the hills for the lost one? And if he finds it, he is happier over that one than over the ninety-nine that never strayed.
bib-matthew-006-p02.core_idea: The one who strays is sought and rejoiced over.

bib-matthew-006-p03.plain: If your brother wrongs you, go and point it out to him privately. If he listens, you have won your brother back.
bib-matthew-006-p03.core_idea: Settle a wrong privately and win your brother back.

bib-matthew-006-p04.plain: Peter asked how many times he should forgive a brother who keeps wronging him, as many as seven? Jesus said not seven times, but seventy times seven.
bib-matthew-006-p04.core_idea: Forgive again and again, without counting.

bib-matthew-006-p05.plain: For people this is impossible, but for God everything is possible.
bib-matthew-006-p05.core_idea: All things are possible with God.

bib-matthew-006-p06.plain: Rulers lord it over their people, but not so among you: whoever wants to be great must serve, and whoever wants to be first must be a slave, as the Son of Man came to serve and give his life.
bib-matthew-006-p06.core_idea: Greatness means serving, as the Son of Man served.

judge.issue: Drops 'as a ransom for many' from the Son of Man's giving his life.

bib-matthew-007-p01.plain: A father asked two sons to work in his vineyard. The first refused but later changed his mind and went; the second said he would go but never did. Which one did what his father wanted?
bib-matthew-007-p01.core_idea: Doing what is asked matters more than promising.

fix.display_text: A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’ He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went. He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go. Which of the two did the will of his father?

bib-matthew-007-p02.plain: The stone the builders threw away has become the cornerstone.
bib-matthew-007-p02.core_idea: What was rejected becomes the foundation.

bib-matthew-007-p03.plain: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and mind; this is the first and greatest commandment. The second is like it: love your neighbour as yourself. All the law and the prophets rest on these two.
bib-matthew-007-p03.core_idea: Love God fully and your neighbour as yourself.

fix.display_text: ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.

bib-matthew-007-p04.plain: Whoever lifts themselves up will be brought low, and whoever lowers themselves will be lifted up.
bib-matthew-007-p04.core_idea: The proud are humbled and the humble raised.

bib-matthew-008-p01.plain: Jesus grieves over Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets sent to it: how often he longed to gather its children as a hen gathers chicks under her wings, but they would not let him.
bib-matthew-008-p01.core_idea: Love that longs to shelter is refused.

bib-matthew-008-p02.plain: You will hear of wars and rumours of wars. Don't be alarmed; these things must happen, but the end is not yet.
bib-matthew-008-p02.core_idea: Don't be alarmed by wars; the end is not yet.

bib-matthew-008-p03.plain: As wrongdoing spreads, most people's love will grow cold. But whoever holds out to the end will be saved.
bib-matthew-008-p03.core_idea: Endure to the end though love grows cold.

judge.issue: 'The love of many' widened to 'most people's love'.

bib-matthew-008-p04.plain: Well done, good and faithful servant. You were trustworthy with a little, so I will put you in charge of much. Come and share your master's joy.
bib-matthew-008-p04.core_idea: Faithfulness in small things leads to greater trust.

bib-matthew-008-p05.plain: The King welcomes those who fed, clothed, sheltered and visited him when he was hungry, a stranger, sick or in prison. When they ask when, he says: whatever you did for the least of my brothers, you did for me.
bib-matthew-008-p05.core_idea: Serving the least of people is serving the King.

bib-matthew-009-p01.plain: Jesus went a little farther, fell face down, and prayed: My Father, if it is possible, take this suffering away from me; yet let it be as you want, not as I want.
bib-matthew-009-p01.core_idea: Surrender your own will to God's, even in anguish.

bib-matthew-009-p02.plain: Stay alert and pray so you don't give in to temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
bib-matthew-009-p02.core_idea: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.

bib-matthew-009-p03.plain: Jesus told his follower to put his sword away, because everyone who lives by the sword will die by the sword.
bib-matthew-009-p03.core_idea: Those who take up the sword die by it.

bib-matthew-009-p04.plain: Around three in the afternoon Jesus cried out loudly, My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?
bib-matthew-009-p04.core_idea: Even Jesus cried out, feeling abandoned by God.

bib-matthew-009-p05.plain: Jesus promises that he is with you always, to the very end of the age.

bib-micah-001-p01.plain: People will hammer their swords into ploughs and their spears into pruning tools. Nations will no longer fight or train for war; everyone will sit under their own vine and fig tree, unafraid, for Yahweh of Armies has said so.
bib-micah-001-p01.core_idea: Yahweh promises a peace where war is unlearned.

bib-micah-001-p02.plain: How should I approach Yahweh: with burnt offerings, thousands of rams, rivers of oil, even my firstborn child? No. He has shown you what is good: to act justly, love mercy and walk humbly with your God.
bib-micah-001-p02.core_idea: God asks for justice, mercy and humility, not sacrifices.

bib-micah-001-p03.plain: I will look to Yahweh and wait for the God who saves me; he will hear me. Don't gloat, my enemy: when I fall I will get up, and in darkness Yahweh will be my light.
bib-micah-001-p03.core_idea: When I fall, I rise; God is my light.

bib-micah-001-p04.plain: Who is a God like you, forgiving wrongdoing and overlooking his people's rebellion? He doesn't stay angry forever, because he loves kindness. He will have mercy on us again and throw our sins into the deep sea.
bib-micah-001-p04.core_idea: God delights in mercy and buries our sins.

bib-nahum-001-p01.plain: Yahweh is good, a safe stronghold when trouble comes, and he knows those who take shelter in him.
bib-nahum-001-p01.core_idea: Yahweh is a refuge in times of trouble.

bib-nehemiah-001-p01.plain: The king asked why I looked sad when I wasn't ill; it must be grief. Terrified, I answered: how could I not be sad when the city of my ancestors' graves lies ruined, its gates burned?
bib-nehemiah-001-p01.core_idea: Grief for a ruined home shows on the face.

bib-nehemiah-001-p02.plain: The people of Judah said the workers carrying loads were worn out and there was so much rubble that they could not build the wall.
bib-nehemiah-001-p02.core_idea: Exhaustion and rubble can make the work seem impossible.

bib-nehemiah-002-p01.plain: My God, remember me kindly for all I have done for this people.
bib-nehemiah-002-p01.core_idea: Asking God to remember the good one has done.

bib-nehemiah-002-p02.plain: I am doing important work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to come to you?
bib-nehemiah-002-p02.core_idea: Don't abandon important work for distractions.

bib-nehemiah-002-p03.plain: None of the things you claim have happened; you are making them up in your own mind.

bib-nehemiah-003-p01.plain: Go and enjoy rich food and sweet drinks, and share with those who have nothing, because today is holy to our Lord. Don't be sad, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.
bib-nehemiah-003-p01.core_idea: The joy of Yahweh is your strength.

bib-nehemiah-003-p02.plain: But you are a God who is ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and full of loving kindness, and you did not abandon them.
bib-nehemiah-003-p02.core_idea: God is ready to forgive and does not abandon.

bib-obadiah-001-p01.plain: Yahweh says your proud heart has fooled you, living high among the rocks and thinking no one can bring you down. Even if you soar like an eagle and nest among the stars, he will bring you down.
bib-obadiah-001-p01.core_idea: Pride deceives; God brings the lofty down.

bib-obadiah-001-p02.plain: Don't look down on your brother on the day of his disaster, don't gloat over Judah's people on the day of their ruin, and don't boast when they are in distress.
bib-obadiah-001-p02.core_idea: Don't gloat over others in their disaster.

bib-philippians-001-p01.plain: Paul says he has not yet arrived, but he does one thing: forgetting what lies behind and reaching for what lies ahead, he presses on toward the goal, the prize of God's heavenly call in Christ Jesus.
bib-philippians-001-p01.core_idea: Forget what is behind and press on ahead.

bib-philippians-001-p02.plain: Always rejoice in the Lord, and let everyone see your gentleness; the Lord is near. Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything with thanks, and God's peace, beyond understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
bib-philippians-001-p02.core_idea: Pray instead of worrying, and God's peace guards you.

bib-philippians-001-p03.plain: Finally, fill your mind with whatever is true, honourable, just, pure, lovely and well spoken of, whatever is excellent and worthy of praise.
bib-philippians-001-p03.core_idea: Think about what is true, good and lovely.

bib-philippians-001-p04.plain: Paul says he knows how to live with little and with plenty; he has learned the secret of being content whether full or hungry, rich or in need. He can do all things through Christ, who gives him strength.
bib-philippians-001-p04.core_idea: Contentment in plenty or want, through Christ's strength.

bib-prayerofmanasseh-001-p01.plain: Lord, in your great goodness you have promised repentance and forgiveness to those who have sinned against you, and in your endless mercy you have given sinners the way of repentance so they may be saved.
bib-prayerofmanasseh-001-p01.core_idea: God's mercy offers sinners repentance and forgiveness.

bib-prayerofmanasseh-001-p02.plain: I have sinned, Lord, and I admit my wrongs. I humbly beg you to forgive me and not stay angry forever. You are the God of those who repent, and in your mercy you will save unworthy me.
bib-prayerofmanasseh-001-p02.core_idea: A sinner begs for God's mercy and forgiveness.

judge.issue: Drops pleas not to be destroyed or condemned to the lower parts of the earth.

bib-pro-001-p01.plain: Never let kindness and truth leave you; tie them around your neck and write them on your heart. Then you will win favour and a good name with God and people.
bib-pro-001-p01.core_idea: Hold fast to kindness and truth.

bib-pro-001-p02.plain: Trust Yahweh with all your heart and don't rely on your own understanding. Acknowledge him in everything you do, and he will make your paths straight.
bib-pro-001-p02.core_idea: Trust God fully, not your own understanding.

bib-pro-001-p03.plain: My son, don't reject Yahweh's discipline or resent his correction, because Yahweh corrects those he loves, as a father corrects the son he delights in.

bib-pro-001-p04.plain: Happy is the one who finds wisdom. She is worth more than silver, gold or rubies, more than anything you could want. She brings long life, riches, honour and peace, a tree of life to those who hold her.
bib-pro-001-p04.core_idea: Wisdom is worth more than any riches.

bib-pro-001-p05.plain: Don't be afraid of sudden terror or of the ruin that comes on the wicked, because Yahweh will be your confidence and keep your foot from being caught.
bib-pro-001-p05.core_idea: Don't fear sudden terror; God keeps you safe.

bib-pro-001-p06.plain: Don't hold back good from those who deserve it when you are able to give it. Don't tell your neighbour to come back tomorrow when you have it with you now.
bib-pro-001-p06.core_idea: Do good now when you are able.

bib-pro-001-p07.plain: Don't quarrel with someone for no reason when they have done you no harm. Don't envy a violent person or copy any of their ways.
bib-pro-001-p07.core_idea: Avoid needless quarrels and don't envy the violent.

bib-pro-001-p08.plain: The path of the righteous is like the first light of dawn, growing brighter until full day. The way of the wicked is like darkness; they don't even know what trips them up.
bib-pro-001-p08.core_idea: The righteous path grows brighter; the wicked stumble.

bib-pro-001-p09.plain: Guard your heart above all, because your whole life flows from it. Keep crooked and corrupt talk far from you. Keep your eyes looking straight ahead and fix your gaze on what is before you.
bib-pro-001-p09.core_idea: Guard your heart; life flows from it.

bib-pro-001-p10.plain: Lazy one, go watch the ant and learn: with no boss, she stores food in summer and harvest. How long will you sleep? A little more sleep and rest, and poverty will come on you like a robber.
bib-pro-001-p10.core_idea: Learn diligence from the ant, or poverty comes.

bib-pro-001-p11.plain: Can a man carry fire in his lap without burning his clothes, or walk on hot coals without scorching his feet? So it is with the man who sleeps with his neighbour's wife: he will not go unpunished.
bib-pro-001-p11.core_idea: Adultery, like playing with fire, brings harm.

extension.text: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned? Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched? So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

bib-pro-002-p01.plain: Correcting a mocker or a wicked person only gets you insults and abuse, and the scoffer will hate you. Correct a wise person and they will love you; teach the wise and righteous and they will grow wiser still.
bib-pro-002-p01.core_idea: The wise welcome correction; mockers resent it.

bib-pro-002-p02.plain: Whoever lives with integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.
bib-pro-002-p02.core_idea: Integrity is secure; crookedness gets exposed.

bib-pro-002-p03.plain: Hatred stirs up fights, but love covers over every wrong.
bib-pro-002-p03.core_idea: Love covers all wrongs; hatred stirs strife.

bib-pro-002-p04.plain: Where there are many words, wrongdoing is never far away, but whoever holds their tongue is wise.
bib-pro-002-p04.core_idea: Too many words lead to wrong; restraint is wise.

bib-pro-002-p05.plain: Pride is followed by shame, but humility brings wisdom.
bib-pro-002-p05.core_idea: Pride brings shame; humility brings wisdom.

bib-pro-002-p06.plain: Whoever looks down on their neighbour lacks sense, but a person of understanding stays quiet. A gossip betrays secrets, but a trustworthy person keeps them.
bib-pro-002-p06.core_idea: The wise stay quiet and keep confidences.

bib-pro-002-p07.plain: Without wise guidance a nation falls, but with many advisers comes victory.

bib-pro-002-p08.plain: A merciful person does good to their own soul, but a cruel person brings trouble on their own body.
bib-pro-002-p08.core_idea: Mercy benefits yourself; cruelty harms yourself.

bib-pro-002-p09.plain: Some give freely and grow richer; others hold back more than they should and end up poor. A generous person will prosper, and whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

bib-pro-003-p01.plain: A fool shows their irritation at once, but a sensible person ignores an insult.

bib-pro-003-p02.plain: Careless words can cut like a sword, but the words of the wise bring healing.
bib-pro-003-p02.core_idea: Rash words wound; wise words heal.

bib-pro-003-p03.plain: Worry weighs a person's heart down, but a kind word lifts it up.
bib-pro-003-p03.core_idea: A kind word lifts an anxious heart.

bib-pro-003-p04.plain: Hope that keeps being put off makes the heart sick, but a longing that comes true is like a tree of life.
bib-pro-003-p04.core_idea: Delayed hope sickens; fulfilled longing gives life.

bib-pro-003-p05.plain: Spend time with wise people and you become wise; keep company with fools and you get hurt.
bib-pro-003-p05.core_idea: You become like the company you keep.

bib-pro-003-p06.plain: Only your own heart knows its bitterness and its joy; no stranger can share them.
bib-pro-003-p06.core_idea: Each heart knows its own sorrow and joy.

bib-pro-003-p07.plain: Even while laughing, the heart can be sad, and joy can end in grief.
bib-pro-003-p07.core_idea: Laughter can hide a sorrowful heart.

bib-pro-003-p08.plain: A peaceful heart gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
bib-pro-003-p08.core_idea: A peaceful heart gives life; envy rots.

bib-pro-003-p09.plain: A gentle answer calms anger, but a harsh word stirs it up.
bib-pro-003-p09.core_idea: Gentle answers calm anger; harsh words inflame it.

bib-pro-003-p10.plain: Better to have little and revere Yahweh than great wealth with trouble. Better a simple meal of vegetables where there is love than a feast of fattened beef with hatred.
bib-pro-003-p10.core_idea: Little with love beats plenty with strife.

bib-pro-003-p11.plain: A person plans their route in their heart, but Yahweh guides their steps.
bib-pro-003-p11.core_idea: We make plans, but God directs our steps.

bib-pro-003-p12.plain: Pride comes before ruin, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

bib-pro-003-p13.plain: Kind words are like honey: sweet to the soul and healing to the body.
bib-pro-003-p13.core_idea: Kind words are sweet and healing.

bib-pro-003-p14.plain: Grey hair is a crown of honour, earned by living rightly.
bib-pro-003-p14.core_idea: Grey hair honours a righteous life.

bib-pro-003-p15.plain: Someone slow to anger is better than a warrior, and someone who controls their temper is better than one who captures a city.

bib-pro-003-p16.plain: Whoever lets an offence go builds love, but whoever keeps bringing it up drives close friends apart.
bib-pro-003-p16.core_idea: Forgiving offences builds love; repeating them divides.

bib-pro-004-p01.plain: Starting a quarrel is like breaking open a dam, so stop the argument before it bursts out.
bib-pro-004-p01.core_idea: Stop a quarrel before it breaks loose.

bib-pro-004-p02.plain: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born to help in hard times.
bib-pro-004-p02.core_idea: True friends and family stand by you in trouble.

bib-pro-004-p03.plain: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.
bib-pro-004-p03.core_idea: A cheerful heart is good medicine.

bib-pro-004-p04.plain: Someone who holds back their words has knowledge, and someone calm has understanding. Even a fool who keeps quiet is taken for wise, and seems sensible when they keep their mouth shut.

bib-pro-004-p05.plain: Answering before you have listened is foolish and shameful.

bib-pro-004-p06.plain: A person's spirit can carry them through illness, but who can bear a crushed spirit?
bib-pro-004-p06.core_idea: A strong spirit sustains; a crushed one is unbearable.

bib-pro-004-p07.plain: The first to state their case seems right, until someone else comes and questions them.

bib-pro-004-p08.plain: The tongue holds the power of life and death, and those who love to talk will live with the results.
bib-pro-004-p08.core_idea: Words hold the power of life and death.

judge.issue: Narrows "those who love it" to those who love to talk.

bib-pro-004-p09.plain: Someone with many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
bib-pro-004-p09.core_idea: One true friend outweighs many companions.

bib-pro-004-p10.plain: Eagerness without knowledge is not good, and rushing ahead makes you lose your way.

bib-pro-004-p11.plain: All the relatives of a poor man avoid him, and his friends keep even further away. He chases after them pleading, but they are gone.
bib-pro-004-p11.core_idea: The poor are abandoned by family and friends.

bib-pro-004-p12.plain: Good sense makes a person slow to anger, and it is to their credit to overlook an offence.
bib-pro-004-p12.core_idea: It is noble to overlook an offence.

bib-pro-004-p13.plain: The purposes in a person's heart are like deep water, but someone with understanding can draw them out.
bib-pro-004-p13.core_idea: The wise draw out what lies deep in hearts.

bib-pro-004-p14.plain: Who can claim to have made their heart pure and to be clean and free of sin?
bib-pro-004-p14.core_idea: No one can claim to be free of sin.

bib-pro-004-p15.plain: Don't say you will get even for a wrong. Wait for Yahweh, and he will rescue you.
bib-pro-004-p15.core_idea: Don't take revenge; wait for God.

bib-pro-004-p16.plain: The pride of young men is their strength, and the honour of old men is their grey hair.
bib-pro-004-p16.core_idea: Youth has strength; age has honour.

bib-pro-004-p17.plain: A good name is worth more than great wealth, and being well regarded is better than silver or gold.
bib-pro-004-p17.core_idea: A good name is worth more than riches.

bib-pro-004-p18.plain: Don't make friends with a hot-tempered or angry person, or you may pick up their ways and trap yourself.
bib-pro-004-p18.core_idea: Avoid angry people, or you'll become like them.

bib-pro-005-p01.plain: Don't wear yourself out trying to get rich; be wise enough to hold back. Why fix your eyes on wealth that is gone in a moment? It sprouts wings and flies off like an eagle.
bib-pro-005-p01.core_idea: Riches fly away; don't exhaust yourself chasing them.

bib-pro-005-p02.plain: Don't envy sinners in your heart; keep revering Yahweh all day long. There truly is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
bib-pro-005-p02.core_idea: Don't envy sinners; your hope has a future.

bib-pro-005-p03.plain: Who has misery, sorrow, quarrels, complaints, needless bruises and bloodshot eyes? Those who linger over wine. Don't be drawn by how it sparkles and goes down smoothly; in the end it bites like a snake.
bib-pro-005-p03.core_idea: Heavy drinking brings misery and bites like a snake.

bib-pro-005-p04.plain: Wicked man, don't lie in wait to attack the home of the righteous, because a righteous person falls seven times and gets up again, but the wicked are brought down by disaster.
bib-pro-005-p04.core_idea: The righteous fall seven times and rise again.

bib-pro-005-p05.plain: Don't celebrate when your enemy falls or be glad when he is brought down, or Yahweh may see it, be displeased, and turn his anger away from him.
bib-pro-005-p05.core_idea: Don't rejoice when your enemy falls.

bib-pro-005-p06.plain: A word spoken at the right moment is like golden apples set in silver.

bib-pro-005-p07.plain: Singing cheerful songs to someone with a heavy heart is like taking away their coat on a cold day, or pouring vinegar on soda.
bib-pro-005-p07.core_idea: Cheerfulness forced on the grieving hurts them.

bib-pro-005-p08.plain: If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him water. In doing so you heap burning coals on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.
bib-pro-005-p08.core_idea: Answer your enemy's need with kindness.

bib-pro-005-p09.plain: A person who cannot control themselves is as defenceless as a city whose walls have been torn down.
bib-pro-005-p09.core_idea: Without self-control, a person is defenceless

bib-pro-005-p10.plain: A fire dies when it runs out of wood, and a quarrel dies down when no one keeps gossiping.
bib-pro-005-p10.core_idea: Gossip feeds quarrels; without it they end

bib-pro-005-p11.plain: Don't brag about what you'll do tomorrow, because you have no idea what the day will bring.
bib-pro-005-p11.core_idea: Tomorrow is unknown, so don't boast about it

bib-pro-005-p12.plain: Honest correction said openly is better than love kept hidden. A friend's wounding words can be trusted, while an enemy's many kisses cannot.
bib-pro-005-p12.core_idea: A friend's honest rebuke beats an enemy's flattery

bib-pro-005-p13.plain: A man who strays from his home is like a bird that has wandered away from its nest.
bib-pro-005-p13.core_idea: Leaving home leaves a person unsettled and exposed

bib-pro-005-p14.plain: Don't abandon your friends or your family's old friends. When disaster hits, a neighbour close by is more help than a brother far away.
bib-pro-005-p14.core_idea: A near neighbour helps more than distant kin

judge.issue: Drops the warning not to go to your brother's house in the day of disaster.

bib-pro-005-p15.plain: Just as one piece of iron sharpens another, people sharpen and improve each other.

bib-pro-005-p16.plain: As water shows you your face, your heart shows who you really are. Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are human eyes.
bib-pro-005-p16.core_idea: The heart reveals the person; desire never ends

bib-pro-006-p01.plain: Wrongdoers run away even when no one is chasing them, but people who do right are as bold as a lion.
bib-pro-006-p01.core_idea: A clear conscience makes a person bold

bib-pro-006-p02.plain: If you hide your wrongdoing you won't do well, but if you admit it and turn away from it, you will find mercy.
bib-pro-006-p02.core_idea: Confessing wrongs brings mercy; hiding them doesn't

bib-pro-006-p03.plain: A fool lets all their anger out, but a wise person keeps themselves under control.

bib-pro-006-p04.plain: Being afraid of what people think traps you, but whoever trusts in God is kept safe.
bib-pro-006-p04.core_idea: Fear of people traps; trust in God protects

judge.issue: Narrows "fear of man" to fear of what people think.

bib-pro-006-p05.plain: The speaker asks God for two things before dying: keep lies far away, and give neither poverty nor wealth, just enough, so that riches don't lead to forgetting God or need to stealing.
bib-pro-006-p05.core_idea: Ask for enough, neither poverty nor riches

judge.issue: Softens denying God ("Who is Yahweh?") to forgetting; drops dishonouring God's name.

bib-pro-006-p06.plain: Some things are too wonderful to understand: how an eagle flies, how a snake moves on rock, how a ship crosses the sea, and how a man and a young woman come together.
bib-pro-006-p06.core_idea: Some ways of the world are beyond understanding

bib-pro-006-p07.plain: Four small creatures are very wise: ants store food in summer, rock badgers make homes in cliffs, locusts march in order with no king, and a lizard you can catch lives in palaces.
bib-pro-006-p07.core_idea: Small and weak things can be very wise

bib-pro-006-p08.plain: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves and for everyone left with nothing. Speak up, judge fairly, and see that the poor and needy get justice.
bib-pro-006-p08.core_idea: Speak up for the voiceless and the poor

bib-pro-006-p09.plain: Charm can deceive and beauty doesn't last, but a woman who reveres God deserves praise.
bib-pro-006-p09.core_idea: Reverence for God outlasts charm and beauty

bib-psa-001-p01.plain: Happy is the person who doesn't follow the wicked or mock, but loves God's law and thinks on it day and night. They are like a well-watered tree that bears fruit and doesn't wither.
bib-psa-001-p01.core_idea: Delight in God's law makes a life flourish

judge.issue: Compresses the three-fold avoidance and drops "whatever he does shall prosper".

bib-psa-001-p02.plain: I lay down and slept, and I woke up again, because God keeps me going. I won't be afraid even of the thousands who surround me as enemies.
bib-psa-001-p02.core_idea: God sustains me, so I need not fear

bib-psa-001-p03.plain: Stand in awe and don't do wrong. Lying in bed, look honestly into your own heart, and be still.

bib-psa-001-p04.plain: Many people ask who will ever show them anything good. The psalmist asks God to shine on them, saying God has given more joy than a rich harvest brings.
bib-psa-001-p04.core_idea: God's favour gives more joy than plenty

bib-psa-001-p05.plain: I can lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, God, keep me safe.
bib-psa-001-p05.core_idea: Peaceful sleep comes from trusting God

bib-psa-001-p06.plain: I am worn out from groaning. Every night I soak my bed with tears, and grief and my enemies have made my eyes weak and old.
bib-psa-001-p06.core_idea: Grief can exhaust and overwhelm a person

bib-psa-001-p07.plain: Looking at the sky God made, the moon and the stars, the psalmist wonders why God would think of or care for human beings at all.
bib-psa-001-p07.core_idea: Why would God care for small humans?

bib-psa-001-p08.plain: God will be a strong refuge for the oppressed and for anyone in trouble. Those who know God trust God, because God has never abandoned those who seek him.
bib-psa-001-p08.core_idea: God is a refuge who never abandons seekers

bib-psa-001-p09.plain: How long, God? Will you forget me forever and hide from me? How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and carry sorrow every day while my enemy wins?
bib-psa-001-p09.core_idea: Crying out to God in long sorrow

bib-psa-002-p01.plain: Who may live close to God? The one who lives with integrity, tells the truth, doesn't slander or harm others, keeps promises even when it hurts, and takes no bribes. Such a person will never be shaken.
bib-psa-002-p01.core_idea: An honest, faithful life stands unshaken

judge.issue: Drops honouring the God-fearing, despising the vile, and refusing usury.

bib-psa-002-p02.plain: God has given me my share in life and made it secure, and it is a good one. I keep God always before me, so I will not be shaken.
bib-psa-002-p02.core_idea: Keeping God near, I stay steady and content

judge.issue: Drops blessing Yahweh for counsel and the heart instructing at night.

bib-psa-002-p03.plain: Death and evil wrapped around me and terrified me. In my distress I called out to God, and God heard my cry.
bib-psa-002-p03.core_idea: In deep distress, God heard my cry

bib-psa-002-p04.plain: God lights my lamp and brightens my darkness. With God's help I can charge through an army and leap over a wall.
bib-psa-002-p04.core_idea: God lights my darkness and gives strength

bib-psa-002-p05.plain: The sky proclaims God's glory and shows what God has made. Every day and night it speaks without words, and its message reaches everywhere.
bib-psa-002-p05.core_idea: The heavens speak wordlessly of God

bib-psa-002-p06.plain: No one can see all their own faults, so the psalmist asks God to forgive hidden ones, guard against deliberate wrongs, and accept his words and thoughts.
bib-psa-002-p06.core_idea: Asking God to forgive faults we cannot see

judge.issue: Drops the hope of being blameless and "my rock and my redeemer".

bib-psa-002-p07.plain: Some people trust in chariots and horses, but we trust in God. They have fallen down, while we get up and stand firm.
bib-psa-002-p07.core_idea: Trust God rather than military strength

bib-psa-002-p08.plain: My God, why have you abandoned me? Why are you so far from helping me? I cry out day and night, and you don't answer.
bib-psa-002-p08.core_idea: Feeling abandoned by God and unanswered

bib-psa-002-p09.plain: I feel poured out and broken: my bones out of joint, my heart melted, my strength dried up, my mouth parched. You have brought me near death.

bib-psa-003-p01.plain: God is my shepherd, so I have all I need. God gives me rest, restores me and guides me rightly. Even in the darkest valley I won't fear, because you are with me and comfort me.
bib-psa-003-p01.core_idea: With God as shepherd, I fear nothing

judge.issue: Drops "for his name's sake" and the rod and staff; paths of righteousness loosened.

bib-psa-003-p02.plain: Show me your ways, God, and teach me. Lead me in your truth, because you are the God who saves me, and I wait for you all day.
bib-psa-003-p02.core_idea: Asking God for guidance and waiting on him

bib-psa-003-p03.plain: Don't hold the wrongs of my youth against me, God. Remember me through your loving kindness and goodness instead.
bib-psa-003-p03.core_idea: Asking God to remember love, not past sins

bib-psa-003-p04.plain: Turn to me and be merciful, God, because I am lonely and suffering. My troubles keep growing. Rescue me, see my pain, and forgive all my wrongs.
bib-psa-003-p04.core_idea: A lonely plea to God for mercy

bib-psa-003-p05.plain: God is my light, my rescue and my strength, so whom should I fear?
bib-psa-003-p05.core_idea: With God as my light, I fear no one

bib-psa-003-p06.plain: Even if my father and mother abandon me, God will take me in.
bib-psa-003-p06.core_idea: God takes in those whom family abandons

bib-psa-003-p07.plain: I am still sure I will see God's goodness while I am alive. Wait for God; be strong and take courage; keep waiting for God.
bib-psa-003-p07.core_idea: Wait for God with courage and hope

bib-psa-003-p08.plain: God's anger lasts only a moment, but his favour lasts a lifetime. Crying may last through the night, but joy comes in the morning.
bib-psa-003-p08.core_idea: Night of weeping, morning of joy

bib-psa-003-p09.plain: When things were going well, I thought nothing could ever shake me. God's favour made me strong, but when God seemed to turn away, I was shaken.
bib-psa-003-p09.core_idea: Security in good times rests on God

judge.issue: 'Seemed to turn away' hedges 'hid your face'; direct address to God lost.

bib-psa-003-p10.plain: You turned my grieving into dancing and replaced my mourning clothes with joy, so that I would sing to you and not stay silent. God, I will thank you forever.

bib-psa-003-p11.plain: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. Grief and sorrow waste my eyes, soul, body and years; my own sin has drained my strength. My enemies have made me despised; neighbours and friends flee me, and I am forgotten like the dead, like broken pottery.
bib-psa-003-p11.core_idea: Grief, weakness, and being shunned by others
bib-psa-003-p11.plain_v1: Be merciful, God, because I am in distress. Grief and sorrow are wearing me down, my strength is failing, and even friends and neighbours avoid me and forget me like the dead.

judge_v1.issue: Drops that the speaker's strength fails because of his own iniquity.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops that his own iniquity causes his failing strength.

bib-psa-003-p12.plain: In a panic I said God had cut me off and no longer saw me. But you heard me when I cried out to you.
bib-psa-003-p12.core_idea: God heard me when I felt cut off

bib-psa-003-p13.plain: While I kept my wrongdoing to myself, I wasted away groaning and felt God's heavy hand on me. When I admitted my sin to God and hid nothing, God forgave me.
bib-psa-003-p13.core_idea: Hiding sin wears you down; confessing brings forgiveness

bib-psa-004-p01.plain: God promises to teach and guide you on the way you should go, watching over you. Don't be like a horse or mule that has no sense and must be controlled with a bit.
bib-psa-004-p01.core_idea: God guides those willing to be taught

judge.issue: Recasts God's first-person promise as reported speech; drops 'or they will not come near you'.

bib-psa-004-p02.plain: No king is saved by a big army, and no strong man by his strength. A war horse is a false hope for safety; its power rescues no one.
bib-psa-004-p02.core_idea: Strength and armies cannot truly save

bib-psa-004-p03.plain: I looked for God, and God answered me and freed me from all my fears.
bib-psa-004-p03.core_idea: Seeking God freed me from fear

bib-psa-004-p04.plain: If you want a long and good life, don't speak evil or tell lies. Turn away from wrong and do good. Look for peace and go after it.
bib-psa-004-p04.core_idea: Speak truly, do good, and pursue peace

fix.display_text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies. Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
fix.reason: Missing capital letter after full stop

bib-psa-004-p05.plain: God is close to people whose hearts are broken and rescues those whose spirits are crushed.

bib-psa-004-p06.plain: I treated them with kindness, fasting and mourning when they were sick as if for family, but they repay me with evil and celebrate my troubles, attacking me without stopping.
bib-psa-004-p06.core_idea: Repaid with cruelty for kindness shown

judge.issue: Omits the unanswered prayer and that the attack came unawares.

bib-psa-004-p07.plain: God, your loving kindness is precious. People shelter under your care and are richly satisfied. You are the source of life, and in your light we see light.
bib-psa-004-p07.core_idea: God's love is the source of life and light

bib-psa-004-p08.plain: Trust God and do good. Take delight in God, and he will give you what your heart desires. Hand your path over to God, and he will make your goodness shine like daylight.
bib-psa-004-p08.core_idea: Trust God, do good, and delight in him

judge.issue: Drops 'dwell in the land, enjoy safe pasture' and justice shining like noon.

bib-psa-004-p09.plain: Rest in God and wait patiently. Don't fret when schemers seem to succeed. Let go of anger and rage; fretting only leads you to do wrong.
bib-psa-004-p09.core_idea: Wait on God; don't fret over the wicked

bib-psa-004-p10.plain: A little that belongs to a good person is better than the great wealth of many wicked people.
bib-psa-004-p10.core_idea: Little with goodness beats wealth with wickedness

bib-psa-004-p11.plain: God makes a person's steps firm and delights in their way. Even if they stumble, they won't fall, because God holds them up by the hand.
bib-psa-004-p11.core_idea: Though we stumble, God keeps us from falling

bib-psa-004-p12.plain: I have seen a wicked man in great power, spreading like a lush tree, but then he was gone and couldn't be found. Look at the honest and upright: the peaceful person has a future.
bib-psa-004-p12.core_idea: The wicked fade; the peaceful have a future

bib-psa-004-p13.plain: I am weak and bruised, groaning with anguish. God, you see all I long for and hear my groaning. My strength and sight fail, and my friends and family keep their distance.
bib-psa-004-p13.core_idea: Suffering alone while God sees all

bib-psa-005-p01.plain: God, show me how short my life is and how frail I am. You have made my days only a few hand-widths long; before you my whole life is nothing, every person just a breath.
bib-psa-005-p01.core_idea: Life is brief, like a breath

bib-psa-005-p02.plain: Hear my prayer, God, and don't be silent at my tears. I am only a passing guest with you, like my ancestors. Spare me so I can recover before I am gone.
bib-psa-005-p02.core_idea: A brief guest on earth asking God to listen

judge.issue: 'Before I am gone' softens 'before I go away and exist no more'.

bib-psa-005-p03.plain: I waited patiently for God, and he heard me. He lifted me out of a muddy pit, set my feet on solid rock, and gave me a new song of praise that will lead others to trust him.
bib-psa-005-p03.core_idea: Patient waiting; God lifts me from the pit

judge.issue: Drops 'many shall see it, and fear'.

bib-psa-005-p04.plain: Don't hold back your mercy from me, God; let your love and truth always protect me. Countless troubles surround me, and my wrongs have caught up with me until I can't look up and my heart fails.
bib-psa-005-p04.core_idea: Overwhelmed, asking God's mercy to hold on

bib-psa-005-p05.plain: Even my close friend, someone I trusted and shared meals with, has turned against me.

bib-psa-005-p06.plain: As a deer longs for streams of water, my soul longs for you, God. I thirst for the living God. I have cried day and night while people keep asking me where my God is.
bib-psa-005-p06.core_idea: The soul thirsts for God like a deer

judge.issue: Drops 'When shall I come and appear before God?'

bib-psa-005-p07.plain: My soul, why are you so low and troubled inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise him for the help his presence brings.
bib-psa-005-p07.core_idea: Speaking to a despairing soul: hope in God

bib-psa-005-p08.plain: God is our safe place and our strength, always ready to help in trouble. So we will not be afraid, even if the earth gives way and the mountains fall into the raging sea.
bib-psa-005-p08.core_idea: With God as refuge, we need not fear

bib-psa-005-p09.plain: God says: be still and know that I am God, and I will be honoured among the nations and over all the earth.

bib-psa-006-p01.plain: Don't be troubled when someone grows rich and their household grows grand, because when they die they take nothing with them, and their glory doesn't follow them.
bib-psa-006-p01.core_idea: The rich take nothing with them at death

bib-psa-006-p02.plain: God, have mercy on me because of your loving kindness. In your great compassion, wipe away my wrongs and wash me clean, because I know what I have done; my sin is always on my mind.
bib-psa-006-p02.core_idea: Asking God to wash away known sin

bib-psa-006-p03.plain: God, make my heart clean and give me a new, steady spirit. Don't send me away from you or take your Spirit from me. Give me back the joy of being saved and a willing spirit.
bib-psa-006-p03.core_idea: A prayer for a clean heart and renewed spirit

bib-psa-006-p04.plain: What God wants as an offering is a broken spirit. God, you will not reject a heart that is broken and sorry.
bib-psa-006-p04.core_idea: God welcomes a broken, repentant heart

bib-psa-006-p05.plain: My heart is in anguish; fear of death, trembling and horror have overwhelmed me. I wish I had wings like a dove so I could fly far away into the wilderness and be at rest.
bib-psa-006-p05.core_idea: Longing to fly away from overwhelming fear

bib-psa-006-p06.plain: If an enemy had insulted me, I could bear it or hide. But it was you, someone like me, my close friend, with whom I shared good times and worshipped God.
bib-psa-006-p06.core_idea: Betrayal by a close friend hurts most

bib-psa-006-p07.plain: Hand your burden over to God, and he will hold you up. He will never let the righteous be shaken.

bib-psa-006-p08.plain: When I am afraid, I will trust you, God. Trusting God and his word, I won't be afraid. What can mere humans do to me?
bib-psa-006-p08.core_idea: In fear, I choose to trust God

bib-psa-006-p09.plain: You keep track of all my wandering, God, and you collect my tears in your bottle. Aren't they all written in your book?

bib-psa-006-p10.plain: Be merciful to me, God, because I take refuge in you. I will shelter under your wings until the disaster has passed.
bib-psa-006-p10.core_idea: Sheltering in God until trouble passes

bib-psa-007-p01.plain: Hear me, God, and listen to my prayer. From the far ends of the earth I call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to a rock higher than I am.
bib-psa-007-p01.core_idea: When overwhelmed, asking God for higher ground

bib-psa-007-p02.plain: My soul, wait quietly for God alone; my hope comes from him. He is my rock, rescue and fortress, so I won't be shaken. Trust him always, everyone, and pour out your heart to him.
bib-psa-007-p02.core_idea: Wait quietly on God; pour out your heart

bib-psa-007-p03.plain: Don't rely on oppressing others or take pride in stealing. And if you become richer, don't set your heart on your wealth.
bib-psa-007-p03.core_idea: Don't set your heart on riches

bib-psa-007-p04.plain: God, you are my God, and I will seek you with all I have. My whole being thirsts and longs for you, like someone in a dry, tired land with no water.
bib-psa-007-p04.core_idea: Longing for God like thirst in a desert

bib-psa-007-p05.plain: God, you have tested and refined us like silver. You let us be imprisoned, burdened and trampled; we went through fire and water, but you brought us out to a place of plenty.
bib-psa-007-p05.core_idea: Through trials, God refines and brings us through

bib-psa-007-p06.plain: From his holy home, God is a father to the fatherless and a protector of widows. He gives lonely people a family and leads prisoners out singing, but the rebellious live in a scorched land.
bib-psa-007-p06.core_idea: God cares for the fatherless, widowed and lonely

bib-psa-007-p07.plain: Praise the Lord, who carries our burdens every day, the God who saves us.

bib-psa-008-p01.plain: Save me, God, because the water is up to my neck. I'm sinking in deep mud with nothing to stand on. I'm worn out from crying, my throat is dry, and my eyes ache from looking for you.
bib-psa-008-p01.core_idea: Sinking and exhausted, crying out to God

bib-psa-008-p02.plain: Insults have broken my heart, and I feel heavy with sorrow. I looked for anyone to show pity or comfort me, but I found no one.

bib-psa-008-p03.plain: Don't push me away when I am old, God. Don't abandon me when my strength gives out.
bib-psa-008-p03.core_idea: A plea not to be abandoned in old age

bib-psa-008-p04.plain: You have let us see many bitter troubles, God, but you will keep me alive and lift us up again from the depths. Restore my honour and comfort me once more.
bib-psa-008-p04.core_idea: After bitter troubles, God will restore us

bib-psa-008-p05.plain: I almost lost my footing and fell, because I envied proud people when I saw wicked people doing so well.
bib-psa-008-p05.core_idea: Envying the prosperous wicked nearly made me fall

bib-psa-008-p06.plain: My heart was bitter and I was senseless as a beast before you. Yet I am always with you; you hold my hand, guide me, and will afterwards receive me into glory. I desire no one but you; though body and heart fail, God is my strength and portion forever.
bib-psa-008-p06.core_idea: Even when bitter, God holds and strengthens me
bib-psa-008-p06.plain_v1: I was bitter and grieving, as foolish as an animal before you, yet I am always with you; you hold my hand and guide me. My body and heart may fail, but God is my strength forever.

judge_v1.issue: Drops 'afterward receive me to glory' and 'no one on earth I desire besides you'.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops being received to glory and desiring no one but God.

bib-psa-009-p01.plain: I cry out to God to listen. In my trouble I reached out to the Lord all night, and my soul would not be comforted. Remembering God, I groan; you keep me awake, too troubled to speak.

bib-psa-009-p02.plain: Has the Lord rejected us for good? Will he never be kind again? Has his love disappeared, his promise failed? Has God forgotten mercy, or held back compassion in anger?
bib-psa-009-p02.core_idea: Asking whether God's love has run out

bib-psa-010-p01.plain: Happy are those who find their strength in God and set their hearts on the journey to him. Passing through the valley of weeping, they turn it into springs, and they grow stronger and stronger.
bib-psa-010-p01.core_idea: Strength in God turns weeping into springs

judge.issue: Adds 'to him' to pilgrimage; drops autumn-rain blessing; direct address to God lost.

bib-psa-010-p02.plain: Mercy and truth come together; justice and peace kiss each other. Truth grows up from the earth, and justice looks down from heaven.
bib-psa-010-p02.core_idea: Mercy, truth, justice and peace united

judge.issue: Renders 'righteousness' as 'justice', narrowing its meaning.

bib-psa-010-p03.plain: Teach me your way, God, and I will live by your truth. Give me an undivided heart that reveres you.
bib-psa-010-p03.core_idea: Asking God for an undivided heart

bib-psa-010-p04.plain: You have taken my friends away and made them turn from me. I'm shut in with no escape, and my eyes are dim with grief. Every day I call to you, God, reaching out my hands.
bib-psa-010-p04.core_idea: Isolated and grieving, still calling on God

judge.issue: 'Made them turn from me' softens 'made me an abomination to them'.

bib-psa-010-p05.plain: Remember how short my life is. How fleeting you have made all people! Who can live and never die, or escape the grave?
bib-psa-010-p05.core_idea: Life is short and no one escapes death

bib-psa-010-p06.plain: Lord, you have been our home through every generation. Before the mountains or the world existed, from forever to forever, you are God.

bib-psa-011-p01.plain: We live seventy years, maybe eighty if we are strong, but even the best of them are toil and sorrow, and they pass quickly and we are gone.
bib-psa-011-p01.core_idea: Life is short and quickly over

bib-psa-011-p02.plain: Fill us each morning with your loving kindness, God, so we can be glad all our lives. Give us as many glad days as the days of trouble we have seen.
bib-psa-011-p02.core_idea: Asking for joy to match past sorrow

bib-psa-011-p03.plain: May the Lord our God show us favour and make the work of our hands last; yes, make our work last.
bib-psa-011-p03.core_idea: Asking God to bless and establish our work

bib-psa-011-p04.plain: Whoever lives close to the Most High rests in God's shadow. God is my refuge and fortress, whom I trust. He will rescue you, shelter you under his wings, and you need not fear dangers by night or day.
bib-psa-011-p04.core_idea: Sheltered by God, you need not fear

judge.issue: Specific dangers (snare, pestilence, arrow) collapsed into generic night-and-day dangers.

bib-psa-011-p05.plain: Good people will flourish like palm trees and grow tall like cedars. Planted in God's house, they will thrive and still bear fruit when they are old.
bib-psa-011-p05.core_idea: The righteous flourish even into old age

bib-psa-011-p06.plain: If God hadn't helped me, I would soon have been silenced in death. When I said my foot was slipping, your love held me up, God. When my thoughts crowd in, your comfort cheers my soul.
bib-psa-011-p06.core_idea: God's love holds me up when slipping

bib-psa-011-p07.plain: My heart is withered like grass; I even forget to eat. My groaning has left me skin and bones. I am like a lonely bird in the wilderness, a sparrow alone on a rooftop.
bib-psa-011-p07.core_idea: Withered and alone in deep distress

bib-psa-012-p01.plain: My God, don't take me in the middle of my life. You laid the foundations of the earth and made the heavens; they will wear out like clothes, but you stay the same and your years never end.
bib-psa-012-p01.core_idea: All things wear out, but God endures

extension.text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations. Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed. But you are the same. Your years will have no end. The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

judge.issue: Drops closing promise that the servants' children will continue before God.

bib-psa-012-p02.plain: Praise God with everything in you, my soul, and don't forget all he does: he forgives your sins, heals your diseases, saves your life, surrounds you with love and fills you with good things, renewing your youth.
bib-psa-012-p02.core_idea: Remember and praise all God's goodness

bib-psa-012-p03.plain: Yahweh is merciful, gracious and slow to anger; he won't accuse forever or repay us for our sins. His love for those who fear him is as high as the heavens; he removes our sins as far as east from west, pitying them like a father, knowing we are dust.
bib-psa-012-p03.core_idea: God is compassionate and removes our wrongs
bib-psa-012-p03.plain_v1: God is merciful, kind, slow to anger and full of love. He doesn't punish us as our wrongs deserve, but removes them as far as east from west, caring for us like a father, knowing we are only dust.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the condition 'toward those who fear him'; makes God's love unconditional.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the condition that his compassion is toward those who fear him.

bib-psa-012-p04.plain: A human life is like grass or a wildflower: it blooms, then the wind passes over it and it is gone, and even its place forgets it.
bib-psa-012-p04.core_idea: Human life is brief like grass

bib-psa-012-p05.plain: They wandered in the desert, homeless, hungry and thirsty, and their strength failed. Then they cried to God in their trouble, and he rescued them and led them straight to a city to live in.
bib-psa-012-p05.core_idea: Lost and failing, they cried and God led them home

bib-psa-013-p01.plain: Sailors on the great waters see Yahweh's wonders: he commands the storm that tosses them until they reel and lose courage. Then they cry to Yahweh, and he rescues them, calms the storm, and brings them gladly to the harbour they longed for.
bib-psa-013-p01.core_idea: God calms the storm for those who cry out
bib-psa-013-p01.plain_v1: Sailors on the great sea see God's wonders. A storm lifts them high and drops them low until they lose their nerve. They cry to God, and he calms the storm and brings them to the harbour they wanted.

judge_v1.issue: Drops that God himself commands and raises the storm.

bib-psa-013-p02.plain: They answer my love by opposing me, but I keep praying. They have paid me back evil for good and hatred for love.
bib-psa-013-p02.core_idea: Answering hatred for love with prayer

bib-psa-013-p03.plain: My heart is wounded inside me. I am fading like an evening shadow and being shaken off like a locust.

bib-psa-013-p04.plain: For those who are honest, kind, merciful and just, light breaks through even in the darkness.
bib-psa-013-p04.core_idea: Light dawns in darkness for the good

bib-psa-013-p05.plain: Death had hold of me and I was full of sorrow. I called on God, and he saved me. Rest again, my soul: God has been good to you, rescuing you from death, tears and falling.
bib-psa-013-p05.core_idea: God rescued me; my soul can rest again

judge.issue: Drops God's gracious, righteous character and that he preserves the simple.

bib-psa-014-p01.plain: In my distress I called to God, and God answered by setting me free. God is on my side, so I won't be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
bib-psa-014-p01.core_idea: God is on my side; I won't fear

bib-psa-014-p02.plain: The stone the builders threw away has become the most important stone of all. God has done this, and it is wonderful to see. This is the day God has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
bib-psa-014-p02.core_idea: The rejected becomes the cornerstone; rejoice today

bib-psa-014-p03.plain: I am only a visitor on this earth. Don't hide your commands from me, God.
bib-psa-014-p03.core_idea: A stranger on earth needs God's guidance

bib-psa-014-p04.plain: My soul is worn out with sorrow. Give me strength, God, as your word promises.
bib-psa-014-p04.core_idea: Asking God for strength in weary sorrow

bib-psa-014-p05.plain: It was good for me to suffer, because it taught me your laws, God.

bib-psa-014-p06.plain: I have seen that every perfect thing has its limit, but your commands, God, have no limit at all.
bib-psa-014-p06.core_idea: All perfection has limits except God's commands

bib-psa-014-p07.plain: Your word, God, is like a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.

bib-psa-014-p08.plain: I get up before dawn and cry out for help, putting my hope in your words. I stay awake through the night to think about what you have said.
bib-psa-014-p08.core_idea: Hoping in God's word through sleepless nights

bib-psa-015-p01.plain: I have wandered off like a lost sheep. Come looking for me, God, because I have not forgotten your commands.
bib-psa-015-p01.core_idea: A lost sheep asking God to seek it

bib-psa-015-p02.plain: I have lived too long among people who hate peace. I want peace, but whenever I speak, they want war.
bib-psa-015-p02.core_idea: Wanting peace among those who want conflict

bib-psa-015-p03.plain: I look up to the hills and ask where my help comes from. It comes from God, who made heaven and earth. He won't let you stumble, and the one who watches over you never sleeps.
bib-psa-015-p03.core_idea: Help comes from God, who never sleeps

bib-psa-015-p04.plain: Have mercy on us, God, because we have put up with so much contempt. We are sick of the mockery of comfortable, proud people.
bib-psa-015-p04.core_idea: Weary of contempt, asking God for mercy

bib-psa-015-p05.plain: We have escaped like a bird from a hunter's trap. The trap is broken, and we are free.
bib-psa-015-p05.core_idea: Escaped like a bird from a trap

bib-psa-015-p06.plain: Those who plant with tears will harvest with joy. Whoever goes out crying, carrying seed, will surely come back joyful, carrying the harvest.
bib-psa-015-p06.core_idea: Sowing in tears leads to reaping in joy

bib-psa-015-p07.plain: Unless God builds the house, the builders work for nothing; unless God guards the city, the guards watch for nothing. It's pointless to work early and late, because God gives sleep to those he loves.
bib-psa-015-p07.core_idea: Without God, anxious toil is in vain

bib-psa-015-p08.plain: If you kept a record of every wrong, Lord, no one could stand; but you forgive. I wait for God and hope in his word, longing for him more than night watchmen long for morning.
bib-psa-015-p08.core_idea: God forgives, so I wait and hope

judge.issue: Drops 'therefore you are feared': forgiveness leading to reverence.

bib-psa-015-p09.plain: God, I am not proud, and I don't busy myself with matters too great for me. I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child resting with its mother.
bib-psa-015-p09.core_idea: A quiet soul, like a child at rest

bib-psa-015-p10.plain: How good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
bib-psa-015-p10.core_idea: Living in unity is good and pleasant

bib-psa-015-p11.plain: Exiled in Babylon, we sat by the rivers and wept, remembering home, and hung up our harps. Our captors demanded happy songs of Zion. How can we sing God's song in a foreign land?
bib-psa-015-p11.core_idea: How can we sing in exile?

bib-psa-016-p01.plain: Even when I am surrounded by trouble, you will give me new life, God. You will reach out against my angry enemies and save me with your hand.
bib-psa-016-p01.core_idea: In the middle of trouble, God revives me

bib-psa-016-p02.plain: God, you have examined me and you know me. You know when I sit and when I get up, you understand my thoughts from far away, and you know every word before I say it.

bib-psa-016-p03.plain: Where could I go to get away from you, God? Heaven, the grave, the far side of the sea: you are there, guiding and holding me. Even darkness is not dark to you; night shines like day.
bib-psa-016-p03.core_idea: There is nowhere God is not present

bib-psa-016-p04.plain: You shaped my inner being and knit me together in my mother's womb. I thank you, because I am made in an awesome and wonderful way, and I know your works are wonderful.
bib-psa-016-p04.core_idea: I am fearfully and wonderfully made

bib-psa-016-p05.plain: Examine me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my anxious thoughts. See if there is anything wrong in me, and lead me on the everlasting path.
bib-psa-016-p05.core_idea: Asking God to search my heart

judge.issue: Adds 'anxious' to 'my thoughts', which the passage does not say.

bib-psa-016-p06.plain: I cry out to God for mercy and pour out my troubles. When I was overwhelmed, you knew my way. Traps are set for me; no one cares about me, and there is nowhere to hide.
bib-psa-016-p06.core_idea: Alone and uncared for, crying out to God

bib-psa-016-p07.plain: Answer me quickly, God; my spirit is failing. Don't hide from me. Let me hear of your love in the morning, because I trust you, and show me which way to go.
bib-psa-016-p07.core_idea: Failing spirit asks God for love and direction

judge.issue: Drops fear of going down to the pit and 'I lift up my soul to you'.

bib-psa-016-p08.plain: God, what are human beings that you care about them or think of them? A person is like a breath, and their days pass like a shadow.
bib-psa-016-p08.core_idea: Humans are fleeting, yet God cares

bib-psa-016-p09.plain: God holds up everyone who falls and lifts up everyone who is bent low.
bib-psa-016-p09.core_idea: God lifts up those who fall

bib-psa-016-p10.plain: Don't put your trust in rulers; they are only human and cannot save. When their breath leaves, they return to the ground, and on that day their plans come to nothing.

bib-psa-016-p11.plain: God heals people whose hearts are broken and bandages their wounds.

bib-psalm151-001-p01.plain: I was the smallest and youngest of my brothers, a shepherd who made music. The Lord himself heard me, sent his angel, took me from the sheep and anointed me, though my brothers were tall and handsome.
bib-psalm151-001-p01.core_idea: God chose the small one over the impressive

judge.issue: Drops 'the Lord did not take pleasure in them'; the choice is only implied.

bib-revelation-001-p01.plain: You have kept going and endured for my name without growing tired. But I hold this against you: you have abandoned the love you had at first.
bib-revelation-001-p01.core_idea: Endurance without your first love falls short

bib-revelation-001-p02.plain: Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will imprison some of you to test you for a time. Stay faithful even to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
bib-revelation-001-p02.core_idea: Stay faithful through suffering, even to death

judge.issue: 'Ten days' generalised to 'for a time'.

bib-revelation-001-p03.plain: You say you are rich and need nothing, but you don't see that you are wretched, poor, blind and naked. Get true riches, clothing and sight from me instead.
bib-revelation-001-p03.core_idea: Self-satisfied wealth hides real spiritual poverty

judge.issue: Loses gold refined by fire and the shame of nakedness; counsel to buy flattened.

bib-revelation-001-p04.plain: Look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and share a meal with them.
bib-revelation-001-p04.core_idea: Christ knocks; whoever opens will share his company

bib-revelation-002-p01.plain: These are the ones who came through great suffering and were made clean by the Lamb. Now they serve God, sheltered by him; they will never hunger, thirst or burn again, and God will wipe away every tear.
bib-revelation-002-p01.core_idea: After great suffering, God wipes away every tear

judge.issue: Drops standing before the throne and the Lamb shepherding them to springs.

bib-revelation-003-p01.plain: A voice from heaven says that those who die in the Lord from now on are blessed. The Spirit agrees: they will rest from their work, and their deeds go with them.
bib-revelation-003-p01.core_idea: Those who die in the Lord rest

bib-revelation-005-p01.plain: A voice from heaven announces that God will live among people as their God. He will wipe away every tear; there will be no more death, mourning, crying or pain, because the old order is gone.
bib-revelation-005-p01.core_idea: God will end death, mourning and pain

bib-romans-001-p01.plain: You teach others, so why don't you teach yourself? You preach against stealing, but do you steal?
