imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p01.core_idea: Solitude kept faithfully becomes a dear friend

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p02.plain: Craving for pleasure pulls you out, but after an hour you bring home only a burdened conscience and a scattered heart. A merry night makes a sad morning; bodily pleasure starts sweet and ends by eating you away.
imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p02.core_idea: Pleasure-seeking ends in a heavy heart

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p03.plain: You will be miserable anywhere unless you turn to God. Why be upset when things go against your wishes? No one, not even a king or pope, escapes trouble; happiest is whoever can suffer something for God.
imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p03.core_idea: No one escapes trouble; turn to God

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p04.plain: Foolish people envy the rich and powerful, but seen against heaven these things are nothing: uncertain, wearisome and never held without worry. Human happiness lies not in having plenty; a modest share is enough.
imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p04.core_idea: A modest share is enough for happiness

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p05.plain: Don't lose your desire to grow spiritually; there is still time. Why delay? Start now. When you feel troubled you are nearest to blessing. You must go through fire and water, and push yourself, to overcome your faults.

judge.issue: Drops that God brings one through fire and water into a wealthy place.

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p06.plain: How weak people are! Today you confess your sins, tomorrow you repeat them; you resolve and within an hour forget. So we should stay humble, knowing how quickly carelessness can lose what grace and hard work gained.
imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p06.core_idea: Our frailty is reason for humility

imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p07.plain: Your life here ends soon, so consider the next world. People are quickly gone and forgotten. Live each day as if you will die today; a clear conscience removes fear of death. Tomorrow is uncertain, so be ready now.
imitation-of-christ-benham-004-p07.core_idea: Live each day as if it were your last

judge.issue: Drops that watching against sin is better than fleeing death.

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p01.plain: The patient person purifies the soul even on earth: grieving more for the wrongdoer's malice than his own hurt, praying for and forgiving those who mistreat him, quick to apologise, quicker to pity than to anger, and mastering the flesh.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p01.core_idea: Patience under injury purifies the soul

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p02.plain: An anxious man prayed to know whether he would persevere. God asked him what he would do if he knew, and told him to do it now. Comforted, he stopped prying into the future and sought God's will.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p02.core_idea: Do now what you would do if you knew

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p03.plain: Fear of difficulty holds many back from growth. But those who make the most progress are the ones who bravely fight what is hardest for them; a person gains most where he most overcomes himself.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p03.core_idea: Growth comes from overcoming what is hardest

judge.issue: Drops meriting greater grace and mortifying oneself in spirit.

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p04.plain: Two things most help growth in holiness: firmly pulling away from the sin you are most drawn to, and eagerly pursuing the good you most lack. Also guard hard against the faults that most annoy you in others.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p04.core_idea: Fight your main weakness, pursue your main lack

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p05.plain: The earnest person bears whatever comes. The careless and lukewarm suffer trouble on every side, lacking inner comfort. Living without discipline invites ruin, and whoever looks for an easier discipline will always be unhappy.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p05.core_idea: Earnest discipline bears all; laxity brings distress

judge.issue: Drops that the lukewarm are forbidden to seek outward comfort.

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p06.plain: When a person no longer seeks comfort in any created thing, he begins to enjoy God fully and is content with whatever happens, neither overjoyed by much nor grieved by little, trusting wholly in God, in whom all things live.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p06.core_idea: Seek comfort in God alone and be content

imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p07.plain: Remember your end, and that lost time never returns. Virtue needs effort; grow cold and things go badly, be zealous and find peace. Neglect small faults and you slide into greater ones. Watch yourself, whatever others do.
imitation-of-christ-benham-005-p07.core_idea: Lost time never returns; tend your own soul

judge.issue: Drops that labour grows lighter through God's grace; several secondary sayings cut.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p01.plain: Don't put much trust in any mortal, however dear, or grieve much when they oppose you; people who are with you today may turn against you tomorrow. Trust God completely; He will answer for you and do what is best.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p01.core_idea: People change; put your whole trust in God

judge.issue: Drops "let Him be thy fear and thy love".

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p02.plain: Christ was despised and abandoned by his friends, yet you complain? He had enemies, and you want everyone on your side? Without adversity patience earns no crown. To share Christ's reign, endure with Him and for Him.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p02.core_idea: Christ suffered rejection; do not expect less

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p03.plain: The wise see things as they are, not as they seem. Someone who lives from within and values outward things little needs no special place or time for God, adapts to events, and isn't troubled by others' odd behaviour.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p03.core_idea: Live from within, unmoved by outward things

judge.issue: Drops that the wise are taught of God more than of men.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p04.plain: Don't worry about who is for or against you; do the duty in front of you and keep God with you. Keep a good conscience and God will defend you. Be quiet and endure, and you will see His help.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p04.core_idea: Do your duty; God defends a good conscience

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p05.plain: Be at peace yourself first; then you can bring peace to others. A peaceful person does more good than a learned one; a restless one suspects everyone and disturbs everyone. Correct yourself before correcting your neighbour.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p05.core_idea: Be at peace yourself before making peace

judge.issue: Drops that the passionate turn good to evil while the peaceable turn all to good.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p06.plain: You excuse yourself but not others; the reverse would be fairer. If you want others to bear with you, bear with them. Getting along with gentle people is easy; living peacefully with difficult ones is a great grace.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p06.core_idea: Excuse others as readily as yourself

judge.issue: Drops the rebuke about true charity and humility being angry only at oneself.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p07.plain: Some keep peace within and with others; some have none and give none, troubling others but themselves most. Yet all our peace here lies in humble suffering, not in escaping hardship. Whoever suffers best has most peace: master of himself, lord of the world, Christ's friend and heir of heaven.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p07.core_idea: Peace lies in humble suffering, not avoiding hardship
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p07.plain_v1: Some keep peace in themselves and with others; some have no peace and give none, troubling themselves most. But our peace in this life lies in suffering humbly, not in avoiding hardship; whoever suffers best has the most peace.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the closing promise: conqueror of self, friend of Christ, inheritor of heaven.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the peacemakers and the sufferer as conqueror, lord, friend of Christ.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p08.plain: If you were pure inside, you would see everything rightly and unharmed. A pure heart sees into heaven and hell; we judge outwardly as we are inwardly. The pure have joy; the bad conscience knows anguish best. As fire cleans rusty iron, turning wholly to God makes a person new.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p08.core_idea: As we are inside, so we see outside
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p08.plain_v1: If you were pure inside, you would see everything rightly; we judge outwardly as we are inwardly. The pure in heart have the world's joy. As fire burns rust off iron, turning wholly to God makes you new.

judge_v1.issue: Drops that a pure heart sees heaven and hell and that evil conscience knows anguish best.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the evil conscience knowing anguish and seeing heaven and hell.

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p09.plain: When someone grows lukewarm, small efforts scare him and he grabs at outward comforts; when he truly starts mastering himself and following God, things that once seemed so hard count for nothing.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p09.core_idea: Self-mastery makes hard things seem light

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p10.plain: We can't trust ourselves too little; our light is small and easily lost. We excuse our wrongs, call passion zeal, and blame small faults in others while ignoring big ones in ourselves. Self-knowledge stops harsh judgment.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p10.core_idea: Knowing our faults stops us judging others

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p11.plain: A spiritual person cares first for his own soul and stays quiet about others. Think wholly on yourself and God, and outside things will move you little. Where are you when absent from yourself? For peace, attend to yourself.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p11.core_idea: Attend to your own soul, not others' affairs

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p12.plain: A good conscience is a good person's glory and brings lasting joy. It can bear a great deal and stays glad in hardship, while a bad conscience is always afraid. You sleep well when your heart doesn't accuse you.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p12.core_idea: A good conscience brings joy even in hardship

judge.issue: Drops "Never rejoice unless when thou hast done well."

imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p13.plain: Human praise is brief and brings sadness with it. Good people find their glory in conscience and their joy in God and truth. Whoever cares for neither praise nor blame has great peace of heart.
imitation-of-christ-benham-006-p13.core_idea: Indifference to praise and blame brings peace

judge.issue: Drops that seeking temporal glory shows little love for the heavenly.

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p01.plain: A pure conscience brings peace. Praise doesn't make you holier nor blame worse; you are what God judges you to be. People see deeds, God sees intent. A humble spirit always does well and thinks little of itself; seeking no comfort from created things shows great purity and faithfulness.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p01.core_idea: You are what you are in God's sight
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p01.plain_v1: A pure conscience is easily content. Praise doesn't make you holier, nor blame worse; you are what you are, and no better than God says. People see the outside and the deed, but God sees the heart and the intention.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the closing ideas on humility and not seeking consolation from created things.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the humble spirit and seeking no comfort from created things.

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p02.plain: Blessed is whoever knows what it is to love Jesus and despise himself for his sake, giving up all he loves, for Jesus must be loved above all. Love of created things fails; his lasts. He won't abandon you when all leave you, as one day they must.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p02.core_idea: Jesus stays when all others leave

judge.issue: Drops the command to hold Jesus as friend and the promise not to let you perish.

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p02.plain_v1: Blessed is whoever knows what it is to love Jesus above all. Love of created things is unstable and makes you fall; love of Jesus is faithful. Hold Him as your friend; He stays when everyone leaves.

judge_v1.issue: Softens: drops despising oneself for Jesus and giving up all one loves; drops final separation.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops despising oneself, giving up all, and the inevitable separation from all.

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p03.plain: Bring God a free, bare heart; only His grace unites you to Him. With grace you can do anything; without it you are weak. Don't despair then, but rest in God's will: after winter comes summer, after storm, calm.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p03.core_idea: After winter summer; after storm, calm

judge.issue: Drops bearing all things to the praise of Jesus Christ.

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p04.plain: We grab at any comfort. For love of Christ, Saint Laurence calmly let his beloved bishop Sixtus be taken from him. Learn likewise to give up a dear friend for God, and don't resent being left; all must part.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p04.core_idea: Let friends go; all must part at last

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p05.plain: When comfort is taken away, don't despair; wait humbly and patiently for God to return, since He can give back even more. This is familiar to those on God's way; the saints and prophets often went through it.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p05.core_idea: When comfort leaves, wait patiently for its return

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p06.plain: I have never met anyone so devout that he didn't sometimes feel God's favour withdraw and his fervour fade. No saint was ever so enlightened that he was not tempted sooner or later.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p06.core_idea: Even saints feel God withdraw sometimes

imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p07.plain: Why look for rest when you were born to work? Prepare yourself for patience more than comfort, and for carrying the cross more than for joy.
imitation-of-christ-benham-007-p07.core_idea: Prepare for patience more than comfort

imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p01.plain: Be thankful for the smallest blessing and you will be worthy of greater ones. Treat the least gift as if it were the greatest, and something of little account as a special present.
imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p01.core_idea: Gratitude for small gifts opens the way to more

imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p02.plain: At times God will forsake you, others will try you and you will weary yourself; you must bear it as long as God wills and be humbled. Only sufferers truly grasp Christ's Passion. The Cross awaits everywhere, for you carry yourself; patience brings inner peace and the everlasting crown.
imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p02.core_idea: The Cross is everywhere; patience brings peace
imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p02.plain_v1: At times God seems absent, others try you, and you tire of yourself, with no relief but to bear it as God wills. You can't escape the Cross, since you take yourself everywhere; you need patience for inner peace.

judge_v1.issue: "Forsaken of God" softened to "God seems absent"; drops Christ's Passion and the everlasting crown.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops suffering as God's way to humility, understanding the Passion, and the everlasting crown.

imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p03.plain: Carry your cross willingly and it will carry you to where suffering ends, though not in this life. Carry it unwillingly and it gets heavier, yet you must still carry it. Drop one and you'll find another, perhaps heavier.
imitation-of-christ-benham-008-p03.core_idea: Carry your cross willingly and it carries you

imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p01.plain: People travel far for a small reward but will hardly lift a foot for eternal life. They fight shamefully over a coin and toil day and night for empty things and flimsy promises.
imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p01.core_idea: We work hard for trifles, little for eternity

imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p02.plain: A prayer: Lord, how can I bear this hard life without Your mercy? Don't hide Your face or withhold Your comfort. Teach me to do Your will humbly, for You know me truly, and knew me before I was born.
imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p02.core_idea: Without God's grace, life is unbearable

judge.issue: Drops "Thou art my wisdom" and walking uprightly before God.

imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p03.plain: Love is the greatest good: it alone makes heavy burdens light and bitter things sweet. Love of Jesus drives to great works and seeks freedom from worldly ties. Nothing is sweeter or stronger, for love is born of God.

judge.issue: Drops that love cannot rest save in God above all created things.

imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p04.plain: The one who loves flies, runs and rejoices, free, resting in God, the source of all good. Love knows no measure, feels no burden, counts no labour, and tries more than it can, succeeding where the loveless give up.
imitation-of-christ-benham-009-p04.core_idea: Love feels no burden and attempts the impossible

judge.issue: Drops giving all for all and turning from gifts to the Giver.

imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p01.plain: Love is swift, sincere, gentle, strong, patient, faithful and never selfish; seeking your own is falling from love. It is humble, steady, chaste, obedient to authority, lowly in its own eyes, grateful to God and trusting him even when he hides his face, for love cannot live without sorrow.
imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p01.core_idea: True love is selfless and trusts through sorrow
imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p01.plain_v1: Love is quick, sincere, gentle, strong, patient, faithful and never selfish; seeking your own is falling from love. It is humble, steady and grateful to God, trusting Him even when He hides, for love cannot live without sorrow.

judge_v1.issue: Drops love's obedience to authority and being vile and lowly in its own sight.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops obedience to authority and being lowly in one's own sight.

imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p02.plain: God speaks: fight like a good soldier, and if you sometimes fail through weakness, take up your strength more bravely, trusting in My greater grace; and beware of false confidence and pride.
imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p02.core_idea: After failure, rise braver, trusting grace

imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p03.plain: Those wise in their own eyes rarely accept being guided. A little wisdom with humility is better than great learning with vanity. It is better for you to have less of anything that might make you proud.
imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p03.core_idea: Humble little wisdom beats proud great learning

imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p04.plain: God speaks: whoever is overconfident in peace will be fearful in war. Stay humble. When fervour burns, think how it will be when the light goes; when it goes, remember it may return. Such trials help more than constant success.
imitation-of-christ-benham-010-p04.core_idea: In good times, prepare for the light to fade

judge.issue: Drops that God takes the light away as a warning and for His glory.

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p01.plain: God speaks: don't chase a desire too hard without consulting Me, or you may regret it. Not every good-seeming feeling should be followed at once. Even good desires sometimes need restraint, lest they distract you or trouble others.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p01.core_idea: Even good desires sometimes need restraint

judge.issue: Drops being disturbed by others' resistance; stumbling-block softened to "trouble others".

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p02.plain: Lord, I need patience; however I plan for peace, life brings strife. God answers: I don't want you seeking a peace free of trials; count yourself at peace when you are tested by many troubles.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p02.core_idea: True peace is found amid trials

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p03.plain: The rich of this world will vanish like smoke, and no trace of their pleasures will remain. Even while alive they are never free of bitterness, weariness and fear.

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p04.plain: An old habit will resist, but a better habit will overcome it. The body will complain again and again, but a fervent spirit will hold it in check.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p04.core_idea: A better habit overcomes an old one

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p05.plain: If you are not led by the Spirit, there is no worse or deadlier enemy to your soul than you yourself.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p05.core_idea: Without the Spirit, you are your worst enemy

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p06.plain: Lord, without Your hand there is no holiness, wisdom, strength or purity. Left alone we sink and perish; visited by You we rise and live. We are unstable and grow cold, but You strengthen us and rekindle us.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p06.core_idea: Without God we fall; with Him we rise

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p07.plain: Someone humbled by Truth will not be puffed up by the whole world, nor swayed by everyone's praise if his hope is in God. Those who praise are nothing; they fade with their words, but the Lord's truth lasts forever.

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p08.plain: God speaks: whatever you desire, seek it humbly and in awe of God, and hand it all over to Me, saying: Lord, You know what is best; give what and when You will; I am Your servant, living for You.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p08.core_idea: Lord, You know best; Your will be done

judge.issue: Shortens the prayer of surrender; drops "place me where Thou wilt" and the closing plea.

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p09.plain: A prayer: above everything I could want, let me rest in You and let my heart be at peace in You. You alone are the heart's true peace and rest; without You everything is hard and restless.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p09.core_idea: God alone is the heart's true rest

imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p10.plain: Want present things too much and you lose eternal ones. Use temporal things, but desire eternal ones. No earthly good can satisfy you, because you weren't made to enjoy these.
imitation-of-christ-benham-011-p10.core_idea: Use earthly things; desire eternal ones

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p01.plain: All human comfort is empty and brief; the comfort that is blessed and real is felt inside and comes from the truth.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p01.core_idea: Real comfort comes from within, from truth

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p02.plain: Lord, Your care for me exceeds any I can give myself. As long as my will stays firm in You, do with me what You will, for it can only be good. Blessed be You whether You leave me in darkness or light, comfort me or cause me trouble.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p02.core_idea: Blessed be God in light and darkness alike
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p02.plain_v1: Lord, You care for me more than I can for myself; whoever doesn't give You his worries stands insecurely. While my will rests in You, do as You wish; it can only be good. Blessed be You, dark or light.

judge_v1.issue: Softens: drops blessing God for causing trouble, reducing it to "dark or light".

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops blessing God whether He comforts or troubles.

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p03.plain: Your suffering is small next to those who have been far more tempted and tried. Remember their pains to bear yours more easily; if yours don't seem small, impatience may be the cause. Big or small, bear them patiently.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p03.core_idea: Recall others' greater sufferings to bear your own

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p04.plain: Someone isn't truly patient who suffers only what he thinks fair and from whom he chooses. The truly patient person accepts every hardship, from anyone, gratefully as from God, since nothing borne for God, however small, loses its reward.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p04.core_idea: True patience accepts hardship from anyone

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p05.plain: Be ready to fight if you want to win. Without struggle there is no crown of patience; refuse to suffer and you refuse the crown. So strive bravely and endure patiently. No rest without labour, no victory without fighting.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p05.core_idea: No victory without struggle, no rest without labour

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p06.plain: A prayer: Lord, by Your grace make possible for me what seems impossible by nature. You know how little I can bear and how quickly I am knocked down when trouble comes.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p06.core_idea: Grace makes possible what nature cannot

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p07.plain: Lord, I confess my weakness. Small things often knock me down and make me sad. I resolve to be brave, but a little temptation throws me into crisis; just when I feel safe, a puff of wind nearly overcomes me.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p07.core_idea: Small things easily overthrow our resolve

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p08.plain: Lord, what keeps setting me back is how easily I fall and how weakly I resist my passions. Their attacks are violent, and living in daily conflict wears me out. Hateful thoughts rush in far more easily than they leave.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p08.core_idea: Bad thoughts enter easily and leave slowly

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p09.plain: What a life this is, where troubles never stop and everything is full of traps and enemies; when one trouble or temptation goes, another comes, and while one battle still rages, more arrive unexpectedly.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p09.core_idea: In this life troubles never cease

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p10.plain: A prayer to Jesus: before You I have no words, and my silence speaks. How long until You come? Come, for without You no day is joyful. I feel imprisoned until Your presence refreshes and frees me.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p10.core_idea: Without Jesus no day is joyful

judge.issue: Drops plea for deliverance from snares and "Thou art my joy".

imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p11.plain: God speaks: Here I am; I come to you because you called Me. Your tears, your longing, your humility and sorrow of heart have drawn Me to you.
imitation-of-christ-benham-012-p11.core_idea: God comes to the humble who call

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p01.plain: Whoever has fewer gifts shouldn't be downcast or envious, but look to You and praise Your goodness, for You give freely to all. Everything comes from You, so You are praised in all. Why one has less and another more is Yours to know, for You know what each deserves.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p01.core_idea: Don't envy others' gifts; God knows best
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p01.plain_v1: Someone given fewer gifts shouldn't be downcast or envy those given more, but praise God's generous goodness, the source of everything. God knows what is best for each; why one has less and another more is His to understand.

judge_v1.issue: Passage addressed to God ("Thee") recast as speech about God; drops God knowing each one's deserving.

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p02.plain: God speaks: try to do another's will rather than your own. Always choose less rather than more, seek the lowest place, and pray that God's will be done in you. Such a person enters into peace and quiet.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p02.core_idea: Choose less and the lowest place for peace

judge.issue: Drops "be subject to all".

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p03.plain: A prayer: Lord my God, don't stay far from me; hurry to help me, for many thoughts and great fears have risen against me and torment my soul. How will I get through them unharmed?
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p03.core_idea: A plea to God amid fears

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p04.plain: A prayer: Jesus, light up my heart and drive out its darkness. Calm my wandering thoughts and take away harmful temptations, so my conscience may have peace. Tell the wind and sea to be still, and there will be calm.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p04.core_idea: Ask Jesus to calm the storm within

judge.issue: Drops driving out "alluring lusts" and the praise within God's palaces.

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p05.plain: A prayer: draw me away from the unstable comforts of created things, for none can satisfy me. Bind me to You with unbreakable love, since You alone are enough for whoever loves You; without You everything is empty toys.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p05.core_idea: God alone satisfies; all else is empty

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p06.plain: God speaks: don't be nosy or fret over useless worries. What is that to you? Follow Me. Why should it matter what someone else is, says or does? You don't answer for others, only for yourself, so why get entangled?

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p07.plain: Don't trouble yourself about fame, having many friends, or being loved by people. These things bring distraction and great sorrow of heart.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p07.core_idea: Fame and popularity bring distraction and sorrow

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p08.plain: God speaks: everyone wants peace, but not everyone cares about what true peace requires. My peace is with the humble and lowly in heart. Your peace will lie in much patience.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p08.core_idea: Peace belongs to the humble and patient

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p09.plain: Never feeling unease or pain belongs to eternal rest, not this life. So don't think you've found true peace just because you feel no grief, have no opponent, or everything goes your way.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p09.core_idea: Peace is not the absence of trouble

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p10.plain: Lord, the mark of a perfect person is to keep the mind on heavenly things and pass through many cares as if free of care, not out of indifference but with a free mind, clinging to nothing with excessive attachment.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p10.core_idea: Pass through cares with a free mind

imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p11.plain: God speaks: self-love harms you more than anything in the world. Things cling to you as your love clings to them; pure love leaves you captive to nothing. Don't covet what you can't have or keep what robs your freedom.
imitation-of-christ-benham-013-p11.core_idea: Self-love harms you more than anything

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p01.plain: God speaks: why wear yourself out with useless sorrow and worry? Rest in My will and you lose nothing. Chase things for your own advantage or pleasure and you will never have peace; something will always be lacking.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p01.core_idea: Chasing your own wishes never brings peace

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p02.plain: A place helps little without devotion, and peace sought outside won't last if your heart isn't grounded in God. You can change where you are, but not make yourself better that way; you'll meet what you fled, and more.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p02.core_idea: Changing places won't change your heart

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p03.plain: God speaks: if you live inwardly, you won't give passing words more weight than they deserve. It is real wisdom to stay silent in bad times, turn inward to Me, and not be troubled by people's judgment.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p03.core_idea: Keep silent and turn inward when judged

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p04.plain: Don't let your peace depend on what people say; good or bad, their opinion doesn't change who you are. True peace is in God. Whoever neither seeks to please people nor fears displeasing them will have great peace.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p04.core_idea: Don't let your peace depend on others' words

judge.issue: Drops that disquiet of heart arises from inordinate love and vain fear.

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p05.plain: A prayer: Lord, I am in trouble and caught in snares. Save me from this hour, though I came to it so You may be glorified. Without You where can I go? Give me patience again, and I won't fear.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p05.core_idea: In trouble, ask God for patience

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p06.plain: God speaks: My child, I am a stronghold when trouble comes. Come to Me when things are not well with you.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p06.core_idea: Turn to God when things go wrong

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p07.plain: God speaks: what most blocks comfort is being slow to pray. You first try outward comforts, which help little, until you learn that I deliver those who trust Me; apart from Me there is no strong help or lasting remedy.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p07.core_idea: Turn to prayer first, not last

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p08.plain: God speaks: stand firm and persevere; comfort will come in its time. Wait for Me; I will come and heal you. What troubles you is temptation and empty fear. Worrying about the future only adds sorrow to sorrow.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p08.core_idea: Wait patiently; don't worry about tomorrow

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p09.plain: God speaks: don't let your heart be troubled or afraid; trust My mercy. When you feel far from Me, I am often nearest. When all seems lost, gain is often close. Don't judge by present feelings or give up hope.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p09.core_idea: When all seems lost, God is often near

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p10.plain: God speaks: don't think yourself abandoned when I send trouble or take away a comfort you love; this is the way to heaven. It is better for you to be tested by hardship than to get everything you want.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p10.core_idea: Hardship is not abandonment by God

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p11.plain: What is more peaceful than a single-minded heart, and who is freer than the one who wants nothing on earth?
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p11.core_idea: Wanting nothing on earth brings freedom

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p12.plain: We ask what someone has achieved, rich, strong, clever, talented, but rarely how humble, patient, gentle or devout they are. Human nature looks at the outside and often misjudges; grace looks to the heart and trusts God.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p12.core_idea: We judge by achievements; grace looks at the heart

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p13.plain: God speaks: you can't be fully free without denying yourself. The rich, the selfish and the restless are slaves, and what isn't from God will perish. Give up everything and you find everything; give up craving and you find rest.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p13.core_idea: Give up craving and you will find rest

judge.issue: Drops "not after the things of Jesus Christ" and the call to dwell on the saying.

imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p14.plain: God speaks: don't be put off or discouraged when you hear what the perfect way demands. Let it spur you to higher aims, or at least to long for that desire.
imitation-of-christ-benham-014-p14.core_idea: High ideals should inspire, not discourage

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p01.plain: God speaks: don't trust your feelings; they change quickly, joyful then sad, calm then anxious, devout then careless. The wise rise above these moods, keeping their aim fixed on God, so they stay steady through all the world's changes.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p01.core_idea: Moods change; keep your aim fixed on God

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p02.plain: My God, my all! For those who understand, those words are enough. When You are present everything is pleasant; when You are absent everything is tiresome. You give the heart rest, deep peace and festive joy.

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p03.plain: If you look for rest in this life, how will you reach eternal rest? Aim not for much rest but for much patience. Seek true peace not on earth, in people or in things, but in God alone.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p03.core_idea: Seek patience, not rest; peace in God alone

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p04.plain: Do you expect spiritual comfort at will? My saints had grief and desolation instead, yet bore it patiently, trusting God, knowing present suffering is nothing beside the coming glory. Wait for the Lord, be strong, devote yourself to God's glory; I will reward you richly and stand by you.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p04.core_idea: Saints endured desolation; wait for the Lord
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p04.plain_v1: God speaks: do you expect spiritual comfort whenever you want? My saints had grief and desolation instead, yet bore it patiently and trusted God. Don't demand at once what others won through tears. Wait, be strong; I am with you.

judge_v1.issue: Drops future glory outweighing present suffering, devotion to God's glory, and the promised reward.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops the coming glory and devoting body and soul to God's glory.

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p05.plain: God speaks: anchor your soul in God and don't fear people's judgment when your conscience says you are innocent. Such suffering is good for a humble heart. People's opinions vary, so trust them little; you can't please everyone anyway.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p05.core_idea: Anchor in God; you cannot please everyone

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p06.plain: Why fear a mortal who is here today and gone tomorrow? Fear God and you won't cower before people's threats. What can anyone do to you by word or deed? He harms himself more, and won't escape God's judgment.

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p07.plain: God speaks: lose yourself and you will find Me. Stand still, without choosing or thinking of yourself, and you will always gain. More grace comes the moment you give yourself up, as long as you don't take yourself back.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p07.core_idea: Lose yourself and you will find God

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p08.plain: God speaks: give yourself up and you will have great inner peace. Give all for all, ask nothing back, rest simply in Me. Let go of self and follow Jesus; then vain fancies, needless worries and excessive fear will vanish.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p08.core_idea: Surrender yourself and find inner peace

judge.issue: Drops dying to self to live eternally to God, and following Jesus "made naked for thee".

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p09.plain: A prayer: Lord, I gladly hand everything over to You, since my planning helps little. If only I didn't dwell so much on the future, but gave myself wholly to Your will at once.
imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p09.core_idea: Hand plans to God; stop dwelling on the future

imitation-of-christ-benham-015-p10.plain: God speaks: people often chase something hard, then lose interest once they have it, because desires don't last but jump from one thing to the next. So resisting yourself even in small things is no small matter.

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p01.plain: Vanity is a terrible plague, the greatest of vanities, because it pulls us from true glory and robs us of God's grace. While a person pleases himself he displeases God; while he craves praise, he loses real virtue.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p01.core_idea: Craving praise robs us of true virtue

judge.issue: "Displeaseth Thee" addressed to God becomes "displeases God".

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p02.plain: God speaks: don't let it concern you if others are honoured and you are looked down on. Lift your heart to Me in heaven, and people's contempt on earth won't make you sad.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p02.core_idea: Lift your heart above others' contempt

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p03.plain: God speaks: if your peace rests on a person you admire, you'll be unstable. Rest in lasting Truth and a friend's leaving or death won't crush you. Love friends in and for God; without Him friendship has no lasting strength.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p03.core_idea: Ground friendship in God, not in the friend

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p04.plain: Let many things pass unheard and think about what brings you peace. Better to look away from what displeases you and let others keep their opinions than to argue. If you stand well with God, losing an argument is easy.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p04.core_idea: Let others keep their opinions; avoid strife

judge.issue: "Bear to be as one conquered" narrowed to losing an argument.

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p05.plain: Lord, what have we come to? We mourn worldly losses and rush after small gains, yet forget spiritual losses. We tend what matters little and neglect what is essential, because we slide toward outward things and settle there.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p05.core_idea: We mourn small losses and forget spiritual ones

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p06.plain: Lord, help me in trouble, for human help is useless. I often found no loyalty where I expected it, and found it where I didn't. Hope in people is vain; salvation is in You. We are weak and easily deceived.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p06.core_idea: Human help fails; hope rests in God

judge.issue: Drops "Blessed be thou, O Lord, in all things which happen unto us".

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p07.plain: A friend who stays loyal through all your troubles is rare. You alone, Lord, are faithful in everything, and there is no one like You.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p07.core_idea: Loyal friends are rare; God is faithful

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p08.plain: Someone says, 'Keep this secret,' then can't keep it himself and betrays us both. Lord, protect me from such reckless gossips and keep me from doing the same. What I wouldn't want done to me, I must not do.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p08.core_idea: Don't do what you would not want done

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p09.plain: How good and peaceful it is not to talk about others, not to believe or spread every rumour, to open up to few, to keep God as your heart's witness, and not be blown about by every wind of words.

judge.issue: Drops desiring all be done by God's will; address to God shifted to third person.

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p10.plain: God speaks: stand firm and trust Me. What are words but words? They fly through the air but bruise no stone. If you are guilty, think how to improve; if your conscience is clear, bear it gladly for God.
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p10.core_idea: Words fly by but bruise no stone

imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p11.plain: God speaks: listen to My word and you won't care about ten thousand human words. Even if the worst malice said everything against you, what harm if you let it go like dust? Could it touch one hair?
imitation-of-christ-benham-016-p11.core_idea: Malicious words cannot truly harm you

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p01.plain: No evil comes to the just, whatever God sends them. Even if falsely accused, they care little; and if others clear their name, they don't celebrate too much.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p01.core_idea: The just stay steady when accused or cleared

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p02.plain: God speaks: don't let your work for Me break you or troubles cast you down; let My promise comfort you. I can reward you beyond measure. You won't labour or grieve forever; wait a little and your troubles will end.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p02.core_idea: Troubles are brief; wait a little longer

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p03.plain: God speaks: do whatever you do wholeheartedly; work faithfully in My vineyard and I will be your reward. Write, read, sing, weep, keep silent, pray, bear hardship bravely; eternal life is worth all these struggles and more.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p03.core_idea: Work wholeheartedly; eternal life is worth it

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p04.plain: The days of this life are few and hard, full of sorrow: people are stained by sin, trapped by passions, bound by fears, worn by cares and labour, weighed down by temptation, weakened by pleasure, tormented by poverty.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p04.core_idea: Life's days are few and full of burdens

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p05.plain: Lord, I long to know You closely but can't; worldly things and untamed passions drag me down. My mind wants to rise above everything, my body pulls me under, so I fight myself and become a burden to myself.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p05.core_idea: Spirit rises, flesh pulls down; I fight myself

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p06.plain: Often I'm not really where my body stands or sits, but wherever my thoughts carry me. Where my thought is, there I am, and my thought is usually where what I love is, drawn by delight or habit.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p06.core_idea: You are where your thoughts are

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p07.plain: As Christ said, where your treasure is, your heart will be. If I love heaven, I think of heavenly things; if I love the world, its pleasures and troubles move me. Whatever I love fills my talk and my thoughts.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p07.core_idea: Where your treasure is, your heart is

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p08.plain: God speaks: a fire often burns, but its flame rises with smoke. Some people's longing for heaven burns, yet bodily desire still clings to it, so their prayer isn't purely for God. Yours is often like that, tainted by self-seeking.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p08.core_idea: Even earnest devotion carries some self-seeking

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p09.plain: God speaks: you will often have to do what you don't want and leave undone what you do. Others will succeed, be heard, get what they ask and be praised; you won't, and you'll be thought useless.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p09.core_idea: Others will be favoured while you are passed over

imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p10.plain: God speaks: hardly anything requires more self-denial than facing what goes against your will, especially orders that seem pointless. Because you are under authority and can't resist, it feels hard to follow another's direction and give up your own opinion.
imitation-of-christ-benham-017-p10.core_idea: Obeying against your own opinion is hard

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p01.plain: A prayer: I long for the peace You give Your children. If You give peace and joy, my soul will sing Your praise. But when You withdraw, as You often do, I falter and beat my breast.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p01.core_idea: When God withdraws, peace and joy fade

judge.issue: Drops failing to run in God's commandments and the memory of former light.

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p02.plain: Lord, it was good for me to be in trouble, so I could learn Your ways and drop my pride. It helped me to be put to shame, so I would look to You for comfort rather than to people.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p02.core_idea: Trouble and shame turn us toward God

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p03.plain: A prayer: Lord, let me know what should be known, love what should be loved, and value what You value. Don't let me judge by appearances or ignorant talk, but discern truly between visible and spiritual things.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p03.core_idea: Grant me to judge as God judges

judge.issue: Drops the closing plea to seek God's will above all things.

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p04.plain: Our senses often misjudge, and worldly people love only what they see. Is anyone better because people think him great? The vain and blind praise each other foolishly. As Saint Francis said, you are what you are in God's eyes.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p04.core_idea: You are what you are in God's eyes

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p05.plain: God speaks: you can't always stay in fervent desire for virtue or high contemplation; your fallen nature means you must sometimes come down to lower things. While you have a mortal body, you will feel weariness and heaviness of heart.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p05.core_idea: In a mortal body, weariness is unavoidable

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p06.plain: What do You ask of a guilty sinner above all, but sorrow and humility for his sins? True contrition brings hope of pardon, a reconciled conscience, recovered grace and escape from the wrath to come, as God and the penitent soul hurry to meet with a holy kiss.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p06.core_idea: Humble sorrow brings God and sinner together
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p06.plain_v1: What does God ask of a guilty sinner but sorrow and humility? From true sorrow and humility come hope of pardon, a reconciled conscience and recovered grace, and God and the repentant soul hurry to meet each other.

judge_v1.issue: Question addressed to God recast as about God; drops preservation from wrath to come and the holy kiss.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops preservation from the wrath to come.

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p07.plain: God speaks: if you fully conquer yourself, you'll easily master everything else. The perfect victory is over yourself. Whoever keeps his desires obedient to reason, and his reason obedient to Me, truly rules himself and the world.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p07.core_idea: The perfect victory is over oneself

imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p08.plain: Nature works for its own advantage and looks for what it can gain from others; Grace looks not at what is useful to itself but at what will benefit many.
imitation-of-christ-benham-018-p08.core_idea: Nature seeks self; grace seeks the good of many

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p01.plain: Nature cares for passing things, delights in money, is saddened by loss and stung by any hurtful word. Grace reaches for eternal things, isn't upset by losses or embittered by harsh words, because its treasure and joy are in heaven.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p01.core_idea: Grace is unshaken by loss and harsh words

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p02.plain: Nature is greedy, likes receiving more than giving, and loves what is private to itself; Grace is kind and generous, avoids selfishness, is content with little, and believes it is more blessed to give than to receive.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p02.core_idea: Grace finds more blessing in giving

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p03.plain: So I want to do good but can't do it. I plan good things, but without grace I give up at the slightest resistance. I see clearly what I should do, yet my corruption keeps me from rising to it.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p03.core_idea: I see the good but fail to do it

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p04.plain: God speaks: as far as you go out of yourself, so far can you enter into Me. Wanting nothing outward brings inner peace; letting go of self unites you with God. Learn full self-denial, living in My will without complaint.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p04.core_idea: Leave yourself to enter into God

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p05.plain: Truly the life of a devoted servant is a cross, but it leads to paradise. I have started; I may not turn back or give it up.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p05.core_idea: The cross leads to paradise; don't turn back

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p06.plain: God speaks: patience and humility in hardship please Me more than comfort in good times. Why does a small criticism upset you? Let it pass; it won't be the last. You give good advice until trouble knocks at your door.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p06.core_idea: Patience in hardship outweighs comfort in ease

judge.issue: Drops that even greater wrongs should not move you, and bravery only absent adversity.

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p07.plain: God speaks: if you can't bear it joyfully, at least bear it patiently. Even if angry, hold back hasty words that could hurt others. The storm will soon calm and grace will sweeten your grief. Trust and call on Me.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p07.core_idea: Bear patiently if not joyfully; the storm will pass

judge.issue: Drops the Lord's promise to help and give more than usual consolation.

imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p08.plain: Stay calm and prepare to endure; being often troubled or tempted does not mean all is lost. You are human, not God or an angel. God lifts up mourners and those who know their weakness.
imitation-of-christ-benham-019-p08.core_idea: Being human, you will falter; God raises the humble

judge.issue: Drops the fallen angel and Adam argument and "raise to my own nature"; God's first-person voice shifted.

imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p01.plain: Do not argue about God's hidden judgments, such as why one person is favoured or afflicted and another raised up. These things are beyond human judgment, and no reasoning can search them out.
imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p01.core_idea: God's judgments are beyond human reasoning

imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p02.plain: Lord, my trust and comfort is You, whose mercies are endless. When was I well without You, or harmed with You near? I'd rather be poor or a pilgrim with You than rich, or in heaven, without You. Where You are is heaven; where You aren't, death and hell.
imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p02.core_idea: With God is heaven; without God is hell
imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p02.plain_v1: Speaking to God: You are my only real comfort. I would rather be poor with You than rich without You, a wanderer with You than in heaven without You. Where You are is heaven.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the hard saying "where Thou art not, there death and hell".

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops 'where You are not, there is death and hell' and his endless mercies.

imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p03.plain: Speaking to God: I put all my hope and troubles in You, because everything else is weak. Friends, helpers, advisers, books, wealth and safe places are all useless unless You yourself help and comfort.
imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p03.core_idea: Without God, no earthly help can truly help

imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p04.plain: The Lord says: come to me, all of you who are worn out and weighed down, and I will give you rest.
imitation-of-christ-benham-020-p04.core_idea: The Lord offers rest to the weary

imitation-of-christ-benham-021-p01.plain: Trusting in Your goodness and mercy, Lord, I come to You as the sick come to a healer, the hungry to a fountain, the poor to a king, the creature to its Creator, the lonely to a gentle comforter.
imitation-of-christ-benham-021-p01.core_idea: Coming to God as the needy come to help

judge.issue: Drops "servant to the Lord" and "Fountain of life" becomes just a fountain.

imitation-of-christ-benham-021-p02.plain: Speaking to God: give me Yourself and that is enough, since nothing else comforts. Without You I cannot exist, and without Your presence I have no strength to live.

imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p01.plain: I toil, grieve, carry my sins and struggle with temptations, and no one can free me except You, Lord my Saviour. I entrust myself and all I have to You, to lead me to eternal life.
imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p01.core_idea: In every burden, only God can deliver

imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p02.plain: God says: all I ask is that you give yourself wholly to Me. Whatever else you give means nothing to Me, because I want you, not your gifts.
imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p02.core_idea: God wants you, not your gifts

imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p03.plain: Speaking to God: all I can do about my sins is confess, grieve and ask mercy. I mean to repent and make amends, and I put myself in Your hands. Treat me by Your kindness, not my wrongdoing.
imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p03.core_idea: Confess, repent, and trust God's mercy

judge.issue: Drops "never more commit them" and the plea to save a soul redeemed by Christ's blood.

imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p04.plain: A prayer: Lord, take from our hearts all suspicion, resentment, anger and quarrelling, and anything that harms love between people.
imitation-of-christ-benham-022-p04.core_idea: Prayer to remove what harms love

imitation-of-christ-benham-023-p01.plain: Follow the advice of wise people and put aside anxiety and over-scrupulous worry, because it blocks God's grace and destroys a devoted mind.
imitation-of-christ-benham-023-p01.core_idea: Anxious scruples block grace and devotion

imitation-of-christ-benham-023-p02.plain: Speaking to God: You are my witness that nothing and no one can comfort me or give me rest except You, whom I long to contemplate forever.

imitation-of-christ-benham-023-p03.plain: If you feel no devotion and feel spiritually dry, keep praying hard. Keep groaning and knocking until you receive even a crumb or a drop of saving grace.

imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p01.plain: Speaking to God: truly You are my peacemaker. In You is perfect peace and rest; apart from You is toil, sorrow and endless misery.
imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p01.core_idea: Peace is in God; misery apart from Him

imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p02.plain: Seek devotion earnestly, wait for it patiently, receive and keep it humbly, and leave its timing to God. When you feel little devotion, be humble but not crushed. God often gives in a moment what He long withheld.
imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p02.core_idea: Wait patiently for grace; God gives in time

judge.issue: Drops asking fervently, receiving gratefully, working diligently, and grace deferred to the end of prayer.

imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p03.plain: Speaking to the Lord: You know my weakness, my needs, and how often I am weighed down and tempted. I come to You for help and comfort, since You know all my secrets and alone can help me fully.
imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p03.core_idea: Bringing one's weakness honestly to God

judge.issue: Drops the eucharistic desire to receive the Lord and poverty in virtues.

imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p04.plain: Simple faith that skips difficult questioning and follows God's commandments is blessed. Many lost their devotion by probing deeper things. God asks faith and an honest life, not great intellect or insight into His mysteries.
imitation-of-christ-benham-024-p04.core_idea: Faith and honest living matter more than intellect

japji-macauliffe-001-p01.plain: There is one God, whose name is truth: the Creator, without fear or hatred, undying, unborn, self-existent, known by the Guru's grace. Repeat His name. The True One was, is, and always will be.

japji-macauliffe-001-p02.plain: No amount of thinking, silence, or worldly gain brings me to God, and no clever method helps. How can a person become true and tear away falsehood? Nanak says: by living according to God's will.
japji-macauliffe-001-p02.core_idea: God is reached by His will, not cleverness

judge.issue: Loses unquenchable hunger for God and "as preordained"; recasts as worldly gain not reaching God.

japji-macauliffe-001-p03.plain: Everything comes by God's order: bodies, souls, greatness, high and low status, pain and pleasure, reward or endless rebirth. No one is outside it. Nanak says whoever understands God's order is free of ego.
japji-macauliffe-001-p03.core_idea: All is God's order; understanding it ends ego

japji-macauliffe-001-p04.plain: The state of someone who obeys God cannot be described, and whoever tries will regret it; no paper, pen or writer can capture it. God's name is so pure that whoever obeys Him feels its joy in their own heart.
japji-macauliffe-001-p04.core_idea: The joy of obeying God is beyond words

japji-macauliffe-001-p05.plain: As water cleans dirty hands and soap cleans clothes, God's name cleanses a mind stained by sin. No one becomes saint or sinner by calling themselves so; deeds are recorded, and each reaps what they sow.
japji-macauliffe-001-p05.core_idea: God's name cleanses; you reap what you sow

japji-macauliffe-001-p06.plain: Pilgrimage, austerity, mercy and charity may earn a little honour. But whoever hears, obeys and loves God in their heart is cleansed at the pilgrimage place within. All virtues are God's, none mine; without virtue there is no devotion.
japji-macauliffe-001-p06.core_idea: Inner love of God cleanses more than rituals

japji-macauliffe-001-p07.plain: Those who praise God still do not know Him fully, as rivers flow into the sea without knowing its size. Kings with mountains of wealth are not equal to a worm that keeps God in its heart.
japji-macauliffe-001-p07.core_idea: Remembering God outweighs all worldly wealth

japji-macauliffe-002-p01.plain: Wear contentment as your earrings, modesty and self-respect as your begging bag, and meditation as your holy ash. Make your body, which death will consume, your beggar's coat, and make faith your rule and your staff.
japji-macauliffe-002-p01.core_idea: Make inner virtues your true religious garb

japji-macauliffe-002-p02.plain: I have no power to speak or be silent, to ask or give, to live or die, to gain wealth, to meditate on God, or to escape the world. Before God, no one is stronger or weaker.
japji-macauliffe-002-p02.core_idea: Before God, no one has power of their own

judge.issue: Drops the challenge "he in whose arm there is strength may see what he can do".

japji-macauliffe-002-p03.plain: Make self-control your furnace, patience your goldsmith, understanding your anvil, divine knowledge your tools, fear of God your bellows, discipline your fire, and love your crucible; melt God's name in it. In such a true mint the Word is coined.
japji-macauliffe-002-p03.core_idea: Virtues are the forge where God's Word is made

japji-macauliffe-002-p04.plain: Air is our Guru, water our father, earth our mother. Our good and bad deeds will be read before the judge, bringing some near to God and some far. Those who dwelt on the Name will shine and free many.
japji-macauliffe-002-p04.core_idea: Deeds decide nearness to God; the Name brings freedom

judge.issue: Drops day and night as nurses and "after completion of toil".

light-of-asia-arnold-002-p01.plain: Just as hidden seed sprouts after years without rain, so good and evil, pains and pleasures, hates and loves, and all past deeds return, bearing bright or dark leaves, sweet or sour fruit.
light-of-asia-arnold-002-p01.core_idea: Past deeds return like seeds that sprout

light-of-asia-arnold-004-p01.plain: We are voices of the wandering wind, longing for rest and never finding it. Mortal life is like that wind: a moan, a sob, a storm. No one knows where life comes from or goes.
light-of-asia-arnold-004-p01.core_idea: Life is restless and changing like the wind

judge.issue: Drops "we are as ye are, ghosts from the inane" and changeful pain lines.

light-of-asia-arnold-004-p02.plain: Even if we held love and life so close that our breaths became one, time would still come between us and steal away my passion and your beauty, just as night quietly takes the rosy light from a mountain peak.
light-of-asia-arnold-004-p02.core_idea: Time steals even the closest love

light-of-asia-arnold-005-p01.plain: High and low, good and bad, all must die, and then, it is taught, begin again somewhere, somehow, who knows; and so again come the pain, the parting, and the funeral fire. Such is the human cycle.
light-of-asia-arnold-005-p01.core_idea: All die and the cycle of rebirth repeats

light-of-asia-arnold-006-p01.plain: Oh suffering world, I feel the vast agony of the earth and the emptiness of its joys. Pleasure ends in pain, youth in age, love in loss, life in death, and death in new lives on the same wheel.
light-of-asia-arnold-006-p01.core_idea: The world is caught in a wheel of suffering

judge.issue: Drops mockery of earth's best and "woes that are not false".

light-of-asia-arnold-007-p01.plain: People froze until someone struck fire from flint, ate like wolves until someone sowed grain, and babbled until someone found speech and writing. Every good gift humanity has came from searching, struggle and loving sacrifice.
light-of-asia-arnold-007-p01.core_idea: Every human gift came from struggle and sacrifice

light-of-asia-arnold-007-p02.plain: Friend, love that clings to love for its own pleasures is false. I love these people more than my joy, even more than theirs, so I leave to save them and all beings, if utmost love can.
light-of-asia-arnold-007-p02.core_idea: True love is selfless, not clinging

light-of-asia-arnold-008-p01.plain: Speaking to ascetics: will you punish your body so hard for your soul's sake that it breaks down before the journey ends? Why wreck this house whose windows give the little light we search by?
light-of-asia-arnold-008-p01.core_idea: Don't destroy the body the spirit needs

light-of-asia-arnold-008-p02.plain: Palms reaching for the sky, what secret keeps you content from sprout to fruit? And you merry birds in the trees: none of you hate your life or think you must deny your needs to improve.

light-of-asia-arnold-009-p01.plain: Yesterday the one you love died in your arms; today you know the whole world weeps with you. A grief that all hearts share grows lighter for each one.

light-of-asia-arnold-010-p01.plain: Pity and need make all beings family. There is no caste in blood or tears, which are alike in everyone, and no one is born marked by caste. Doing good makes a person noble; doing evil, base.
light-of-asia-arnold-010-p01.core_idea: Deeds, not birth, make a person noble

light-of-asia-arnold-010-p02.plain: A string pulled too tight snaps and the music is gone; a string too loose makes no sound. Tune us like a sitar, neither too low nor too high.
light-of-asia-arnold-010-p02.core_idea: Balance, not extremes, makes life work

light-of-asia-arnold-010-p03.plain: I believe good comes from good and evil from evil, everywhere: sweet fruit from healthy roots, hate from spite, friends from kindness, peace from patience. So after death, will the future not be as good as now?
light-of-asia-arnold-010-p03.core_idea: Good brings good, now and after death

light-of-asia-arnold-011-p01.plain: Like a climber on a summit looking back over every cliff, bog and ridge he crossed, the Buddha saw life's long chain of upward steps, from low levels to heights where the ten Virtues lead skyward.
light-of-asia-arnold-011-p01.core_idea: Life is a long upward climb toward virtue

light-of-asia-arnold-012-p01.plain: Through many lives I sought the builder of these sorrowful prisons of the senses. Now, builder, I know you; you will never build these walls of pain again. Delusion made your house, and it is broken. I go free.
light-of-asia-arnold-012-p01.core_idea: Seeing through delusion ends the cycle of suffering

light-of-asia-arnold-012-p02.plain: Evil adds to the debts you must pay; good frees and clears you. Avoid evil, do good, and rule over yourself. This is the Way.
light-of-asia-arnold-012-p02.core_idea: Shun evil, do good, master yourself

light-of-asia-arnold-013-p01.plain: A greater love bears patiently with a lesser one to lift it higher. Whoever has escaped bondage should not taunt those still bound. Be free so that you spread freedom through patience and gentle wisdom.
light-of-asia-arnold-013-p01.core_idea: Use your freedom to free others patiently

fix.display_text:
The greater beareth with the lesser love
So it may raise it unto easier heights.
Take heed that no man, being 'scaped from bonds,
Vexeth bound souls with boasts of liberty.
Free are ye rather that your freedom spread
By patient winning and sweet wisdom's skill.

judge.issue: "Free are ye rather that your freedom spread" recast as a command to be free.

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p01.plain: Do not pray; the darkness will not lighten and the silence cannot answer. Do not try to buy help from powerless gods with offerings. Freedom must be sought within; each person makes their own prison.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p01.core_idea: Liberation is found within, not from gods

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p02.plain: Nothing lasts: good virtues wear away with time, and bad sins are cleansed by it.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p02.core_idea: Time wears away both virtue and sin

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p03.plain: You are not bound: the heart of being is restful, and will is stronger than sorrow. I, the Buddha, who wept with the world, now rejoice in freedom. You suffer from yourselves; no one else holds you on the wheel.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p03.core_idea: Your suffering comes from yourself; freedom is possible

judge.issue: Drops "that which was Good doth pass to Better, Best".

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p04.plain: You reap what you sow: sesame grows sesame, corn grows corn. A person's fate grows from what they planted in past lives, good seed and weeds. If they pull the weeds and plant good seedlings, the harvest will be rich.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p04.core_idea: You reap what you sow, across lives

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p05.plain: When gentle and just people die, the world grows richer, like a desert stream that sinks underground and rises again purer and wider.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p05.core_idea: Good lives enrich the world after death

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p06.plain: Love is sweet, but the funeral fire will take the bodies that embrace; strength in war is fine, but vultures pick the bones of chiefs and kings.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p06.core_idea: Love and power both end in death

light-of-asia-arnold-014-p07.plain: You cling to shadows and love dreams. You set a false self at the centre and build a world around it that only seems real, blind to the higher truth and the true life kept for whoever drops the false.
light-of-asia-arnold-014-p07.core_idea: A false self builds an unreal world

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p01.plain: Peace is overcoming self-love and craving, uprooting passion, and calming inner conflict. Let your love be eternal beauty, your glory self-mastery, your wealth service, duty, kindness, gentle speech and blameless days, riches that never fade.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p01.core_idea: Peace is mastering self and craving

judge.issue: Drops "for pleasure, to live beyond the gods"; descriptive definition of peace partly turned into commands.

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p02.plain: Many paths lead up to the snowy peaks: the strong climb the steep road, the weak wind slowly with many rests. So the Eightfold Path to peace goes; the firm hurry, the feeble linger, but all arrive.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p02.core_idea: All reach peace, fast or slow

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p03.plain: Wish well to every living thing, letting unkindness, greed and anger die, so that your lives become like gentle breezes passing by.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p03.core_idea: Goodwill to all; let anger and greed die

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p04.plain: Guard your lips as if they were palace doors with a king inside; let every word that comes out be calm, kind and courteous.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p04.core_idea: Guard your speech; keep it calm and kind

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p05.plain: Let each act undo a fault or help some good grow; let love show through good deeds like silver thread through crystal beads.

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p06.plain: I know love of spouse and child is dear, friends and pleasures sweet, and life's fears false though strong. Those who must, live such lives, but make your weakness a golden stair, rising through them to lovelier truths.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p06.core_idea: Ordinary life can be a stair to truth

judge.issue: Drops "fruitful of good life's gentle charities".

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p07.plain: Enter the Path! No sorrow is like hatred, no pain like passion, no deceit like the senses. Whoever overcomes even one cherished fault has come far.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p07.core_idea: Overcoming one fault is real progress

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p08.plain: Do not bear false witness, slander, or lie; truthful speech comes from a pure heart.

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p09.plain: Avoid drugs and drinks that cloud your mind; a clear mind and clean body need no intoxicant.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p09.core_idea: A clear mind needs no intoxicants

light-of-asia-arnold-015-p10.plain: Don't scatter rice as offerings; instead offer loving thoughts and acts to everyone: parents, teachers, spouse and children, friends and all people, the smallest creatures, and the saints and dead above. That shuts out evil and keeps every direction safe.
light-of-asia-arnold-015-p10.core_idea: Offer love to all, not ritual offerings

judge.issue: Drops the mapping of each relation to a compass quarter.

meditations-001-p01.plain: From Apollonius I learned free will, steady purpose and reliance on reason alone; to stay the same in pain, grief and illness; to be firm yet gentle; and to accept friends' favours without feeling humbled or ignoring them.
meditations-001-p01.core_idea: Lessons in steadiness and reason from a teacher

judge.issue: Drops "not peevish in instruction" and holding his own skill as smallest merit; child's loss generalised.

meditations-001-p02.plain: From Maximus I learned self-control and not being led astray, cheerfulness in every situation including illness, a blend of sweetness and dignity, and doing my tasks without complaint.
meditations-001-p02.core_idea: Self-control, cheerfulness, and duty without complaint

meditations-002-p01.plain: I owe it to the gods that I had good grandparents, parents, sister, teachers, companions, relatives and friends, almost everything good.
meditations-002-p01.core_idea: Gratitude for the good people in my life

meditations-002-p02.plain: Each morning tell yourself: today I'll meet meddling, ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful, envious people, ignorant of good and evil. But the wrongdoer is my kin, sharing reason and the divine, so he cannot harm me nor I hate him. We are made to cooperate; resenting or turning away is against nature.
meditations-002-p02.core_idea: Expect difficult people; they are still your kin
meditations-002-p02.plain_v1: Each morning, expect to meet meddling, ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful and envious people who don't know good from evil. They cannot harm you, and you cannot hate them, for they are your kin. We are made to work together.

judge_v1.issue: Drops kinship through shared reason and divinity, and that being vexed or turning away is itself against nature.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops that resentment and turning away are against nature, and kinship in divinity.

meditations-002-p03.plain: Remember how long you have delayed and how many chances the gods gave you. See what universe you belong to and what governor your life flows from; your time is fixed, and unless you use it to clear your mind, it will go, and you too, never to return.
meditations-002-p03.core_idea: Your time is limited; stop putting things off
meditations-002-p03.plain_v1: Remember how long you have put things off and wasted chances. Your time is limited, and if you don't use it to clear your mind, it will pass, you will pass, and it will never return.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the cosmic frame: part of the universe, existence flowing from its administrator, chances from the gods.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops perceiving one's place in the universe and its governor.

meditations-002-p04.plain: Do each present task with simple dignity, kindness, freedom and justice, setting aside other thoughts. You will, if you do each act as your last, free of carelessness, hypocrisy, self-love and discontent. Hold these few things and you live a quiet life like the gods', who ask nothing more.
meditations-002-p04.core_idea: Do each act as if it were your last
meditations-002-p04.plain_v1: Do each task with dignity, care, freedom and justice, setting other thoughts aside. You can, if you act each time as if it were your last, without carelessness, hypocrisy, self-love or discontent. A calm life needs little.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the life "like the existence of the gods"; "a calm life needs little" misreads few principles held.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops that this life is like the gods', who require nothing more.

meditations-002-p05.plain: Do outside events distract you? Take time to learn something good and stop being spun around. But avoid the opposite error too: people who wear themselves out with activity, with no aim for their actions and thoughts.
meditations-002-p05.core_idea: Avoid distraction and aimless busyness alike

meditations-002-p06.plain: People are rarely unhappy because they fail to notice what others are thinking, but those who don't watch their own minds are bound to be unhappy.
meditations-002-p06.core_idea: Watch your own mind, not others'

meditations-002-p07.plain: Since you could leave life this very moment, let every act and thought reflect that.
meditations-002-p07.core_idea: Live as if you could die now

meditations-003-p01.plain: Even if you lived thousands of years, you only ever lose the life you are living now. So the longest and shortest lives come to the same. No one can lose the past or future, because no one has them.
meditations-003-p01.core_idea: Only the present moment can be lost

meditations-003-p02.plain: Remember that everything depends on how you judge it.
meditations-003-p02.core_idea: Everything is a matter of opinion

meditations-003-p03.plain: Don't waste the rest of your life thinking about other people unless it serves some common good. Wondering what someone is doing, saying, thinking or plotting costs you other work and pulls you away from watching your own mind.
meditations-003-p03.core_idea: Don't waste life wondering about others

meditations-003-p04.plain: Be cheerful, and don't depend on outside help or on calm that others provide. A person must stand upright on their own, not be held up by others.
meditations-003-p04.core_idea: Stand on your own, not propped up

meditations-004-p01.plain: If you do the task in front of you by right reason, seriously, calmly and undistracted, keeping your divine part pure, expecting and fearing nothing, and speaking truthfully, you will live happily. No one can stop you.
meditations-004-p01.core_idea: Do your present task well and be happy

judge.issue: Drops keeping the divine part "as if bound to give it back" and heroic truth.

meditations-004-p02.plain: Stop drifting. You will never read the notes, histories and books you were saving for old age. Hurry toward your goal, drop empty hopes, and help yourself while you still can, if you care about yourself.
meditations-004-p02.core_idea: Stop drifting; act for yourself now

meditations-004-p03.plain: The ruling mind, following nature, easily adapts to whatever happens and turns obstacles into material for its purpose, like a strong fire that seizes what is thrown on it and burns higher because of it.
meditations-004-p03.core_idea: A strong mind turns obstacles into fuel

judge.issue: Drops "under certain conditions" and the contrast with a small light being extinguished.

meditations-004-p04.plain: People seek retreats in the country, by the sea or in the mountains, but you can retreat into yourself anytime, and nowhere is quieter or freer than your own soul. Tranquillity is a well-ordered mind. Retreat there often, keeping brief basic principles that cleanse you and send you back content.
meditations-004-p04.core_idea: Retreat into your own mind for peace
meditations-004-p04.plain_v1: People seek retreats in the country, by the sea, in the mountains. But you can retreat into yourself whenever you choose, and nowhere is quieter than your own soul. Tranquility is a well-ordered mind; renew yourself there often.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the brief fundamental principles that cleanse the soul, a key secondary idea.
