viv08-003-p06.plain: Forcing reform only slows it. Do not tell someone they are bad; tell them they are good but can be better.
viv08-003-p06.core_idea: Encourage people to be better; don't condemn.

viv08-003-p07.plain: Love never condemns; only ambition does. There is no such thing as righteous anger or justified killing.
viv08-003-p07.core_idea: Love never condemns; no anger is righteous.

viv08-004-p01.plain: The more love and goodness grow in us, the more we see them around us, and condemning others condemns ourselves. Set your own small world right and the larger world will follow.
viv08-004-p01.core_idea: Change yourself and the world changes with you.

viv08-004-p02.plain: Every real step forward in the world has been won by love. Criticism has been tried for thousands of years and never helps; condemnation achieves nothing.
viv08-004-p02.core_idea: Love achieves progress; condemnation achieves nothing.

viv08-004-p03.plain: Never ask what good something will do for the world; leave the world alone. Love and ask nothing, look for nothing more, and forget all the isms.

viv08-004-p04.plain: A Sufi poem: once there were a woman and a man, but love grew until there was neither, only a faint memory of two, because love came between them and made them one.

judge.issue: Adds 'A Sufi poem' attribution not in the passage.

viv08-004-p05.plain: All hatred is the self killing the Self, so love is the law of life.
viv08-004-p05.core_idea: Hatred harms the Self; love is life's law.

viv08-005-p01.plain: Striking back is easy. It is enormously hard to hold back, stand still, take refuge in the Lord, and wait for Him to act.
viv08-005-p01.core_idea: Restraint and surrender are harder than striking.

judge.issue: 'Strike a blow' rendered as 'striking back', adding retaliation.

viv08-005-p02.plain: You cannot see the truth unless you are ready to change at any moment, yet you must stay firm and steady in your search for it.
viv08-005-p02.core_idea: Stay open to change yet steady in seeking truth.

viv08-005-p03.plain: The universe is ours to enjoy, but want nothing. Wanting is weakness; it makes us beggars, and we are children of the king, not beggars.
viv08-005-p03.core_idea: Wanting makes beggars of royal children.

viv08-005-p04.plain: Religion without philosophy turns into superstition; philosophy without religion turns into dry atheism.
viv08-005-p04.core_idea: Religion and philosophy need each other.

viv08-005-p05.plain: Seeing difference causes all misery, and ignorance causes us to see difference.
viv08-005-p05.core_idea: Ignorance makes us see difference, causing misery.

viv08-005-p06.plain: We are lamps, and our burning is what we call life; when the oxygen runs out, the lamp goes out. All we can do is keep the lamp clean.
viv08-005-p06.core_idea: Life burns out; we can only keep it clean.

viv08-006-p01.plain: His Master said the vulture flies high out of sight, yet its eye is always on some scrap of carrion on the ground.
viv08-006-p01.core_idea: Soaring high means little if your eye is low.

viv08-006-p02.plain: Knowledge kept in books and money held by others are as good as having no knowledge and no money.
viv08-006-p02.core_idea: Knowledge and money must truly be your own.

viv08-006-p03.plain: Devotion is natural and pleasant; philosophy turns the stream back to its source, faster but very hard. Devotion asks for total self-surrender: a longer way, but easier and happier, where all I do is God doing it.
viv08-006-p03.core_idea: Devotion is the easier, happier path to God.

fix.display_text: The path of devotion is natural and pleasant. Philosophy is taking the mountain stream back to its force. It is a quicker method but very hard. Philosophy says, “Check everything.” Devotion says, “Give the stream, have eternal self-surrender.” It is a longer way, but easier and happier. “Thine am I for ever; henceforth whatever I do, it is Thou doing it. No more is there any me or mine.”

judge.issue: Drops 'philosophy says check everything'; contrast slightly thinned.

viv08-006-p04.plain: A prayer: with no money to give, no brains for learning and no time for Yoga, I give You myself, sweet One, my body and my mind.
viv08-006-p04.core_idea: Having nothing else, I offer myself to God.

viv08-006-p05.plain: Nothing can come between the soul and God; even if there is no God, keep hold of love, for it is better to die seeking God than chasing scraps. Choose the highest ideal and give your life to it.
viv08-006-p05.core_idea: Give your life to the highest ideal.

judge.issue: 'No ignorance or wrong ideas' broadened to 'nothing'; drops death-for-great-purpose line.

viv08-006-p06.plain: Knowledge criticises and fusses over everything, but Love trusts that God will show His true nature and accepts everything.
viv08-006-p06.core_idea: Love accepts all; knowledge only criticises.

viv08-006-p07.plain: A poem: visiting the sick Rabbia, one saint said pure prayer endures God's punishment, another that loving God's will rejoices in it. Rabbia replied that whoever sees the Master's face forgets being punished at all.
viv08-006-p07.core_idea: Seeing God, one forgets all suffering.

fix.display_text: Rabbia, sick upon her bed, By two saints was visited — Holy Malik, Hassan wise — Men of mark in Moslem eyes. Hassan said, “Whose prayer is pure Will God’s chastisements endure.” Malik, from a deeper sense Uttered his experience: “He who loves his master’s choice Will in chastisement rejoice.” Rabbia saw some selfish will In their maxims lingering still, And replied “O men of grace, He who sees his Master’s face, Will not in his prayers recall That he is chastised at all!”
fix.reason: Removed stray spaces before apostrophes and exclamation mark.

judge.issue: Drops Rabbia seeing selfish will lingering in the saints' maxims.

viv08-006-p08.plain: Every new power brings more misery, so kill desire. Fulfilling any desire is like poking a stick into a hornets' nest.
viv08-006-p08.core_idea: Fulfilling desire stirs up more misery.

viv08-007-p01.plain: Action is pleasant and all misery is reaction, as a child feels pain only when the burn reacts, so be the witness and do not react. Work freely, not from duty; life is an eternal holiday.
viv08-007-p01.core_idea: Misery comes from reaction; be the witness.

judge.issue: Drops 'we have no duty', self-forgetting as happiest, and the gymnasium image.

viv08-007-p02.plain: The secret of existence is to have no fear: never fear what will happen to you, and depend on no one. You are free only when you refuse all help, as a full sponge can absorb no more.
viv08-007-p02.core_idea: Fearlessness and self-reliance are the secret of life.

viv08-007-p03.plain: Even fighting in self-defence is wrong, though better than attacking. There is no righteous indignation, because indignation comes from failing to see that all things are the same.
viv08-007-p03.core_idea: No indignation is righteous; all are one.

viv08-007-p04.plain: The greatest sin is to think yourself weak; realise you are Brahman, and nothing has power except what you give it. Deny evil, create none, and declare yourself master, for we make our chains and only we can break them.
viv08-007-p04.core_idea: Thinking yourself weak is the greatest sin.

judge.issue: Drops 'teach the Godhood of man' and being beyond sun and stars.

viv08-008-p01.plain: Buddha bowed to nothing, not scripture, caste, priest or custom, and reasoned fearlessly as far as reason went, with unmatched love for all life. Like Washington, he won a throne only to give it away, seeking nothing for himself.
viv08-008-p01.core_idea: Buddha sought truth fearlessly and nothing for himself.

viv08-008-p02.plain: Every step taken in the light is mine forever, as a country becomes yours once you see it. Each of us must see for ourselves; teachers can only bring the food, and we must eat it.
viv08-008-p02.core_idea: Truth must be seen for yourself.

viv08-008-p03.plain: Hold on to reason until you reach something higher; you will know it is higher because it does not clash with reason.
viv08-008-p03.core_idea: What is truly higher never clashes with reason.

viv08-008-p04.plain: Do not waste energy talking; meditate and gather power in silence, undisturbed by the world's rush. A beggar has nothing to give; only a king can give, and only when he wants nothing.

judge.issue: Drops unconsciousness of the highest state and the 'dynamo of spirituality' image.

viv08-008-p05.plain: Hold your money only as a caretaker of what belongs to God, without attachment. Let go of name, fame and money, which are a terrible bondage, and feel the wonderful air of freedom.
viv08-008-p05.core_idea: Hold wealth without attachment; it binds.

viv08-008-p06.plain: The whole ocean stands behind every wave. All things are waves, big and small, and each is the whole ocean in essence, though as a wave it is only a part.
viv08-008-p06.core_idea: Each wave is the whole ocean in essence.

viv08-008-p07.plain: Religion adds nothing new; it only removes obstacles to seeing your Self. These include sickness, doubt, inconstancy and melancholy, though once you know Brahman you can never be melancholy again.
viv08-008-p07.core_idea: Religion removes obstacles to seeing the Self.

judge.issue: Drops 'healthy body is the best instrument' and melancholy as nearly insuperable.

viv08-009-p01.plain: To gain liberation through work, work without desire or looking for results; such work brings knowledge, then freedom. Giving up work before you know brings misery. Work done for the Self doesn't bind. Neither seek pleasure nor fear pain from work; keep telling yourself mind and body work, not you.
viv08-009-p01.core_idea: Work without desire leads to freedom.
viv08-009-p01.plain_v1: To gain freedom through work, work without desire or looking for results, neither seeking pleasure nor fearing pain; that leads to knowledge and liberation. It is body and mind that work, not I.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the warning that giving up work before knowing leads to misery, and work for the Self.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Drops misery of giving up work early and work for the Self not binding.

viv08-009-p02.plain: Do everything as an offering to the Lord, in the world but not of it, like a lotus pure above the mud, and love everyone. We see evil outside only because it is in us; the pure cannot see impurity.
viv08-009-p02.core_idea: We see outside only what is within us.

judge.issue: Drops 'whatever they do to you', the condition on loving all.

viv08-009-p03.plain: Do not fight over methods; aim only at realisation and pick the method that suits you best. Eat the mangoes and let others argue about the basket.
viv08-009-p03.core_idea: Seek realisation; don't quarrel over methods.

viv08-009-p04.plain: One guess against another leads to fights, but speak of what you have actually lived, and no human heart can resist it.
viv08-009-p04.core_idea: Lived experience moves hearts; opinions breed fights.

viv08-009-p05.plain: Learn to help without pity or thinking there is misery. Learn to treat enemy and friend alike; when you can, and desire is gone, the goal is reached.
viv08-009-p05.core_idea: Help without pity; treat friend and enemy alike.

viv08-009-p06.plain: Time devours everything, so why paint the butterfly or run like mice on a treadmill? Every desire, good or bad, brings evil, like meat forever out of a dog's reach, so cut off all desire.
viv08-009-p06.core_idea: All desire is futile; cut it off.

viv08-009-p07.plain: Four travellers reached a high wall: three climbed and leapt over with joy, and the fourth came back to tell of them. The laughter echoing back from great souls who leapt beyond illusion is our sign something lies beyond.
viv08-009-p07.core_idea: Great souls' joy shows there is something beyond.

viv08-009-p08.plain: Being allowed to give is our privilege, for only by giving do we grow. The poor suffer so that we may be helped; let the giver kneel and give thanks, and the receiver stand and allow it.
viv08-009-p08.core_idea: The giver should thank the one who receives.

viv08-009-p09.plain: Be grateful to whoever curses you: they show you a mirror of what cursing is and give you a chance to practise restraint. So bless them and be glad; power grows only through exercise.
viv08-009-p09.core_idea: Those who curse you help you grow.

viv08-010-p01.plain: Draw the scriptures out of your own Self, for you are the greatest book there is. Outside teaching is useless until the teacher within opens the book of the heart.
viv08-010-p01.core_idea: The truest teacher and book are within you.

judge.issue: 'Upanishads' generalised to 'scriptures'; drops 'go into your own room'.

viv08-010-p02.plain: Never say doing anything is your duty; say it is your nature. Truth alone wins, so stand on Truth and you have God.
viv08-010-p02.core_idea: Act from your nature; stand on Truth.

viv08-010-p03.plain: All knowledge depends on a calm mind.
viv08-010-p03.core_idea: Knowledge depends on a calm mind.

viv08-010-p04.plain: Whether or not you have controlled your mind or have money, you are the ever-pure Atman. Say: no bondage ever touched me; I am the changeless sky, and passing clouds of belief do not touch me.
viv08-010-p04.core_idea: You are the ever-pure Self, untouched by anything.

viv08-010-p05.plain: Fear nothing, for you are the essence of existence; be at peace and do not upset yourself. You were never bound, never virtuous or sinful, so drop these delusions and be at peace.
viv08-010-p05.core_idea: You were never bound; be at peace.

viv08-010-p06.plain: Remove the faults in yourself and you will see none outside; a baby sees a robbery and it means nothing. Once you are free and stainless, you see only freedom and purity around you.
viv08-010-p06.core_idea: Free yourself of faults and you'll see none.

viv08-010-p07.plain: We have three great gifts: a human body, the nearest reflection of God; the desire to be free; and a noble teacher who has crossed beyond delusion. With these three, thank the Lord; you will surely be free.
viv08-010-p07.core_idea: Body, longing and a teacher bring freedom.

viv08-010-p08.plain: What you only understand intellectually can be overturned by a new argument, but what you realise is yours forever. Talking religion does little good; make it a habit to see God behind everything.
viv08-010-p08.core_idea: Realisation lasts; intellectual belief can be overturned.

viv08-010-p09.plain: Ingersoll wanted to squeeze the orange of this world dry. He replied he squeezed it better: knowing he cannot die, he is unhurried and fearless, free of ties, loving everyone as God, and so gets ten thousand times more.
viv08-010-p09.core_idea: Fearless love of all gets the most from life.

judge.issue: First-person reply shifted to an unclear 'he'; 'no duty, no bondage of family' thinned.

viv08-011-p01.plain: Never judge a person by their faults. Their great virtues are their own; their errors are the common weaknesses of humanity and should not count in judging their character.
viv08-011-p01.core_idea: Judge people by their virtues, not faults.

viv08-011-p02.plain: All our past actions are really good, because they lead us to what we finally become.
viv08-011-p02.core_idea: Every past action leads toward who we become.

viv08-011-p03.plain: Tell the truth boldly, whether it hurts or not, and never cater to weakness. If the truth is too much for intelligent people and sweeps them away, let them go, the sooner the better.
viv08-011-p03.core_idea: Speak truth boldly, never pandering to weakness.

viv08-011-p04.plain: Blows wake us up and help break the dream. They show us the world is not enough and make us long for freedom.
viv08-011-p04.core_idea: Life's blows awaken longing for freedom.

viv08-011-p05.plain: A restless lower bird, tasting bitter fruit, kept climbing nearer a serene golden bird above. At last it reached the top and found there had only ever been one bird, and it had always been that upper bird.
viv08-011-p05.core_idea: The restless self is really the serene Self.

viv08-011-p06.plain: Be completely without hope, the highest state, for what is there to hope for? Break the bonds of hope, stand on your Self, be at rest and give everything to God, without hypocrisy.
viv08-011-p06.core_idea: Freedom from hope is the highest rest.

judge.issue: Drops 'never mind what you do'.

viv08-011-p07.plain: We want everything except God, because the outer world meets our ordinary needs. Only after hard blows, when we are disappointed with everything here, do we feel the need for something higher and seek God.
viv08-011-p07.core_idea: Disappointment with the world turns us to God.

viv08-011-p08.plain: Only a fool, living beside the Ganga, digs a little well for water; only a fool, arriving at a diamond mine, looks for glass beads.
viv08-011-p08.core_idea: Don't settle for trifles beside the infinite.

viv08-012-p01.plain: Books point to the inner light, but once it flashes for you, leave them and look within; you hold far more than all books. Never lose faith in yourself, for all power is yours.
viv08-012-p01.core_idea: Look within; never lose faith in yourself.

judge.issue: Drops that books are understood only once knowledge is earned, and 'you can do anything'.

viv08-012-p02.plain: Be grateful to books and teachers without being bound to them; love and worship your Guru, but think for yourself rather than obey blindly. Blind belief cannot save you; work out your own salvation.
viv08-012-p02.core_idea: Love your teacher but think for yourself.

judge.issue: 'Worship your Guru as God' loses 'as God'.

viv08-012-p03.plain: Any good you do, you do to yourself, so treat the receiver as the higher one. Give as a rose gives perfume, naturally and without knowing it is giving.
viv08-012-p03.core_idea: Give naturally, as a rose gives perfume.

judge.issue: Drops 'you serve because you are lower than he'.

viv08-012-p04.plain: Be friendly and respectful to all and take the best from each, but keep firm in your own way. Higher still is seeing through another's eyes: while weak, keep one path; when strong, sympathise with every view.
viv08-012-p04.core_idea: Hold your path, yet learn to see through others' eyes.

fix.display_text: “Take the honey out of all flowers; sit and be friendly with all, pay reverence to all, say to all, ‘Yes, brother, yes, brother’, but keep firm in your own way.” A higher stage is actually to take the position of the other. If I am all, why can I not really and actively sympathise with my brother and see with his eyes? While I am weak, I must stick to one course (Nishthâ), but when I am strong, I can feel with every other and perfectly sympathise with his ideas.
fix.reason: Removed stray space before closing quote.

viv08-012-p05.plain: Now we are like stray dogs eating fearfully in a kitchen, waiting to be chased out. Renounce the world, at least in your heart, and you become a king who knows he owns it.
viv08-012-p05.core_idea: Renounce the world to truly own it.

viv08-012-p06.plain: Spit out your actions, good or bad, and never think of them again; do not repent, brood or recall your good deeds. You cannot undo the effect, so face it, but never repeat the act.
viv08-012-p06.core_idea: Let go of past deeds; face effects, don't repeat.

judge.issue: Drops 'no weakness even facing death' and 'the weak never reach Atman'.

viv08-012-p07.plain: Saying food is not eating it, and saying water is not drinking it. Likewise, merely repeating the word God brings no realisation; we must strive and practise.
viv08-012-p07.core_idea: Realisation needs practice, not just words.

viv08-013-p01.plain: Only the present exists. Even in thought there is no past or future, because to think of them you must make them present.

viv08-013-p02.plain: Do not wait to rest with a harp by degrees; take the harp and begin now. Why wait for heaven when you can make it here?
viv08-013-p02.core_idea: Don't wait for heaven; make it here.

viv08-013-p03.plain: This shameful clinging to life as we know it is the root of all evil, of cheating, stealing and making money a god. Value nothing material and cling to nothing, not even life; then there is no fear.
viv08-013-p03.core_idea: Clinging to life is the root of evil and fear.

viv08-013-p04.plain: All the great religions taught the golden rule in nearly the same words, but only the Hindus gave the reason: you must love others because they are yourself. There is only One.
viv08-013-p04.core_idea: Love others because they are yourself.

viv08-013-p05.plain: Of all great religious teachers, only Lao-tze, Buddha and Jesus went beyond the golden rule to say: do good to your enemies and love those who hate you.
viv08-013-p05.core_idea: The highest teaching is to love your enemies.

viv08-013-p06.plain: Have something of your own to say, or you cannot judge what others have said. Drop old superstitions and stay ready for new truths; only fools drink bitter water from their forefathers' well rather than pure water from others'.
viv08-013-p06.core_idea: Stay open to new truths over inherited superstition.

viv08-013-p07.plain: Come to God any way you can; just come. But on the way, do not push anyone down.
viv08-013-p07.core_idea: Reach God any way, without harming others.

viv08-014-p01.plain: Control the lake of your own mind, or you cannot understand another's. A true teacher puts all his force into the learner's own leanings; without real sympathy we can never teach well.
viv08-014-p01.core_idea: Master your own mind to teach with sympathy.

fix.display_text: Control the “lake” of your own mind, else you cannot understand the lake of another’s mind. The true teacher is one who can throw his whole force into the tendency of the taught. Without real sympathy we can never teach well.

viv08-014-p02.plain: Be honest that you see the ideal but cannot reach it yet, rather than pretending to renounce. If a hundred fall, take the flag and carry it on, for God is true whoever fails.
viv08-014-p02.core_idea: Be honest about the ideal; carry the flag on.

judge.issue: Drops 'if you give up, stand fast' and that the flag can never fall.

viv08-014-p03.plain: Give up, and know success will follow even if you never see it. Jesus left only twelve fishermen, yet those few overturned the Roman Empire.

viv08-014-p04.plain: The one who struggles is better than the one who never tries.

viv08-014-p05.plain: Truth is judged only by truth, not by the good it does; the sun needs no torch to be seen. Even if truth destroys the universe, it is still truth, so stand by it.
viv08-014-p05.core_idea: Truth needs no test beyond itself.

viv08-014-p06.plain: Like an ox in an oil-mill chasing hay it never reaches, we chase happiness, grind nature's mill, and die to begin again. Religion begins when we see that seeking happiness in matter is nonsense.
viv08-014-p06.core_idea: Religion begins when chasing material happiness fails.

judge.issue: Drops that without evil we would never glimpse anything higher.

viv08-014-p07.plain: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God. If every book and prophet were lost, this one sentence alone would save humanity.
viv08-014-p07.core_idea: Purity of heart alone could save humanity.

viv08-014-p08.plain: An evil person is part of my own body, like a wound or burn. We must nurse him and help him get better until he heals and is happy and healthy again.
viv08-014-p08.core_idea: Heal the wrongdoer like a wound in yourself.

viv08-014-p09.plain: Cry for help and you will receive it. In the end the one crying and the Helper both vanish, the play is over, and only the Self remains.
viv08-014-p09.core_idea: Seeker and Helper dissolve; only the Self remains.

viv09-001-p01.plain: Once you have chosen the ideal and the means, you can almost let the ideal go, sure it will come when the means are perfected. Take care of the cause, and the effect will take care of itself.
viv09-001-p01.core_idea: Focus on the means; the result will follow.

viv09-001-p02.plain: Our greatest sorrow comes when we pour our energy into something that fails, know it hurts us, and still cannot let go. Like the bee that came for honey, our feet stick to the pot.
viv09-001-p02.core_idea: We suffer by clinging to what hurts us.

viv09-001-p03.plain: Cold, unloving people escape most of life's miseries, but so does a wall, which never loves or hurts and is still only a wall. Better to be attached and caught than to be a wall.
viv09-001-p03.core_idea: Better to love and suffer than feel nothing.

viv09-001-p04.plain: We are all beggars, wanting a return for whatever we do. We are traders in life, in virtue, in religion, and sadly even in love.
viv09-001-p04.core_idea: We even turn love into a trade.

viv09-001-p05.plain: We get caught not by what we give but by what we expect: love brings misery only because we want love back. Without wanting there is no misery; desire is the father of all misery.
viv09-001-p05.core_idea: Expecting return, not loving, brings misery.

viv09-001-p06.plain: Give what you have and want nothing back; it will return a thousandfold, but do not think of that. All of life is giving, and nature will force you to give, so give willingly.
viv09-001-p06.core_idea: Life is giving; give willingly, expecting nothing.

viv09-001-p07.plain: Even if every attempt fails and we are torn and bleeding, we must keep our heart and assert our divinity. Nature wants us to hit back blow for blow; not hitting back takes a more than divine power.
viv09-001-p07.core_idea: Not striking back takes the greatest strength.

viv09-001-p08.plain: Every day we resolve to be unattached, remembering how each attachment made us miserable and enslaved, and we vow to master ourselves. Then the same story repeats, and the soul is caught again, like a bird struggling in a net.
viv09-001-p08.core_idea: We vow freedom, then get caught again.

viv09-001-p09.plain: The difficulties are huge; most of us lose heart, turn pessimist and stop believing in sincerity, love and everything noble. So people who were kind, simple and forgiving when young become lying masks in old age.
viv09-001-p09.core_idea: Discouragement can turn the kind into cynics.

viv09-002-p01.plain: Every blow you receive needs your half as well as the world's. You cannot control the world, but you can control your own half, and if you truly master yourself, the blow will never come.
viv09-002-p01.core_idea: Control your part and the blow cannot land.

viv09-002-p02.plain: Since childhood we blame things outside ourselves, calling the world devilish and people selfish, and try to fix others instead of ourselves. But if we are so good, why are we here among them?
viv09-002-p02.core_idea: Stop blaming the world; look at yourself.

judge.issue: Drops 'if this is a devil's world, we must be devils also'.

viv09-002-p03.plain: Take care of yourself and stop attending to others for a while; perfect the means and the end will follow. The world can be good and pure only if our lives are, so let us purify ourselves.
viv09-002-p03.core_idea: Purify yourself and the world follows.

viv09-003-p01.plain: When we fail, we blame others. Nobody likes admitting their own faults and weaknesses; each of us tries to look blameless and pin it on someone or something else, even bad luck.
viv09-003-p01.core_idea: In failure we blame others, not ourselves.

viv09-003-p02.plain: The aim of all education should be making people grow, yet we keep polishing the outside. What use is polish when there is nothing inside?
viv09-003-p02.core_idea: Education should build the person within.

viv09-003-p03.plain: Like a bubble seen only when it bursts at the surface, we notice thoughts only once they are large or have become actions. If we could catch thought at its root, we could control everything.
viv09-003-p03.core_idea: Control thought at its root to master yourself.

viv09-004-p01.plain: Business is a harsh master: even when family die and your heart is breaking, you must keep working, and we think this right. This science demands more effort than any business ever could; many succeed in business, very few in this.
viv09-004-p01.core_idea: Spiritual practice demands more effort than relentless business

extension.text: And what an amount of attention does business require, and what a rigorous taskmaster it is! Even if the father, the mother, the wife, or the child dies, business cannot stop! Even if the heart is breaking, we still have to go to our place of business, when every hour of work is a pang. That is business, and we think that it is just, that it is right. This science calls for more application than any business can ever require. Many men can succeed in business; very few in this.

viv09-004-p01.plain_v1: Business is a harsh master: even when someone dies or your heart is breaking, you must still go to work, and we accept that as right.

judge_v1.issue: Loses the main point: this science demands more application than business; few succeed.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Omits the main point: this science demands more than business; few succeed.

viv09-004-p02.plain: As a boy I criticised the hard practices of ascetics, as even the Buddha did. Now I feel I have no right to judge; my criticism may come from cowardice, because I could not do what they do.
viv09-004-p02.core_idea: My criticism of ascetics may hide my own cowardice

judge.issue: Drops his wish for a fragment of their power; 'often I think' softened to 'may'.

viv09-004-p03.plain: A man brave before cannon may fear the surgeon's knife, and the reverse. So when you judge others, define what you mean by courage; the person you call not good may excel where you do not.
viv09-004-p03.core_idea: Courage takes many forms; define it before judging

viv09-004-p04.plain: The universe is like waves and hollows; you cannot have one without the other. Balance is everywhere: you are great in one thing, your neighbour in another.
viv09-004-p04.core_idea: Everything is balanced; each person has their own greatness

viv09-005-p01.plain: Birth, life and death are old superstitions. No one was ever born and no one will ever die; we only change our position.
viv09-005-p01.core_idea: No one is born or dies; we only change position

viv09-005-p02.plain: Look at people as kindly as you can, because being good is not easy. You are not good by your own merit, nor is another bad by his; in his place, who knows what you would be?
viv09-005-p02.core_idea: Judge others charitably; you might be no better

judge.issue: Drops 'mere machines until you are free' and the rebuke of pride in goodness.

viv09-006-p01.plain: Everything depends on preparation. Striking a light takes a second, but making the candle takes long; a meal takes half an hour to eat but hours to cook. We want the quick result and forget the preparation.
viv09-006-p01.core_idea: Preparation is the real work behind every result

viv09-006-p02.plain: Nothing is lost. In the Gita, Krishna tells Arjuna that whatever effort one makes remains one's own, and if Yoga is not fulfilled in this life, it is taken up again in the next birth.
viv09-006-p02.core_idea: No spiritual effort is ever lost

viv09-006-p03.plain: Live for one ideal and leave no room in your mind for anything else. Put all your energy into spiritual perfection; true longing means struggle, and growth comes through it. Mistakes may turn out to be blessings.
viv09-006-p03.core_idea: Live for one ideal and struggle toward it

viv09-006-p04.plain: Meditation is the greatest help in spiritual life. In it we set aside material things and feel our divine nature, needing nothing outside. The soul's touch can brighten the darkest place and make even the wicked divine.
viv09-006-p04.core_idea: Meditation reveals our divine nature and transforms everything

judge.issue: Drops that all enmity and selfishness are effaced.

viv09-006-p05.plain: It is good to be born in a church but bad to die in one. Religious forms help the young plant of spirituality, but dying still within them shows the soul never grew.
viv09-006-p05.core_idea: Religious forms should help growth, not confine it

fix.display_text: It is very good to be born in a church, but it is very bad to die in a church. It is very good to be born within the limits of certain forms that help the little plant of spirituality, but if a man dies within the bounds of these forms, it shows that he has not grown, that there has been no development of the soul.

viv09-007-p01.plain: Religion is not doctrine, dogma or argument; it is being and becoming, it is realisation. Many talk about God and the soul, yet few have actually realised either, and still they fight one another.
viv09-007-p01.core_idea: Religion is realisation, not doctrine or argument

viv09-007-p02.plain: A jar makes noise while it is being filled with water, but when it is full, it is silent.
viv09-007-p02.core_idea: Those who are full make no noise

viv09-007-p03.plain: Everyone talks of love, but loving is hard. The first test of love is that it does not bargain; if someone loves another to get something back, that is not love but shopkeeping.

viv09-008-p01.plain: The first test of love is that it does not bargain. Love always gives and never takes.

viv09-008-p02.plain: A young mother who runs from a barking dog will stand in a lion's mouth to protect her child. Her love overcame all her fear.

viv09-008-p03.plain: The outer world only gives us hints; we project our own minds onto it, as an oyster coats a grain of sand into a pearl. The wicked see hell, the good heaven; lovers see love, fighters strife, the peaceful peace.
viv09-008-p03.core_idea: We see the world through what is in us

viv10-001-p01.plain: Humans alone naturally look upward. Looking and rising upward toward perfection is salvation, and it lies not in money, clothes or houses but in the wealth of spiritual thought within you.
viv10-001-p01.core_idea: Salvation is rising toward truth, not wealth

viv10-002-p01.plain: Clouds of many colours pass across the sky, but the blue sky itself never changes. In the same way you are always perfect; nothing changes your true nature, or ever will.
viv10-002-p01.core_idea: You are always perfect, like the unchanging sky

viv10-002-p02.plain: Crossing an Indian desert, I saw lovely lakes for a month; when one vanished as I approached, I realised all were mirages. Afterwards I still saw them but knew them as mirage, so they lost their power to deceive. So too the illusion of the universe will break one day.
viv10-002-p02.core_idea: Once seen through, illusion loses its power

extension.text: I was once travelling in the desert in India. I travelled for over a month and always found the most beautiful landscapes before me, beautiful lakes and all that. One day I was very thirsty and I wanted to have a drink at one of these lakes; but when I approached that lake it vanished. Immediately with a blow came into my brain the idea that this was a mirage about which I had read all my life; and then I remembered and smiled at my folly, that for the last month all the beautiful landscapes and lakes I had been seeing were this mirage, but I could not distinguish them then. The next morning I again began my march; there was the lake and the landscape, but with it immediately came the idea, “This is a mirage.” Once known it had lost its power of illusion. So this illusion of the universe will break one day.

viv10-002-p02.plain_v1: Travelling in an Indian desert, I kept seeing lovely lakes until one vanished when I went to drink. Afterwards the mirage still appeared, but I knew it for a mirage; once known, it lost its power to fool me.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the point: the illusion of the universe will likewise break one day.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Omits the conclusion that the illusion of the universe will break one day.

viv10-003-p01.plain: However clearly people see that nothing here is free, they cannot help feeling free, and nothing gets done without it. That felt freedom is a glimpse of blue sky through clouds; real freedom lies behind.
viv10-003-p01.core_idea: Our felt freedom hints at a real freedom beyond

viv10-003-p02.plain: You are not going to become God or become perfect; you already are perfect. Whenever you think you are not, that is a delusion.
viv10-003-p02.core_idea: You are already perfect, not becoming so

viv10-003-p03.plain: We are not going to become free; we are free already. Thinking we are bound, or happy or unhappy, is delusion; the idea that we must struggle to be free chases it out, and then both fall away.
viv10-003-p03.core_idea: You are already free; bondage is a delusion

judge.issue: Loses that the need-to-struggle idea is itself a delusion.

viv10-004-p01.plain: People who toil like machines do not really enjoy life; the wise do. A rich man may buy a costly painting, but only one who understands art enjoys it; without that, the rich man merely owns it.
viv10-004-p01.core_idea: The wise, not the owners, truly enjoy life

viv10-004-p02.plain: You are permanent and unchanging; how could you come and go? Like the sky, which seems to move while only clouds move, or land that seems to move from a train, you stay where you are while dreams pass.
viv10-004-p02.core_idea: The Self is unmoving; only dreams pass over it

viv10-005-p01.plain: We are the Infinite Being, yet we have become small people who depend on one man's kind word or another's angry one. I am a slave of body, mind, praise, blame, passion, life and death. This slavery must be broken.
viv10-005-p01.core_idea: We are infinite, yet enslaved by praise and pain

viv10-005-p02.plain: There is no help for you outside yourself; you made your own universe. Like a silkworm you have spun a cocoon around yourself. Break it and come out a butterfly, a free soul; only then will you see Truth.
viv10-005-p02.core_idea: No one outside you can free you

judge.issue: 'You are the creator of the universe' softened to 'you made your own universe'.

viv10-005-p03.plain: Before you start practising, clear your mind of doubts. Argue it out, and once you are convinced this is the truth, stop arguing and stop listening to arguments. You have settled the question; more debate is useless.
viv10-005-p03.core_idea: Settle your doubts, then stop arguing and practise

viv10-005-p04.plain: The way is long, like walking on a razor's edge, yet do not despair. The Vedas say: wake up, get up, and do not stop until you reach the goal.
viv10-005-p04.core_idea: The path is hard, but do not despair

viv10-005-p05.plain: A perfect person sees perfection in others. When someone sees imperfection, it is their own mind projecting it; how could they see it if it were not in them?
viv10-005-p05.core_idea: The imperfection we see in others is our own

viv11-001-p01.plain: Each person has their own way of growing, set by all their past Karma, as Hindus say. We arrive carrying the whole past, and how we use the present will make the future.
viv11-001-p01.core_idea: The past shapes us; the present shapes the future

viv11-002-p01.plain: As rivers from different mountains, straight or winding, all reach the ocean, so people's different paths all lead to the Lord. Some go crooked, some straight, but all will at last reach the One.
viv11-002-p01.core_idea: All paths, straight or crooked, lead to the One

judge.issue: Drops the hymn's direct address to Shiva.

viv11-002-p02.plain: Differences can never all disappear; without variety life would end, and the clash of ideas drives everything. But differing does not mean we must hate or fight each other.
viv11-002-p02.core_idea: Differences must remain, but hatred need not

viv11-004-p01.plain: A cloud rains on all fields alike, but only the tilled field benefits; that is not the cloud's fault. God's mercy is eternal and unchanging; it is we who make the difference.
viv11-004-p01.core_idea: God's mercy falls equally; we make the difference

viv11-004-p02.plain: We alone are responsible for what we suffer; we are cause and effect, and so we are free. If I made my unhappiness or impurity, I can be happy and pure if I will. The human will stands above circumstance.
viv11-004-p02.core_idea: We cause our own suffering, so we can end it

viv11-004-p03.plain: The same all-present, all-knowing soul lives in every person and animal, weak or wicked, great or small. The difference lies only in how it shows itself; even the smallest animal is my brother with the same soul.
viv11-004-p03.core_idea: Every creature has the same soul

viv11-005-p01.plain: Whatever you think yourself to be, weak or strong, pure or impure, you will become. All knowledge, power and purity are already in me; they do not show because I do not believe it. Believe, and they will.
viv11-005-p01.core_idea: You become what you think you are

viv11-005-p02.plain: It has long been recognised that there are many ways of worshipping God and that different natures need different methods. Your way to God may not suit me; the idea of one way for everyone is harmful.
viv11-005-p02.core_idea: Different natures need different ways to God

viv11-005-p03.plain: Talking is not religion; parrots and machines can talk. Show me a life of renunciation, spirituality, endurance and boundless love; that is the mark of a spiritual person.
viv11-005-p03.core_idea: Religion is a lived life, not talk

fix.display_text: Talking is not religion; parrots may talk, machines may talk nowadays. But show me the life of renunciation, of spirituality, of all-suffering, of love infinite. This kind of life indicates a spiritual man.

viv11-005-p04.plain: For ages we have been soaked in jealousy, always asking why someone else gets ahead and not I. We want precedence even in worshipping God, so enslaved have we become. This must be avoided.
viv11-005-p04.core_idea: Jealousy and craving precedence enslave us

viv11-006-p01.plain: Religion exists in pure, sincere love in the heart, not in ceremony.
viv11-006-p01.core_idea: Religion lives in sincere love, not ceremony

viv11-006-p02.plain: All worship comes down to being pure and doing good to others. Whoever sees Shiva in the poor, weak and sick truly worships him. Serving one poor person as Shiva pleases him more than seeing him only in temples.
viv11-006-p02.core_idea: True worship is serving God in the poor

judge.issue: Drops image-worship as merely preliminary and serving regardless of caste or creed.

viv11-006-p03.plain: A dusty mirror cannot show your image. In the same way, ignorance and wickedness are the dust on the mirror of our hearts.
viv11-006-p03.core_idea: Ignorance and wickedness cloud the heart's mirror

viv11-006-p04.plain: Selfishness, putting ourselves first, is the chief sin, even wanting to reach heaven or liberation before others. The unselfish person would go last, even to hell, to help others. Unselfishness is the test of religion.
viv11-006-p04.core_idea: Unselfishness is the test of religion

viv11-007-p01.plain: I feel your warmth and kindness, because heart speaks to heart better than words do; spirit speaks to spirit in silence, yet unmistakably, and I feel it deep in my heart.
viv11-007-p01.core_idea: Heart speaks to heart beyond words

viv11-007-p02.plain: Give up: that is the watchword of Indian religions. This world is a two-day illusion and this life lasts five minutes. Beyond it is the Infinite; let us seek that.
viv11-007-p02.core_idea: Renounce this brief world and seek the Infinite

viv11-008-p01.plain: The ideal is to give things up after seeing and experiencing how empty they are. Once you find that the material world is hollow at its heart, holding only ashes, give it up and turn back.
viv11-008-p01.core_idea: Having seen the world's emptiness, turn away from it

viv11-008-p02.plain: Stand in your own strength and die in it. If there is any sin in the world, it is weakness; avoid all weakness, because weakness is sin and weakness is death.

viv11-008-p03.plain: Stand on your own feet and absorb what you can; learn from every nation and take whatever is useful to you.
viv11-008-p03.core_idea: Stand on your own feet and learn from all

viv11-009-p01.plain: The worst, most devilish person has some virtues the greatest saint lacks, and the lowest worm may have things the highest human does not.
viv11-009-p01.core_idea: Even the worst have virtues the best lack

viv11-009-p02.plain: Impurity is only a covering that hides your real nature. The real you is already perfect and strong and needs no help to govern itself. The only difference is whether you know it or not.
viv11-009-p02.core_idea: Your real self is already perfect and strong

viv11-009-p03.plain: The word that bursts from the Upanishads like a bomb is fearlessness, and the only religion worth teaching is fearlessness. Fear brings misery, death and evil, and fear comes from not knowing our own nature.

viv11-009-p04.plain: Knowing the soul's nature gives hope to the weakest and worst sinner. Do not despair: whatever you do, your nature stays pure and cannot be destroyed. It may be hidden for ages, but at last it will come out.
viv11-009-p04.core_idea: Your pure nature will always win out

viv11-009-p05.plain: All responsibility for good and evil rests on you, and that is the great hope: what I have done, I can undo.
viv11-009-p05.core_idea: What I have done, I can undo

viv11-010-p01.plain: As followers of Vedanta, we know for certain that no power in the universe can injure us unless we first injure ourselves.
viv11-010-p01.core_idea: Nothing can harm us unless we harm ourselves first

viv11-010-p02.plain: I do not know if I will succeed, but it is a great thing to take up a grand ideal and give your whole life to it. Otherwise life is small and stagnant; a high ideal is its only value.
viv11-010-p02.core_idea: Life's value lies in serving a grand ideal

viv11-011-p01.plain: I doubt a perfect world will ever come, but each of us must work for it as if it will come tomorrow and depends on us alone, as if everyone else has done their part. That responsibility is ours.
viv11-011-p01.core_idea: Work for a perfect world as if solely responsible

viv11-011-p02.plain: I want the fanatic's intensity together with the materialist's breadth. A heart as deep as the ocean and as broad as the sky: that is what we need.
viv11-011-p02.core_idea: Combine deep intensity with broad openness

viv11-012-p01.plain: In the West people try to work out how much a person can own; here we try to work out how little a person can live on.
viv11-012-p01.core_idea: The West asks how much; India asks how little

viv11-012-p02.plain: Only the soul itself changing for the better can cure the evils of life.
viv11-012-p02.core_idea: Only inner change cures life's evils

viv11-013-p01.plain: No civilisation can grow until fanaticism and brutality stop and we look kindly on one another, starting with others' religious beliefs. More than that, we should actively help each other, however different our beliefs.
viv11-013-p01.core_idea: Civilisation needs charity toward others' beliefs

fix.display_text: No civilisation can grow unless fanatics, bloodshed, and brutality stop. No civilisation can begin to lift up its head until we look charitably upon one another; and the first step towards that much-needed charity is to look charitably and kindly upon the religious convictions of others. Nay more, to understand that not only should we be charitable, but positively helpful to each other, however different our religious ideas and convictions may be.

viv11-014-p01.plain: Faith in ourselves and faith in God is the secret of greatness. You may believe in every god there is, but without faith in yourself there is no salvation. Have faith in yourself, stand on it, and be strong.
viv11-014-p01.core_idea: Faith in yourself is the secret of greatness

viv11-014-p02.plain: Get up, wake up, and do not stop until you reach the goal. Wake from the spell of weakness: no one is really weak, because the soul is infinite and all-powerful. Stand up and declare the God within you.
viv11-014-p02.core_idea: Wake from weakness; the soul is infinite

viv11-014-p03.plain: We cannot stand still; standing still is dying. We either go forward or go back, either grow or decline.
viv11-014-p03.core_idea: We must move forward or we fall back

viv11-015-p01.plain: Cursing, condemning and abusing cannot produce anything good; they have been tried for years with no worthwhile result. Good results come only through love and sympathy.
viv11-015-p01.core_idea: Only love and sympathy produce good results

viv11-016-p01.plain: Respecting and loving someone is one thing; swallowing everything they say without reasoning, questioning or analysing is quite another.
viv11-016-p01.core_idea: Respect does not mean accepting everything uncritically

viv11-016-p02.plain: People talk a lot about open minds and respecting other views. But in practice we sympathise with others only while they agree with us; once they dare to differ, the sympathy and love vanish.
viv11-016-p02.core_idea: Tolerance often ends the moment someone disagrees

viv11-017-p01.plain: A tiny amount of practice is worth more than mountains of grand talk.

viv11-017-p02.plain: Anyone can point out what is wrong, but the true friend of humanity is the one who finds a way out of the problem.
viv11-017-p02.core_idea: Anyone sees evil; a true friend finds a way out

viv11-018-p01.plain: It is very hard to see through each other's eyes, and that is humanity's curse. It is the root of hatred, jealousy, quarrels and fights.
viv11-018-p01.core_idea: Failing to see through others' eyes breeds hatred

fix.display_text: How difficult it is to look through each other’s eyes, and that is the bane of humanity. That is the basis of hatred and jealousy, of quarrel and of fight.

viv11-019-p01.plain: Make your nerves strong; we need muscles of iron and nerves of steel. We have wept long enough. No more weeping: stand on your feet and be men.
viv11-019-p01.core_idea: Stop weeping; be strong and stand up

viv11-019-p02.plain: Here is a test of truth: reject as poison anything that weakens you in body, mind or spirit; there is no life in it and it cannot be true. Truth is pure and wise, and it always strengthens and enlightens.
viv11-019-p02.core_idea: Whatever weakens you cannot be true

viv11-019-p03.plain: Reason goes a few steps and then stops, but inspiration comes through the heart. Love opens the most impossible gates; it is the gateway to all the secrets of the universe.

viv11-019-p04.plain: Would you still do right if the whole world, even your family, opposed you and you lost money and name? As Bhartrihari said, the steady person never strays an inch from truth, whatever praise, blame or death comes.
viv11-019-p04.core_idea: Hold to the right course whatever the cost

viv11-021-p01.plain: Two friendly birds sit on one tree. The lower eats sweet and bitter fruits and turns happy and unhappy; the upper sits calm and majestic, eating nothing, absorbed in its own glory. This is a picture of the human soul.
viv11-021-p01.core_idea: The soul is a calm witness above joy and sorrow

viv11-021-p02.plain: In everyone's life, amid deepest sorrow or joy, come golden moments when the clouds part and we glimpse something far beyond the senses, beyond pleasure and pain, and beyond all longing for money, fame or legacy.
viv11-021-p02.core_idea: Golden moments reveal something beyond the senses

viv11-021-p03.plain: On every page the Upanishads tell me: be strong, do not be weak. Yes, people have weaknesses, but will more weakness heal them? You cannot wash dirt with dirt. Stand up and be strong.
viv11-021-p03.core_idea: Weakness cannot cure weakness; be strong

viv11-022-p01.plain: The Upanishads say ignorance is the cause of all misery, and that is true everywhere. Ignorance makes us hate each other and keeps us from loving; once we know each other, love must come, since we are one.
viv11-022-p01.core_idea: Ignorance makes us hate; knowing each other brings love

viv11-022-p02.plain: Even the smallest thing done well brings wonderful results, so let everyone do what little they can. A fisherman who thinks he is the Spirit will be a better fisherman; a student who thinks so, a better student.
viv11-022-p02.core_idea: Even small work done well yields great results

viv11-023-p01.plain: See every person as God. You cannot help anyone; you can only serve God's children, and God himself. If you get the chance, count yourself blessed and do not think too much of yourself. Do it only as worship.
viv11-023-p01.core_idea: Serve others as God, humbly, as worship

judge.issue: 'If the Lord grants' becomes 'if you get the chance'; drops privilege others lacked.

viv11-023-p02.plain: Give up the idea that you can do others good by ruling them. As with a plant, you can only supply what it needs, earth, water and air; it takes what it wants and grows by its own nature.
viv11-023-p02.core_idea: You cannot rule others into good; only nourish their growth

viv11-023-p03.plain: In everyone's life come calm moments, at a loved one's death, a shock, or great joy, when the mind feels its real nature and glimpses the Infinite beyond words and thought. Such moments must be deepened and practised.
viv11-023-p03.core_idea: Moments of stillness give a glimpse of the Infinite

viv11-024-p01.plain: Religion is not in books, theories, dogmas, talk or even reasoning. It is being and becoming.

viv11-024-p02.plain: Tell all nations, as the Vedas do: your fights are pointless. Have you seen the God you preach? If not, your preaching is empty; if you have, you will not quarrel, and your face will shine.
viv11-024-p02.core_idea: Those who have seen God do not quarrel

viv11-024-p03.plain: A prayer: I do not want wealth, followers, learning or even heaven. Let me be born again and again, but Lord, grant that I may love you, and love you only for love's sake.
viv11-024-p03.core_idea: Ask God only for love, for love's sake

viv11-026-p01.plain: We must always be ready to sit at the feet of anyone, because everyone can teach us great lessons. Manu says to accept good knowledge even from the lowest-born and learn from them, by serving, the road to heaven.
viv11-026-p01.core_idea: Be ready to learn from anyone

viv11-026-p02.plain: The first sign of life is expansion. You must expand if you want to live; the moment you stop, death is near and danger lies ahead.
viv11-026-p02.core_idea: To live, you must keep expanding

viv11-027-p01.plain: People will tell you to look after your own home first and only then work outside it. But plainly, you work best when you work for others.
viv11-027-p01.core_idea: You work best when you work for others

viv11-027-p02.plain: Love must conquer hatred; hatred cannot conquer itself. Materialism and its miseries can never be defeated by more materialism, and armies fighting armies only multiply and brutalise humanity.
viv11-027-p02.core_idea: Hatred cannot conquer hatred; love must

viv11-028-p01.plain: In a Sufi poem the lover knocks at the Beloved’s door. Asked who is there, he says I am, then gives his name; the door stays shut. The third time he says I am yourself, my Love, and it opens.
viv11-028-p01.core_idea: The door opens when the self dissolves into the Beloved

viv11-028-p02.plain: Religion is not going to church, marking your forehead or dressing a certain way. Without an opened heart and realisation of God, all that is useless. Whoever has the colour of the heart needs no outer colour.
viv11-028-p02.core_idea: Outer marks are empty without an opened heart

viv11-028-p03.plain: All power is within you; you can do anything. Believe that, and do not believe you are weak or half-mad, as most of us do. You need no one's guidance. Stand up and express the divinity within you.

viv11-028-p04.plain: Such periods were necessary. A great tree bears a ripe fruit that falls, rots and decays, and from that decay grows a new tree, perhaps mightier than the first.

viv11-030-p01.plain: Gaining an advantage is one thing; keeping it for evil use is another. Whenever power is used for evil it becomes devilish; it must be used only for good.
viv11-030-p01.core_idea: Power must be used only for good

viv11-031-p01.plain: Education is not a mass of undigested facts in your head. If you have taken in five ideas and made them your life and character, you are better educated than someone who memorised a library; otherwise libraries would be sages.
viv11-031-p01.core_idea: Education is ideas lived, not facts stored

fix.display_text: Education is not the amount of information that is put into your brain and runs riot there, undigested, all your life. We must have life-building, man-making, character-making assimilation of ideas. If you have assimilated five ideas and made them your life and character, you have more education than any man who has got by heart a whole library — “The ass carrying its load of sandalwood knows only the weight and not the value of the sandalwood.” If education is identical with information, the libraries are the greatest sages in the world, and encyclopaedias are the Rishis.

viv11-031-p02.plain: Money is nothing. For twelve years I did not know where my next meal would come from, yet money and whatever I need must come, because they are my servants, not my masters.
viv11-031-p02.core_idea: Money serves me; I do not serve it

viv11-031-p03.plain: Life is short but the soul is eternal, and death is certain. So let us take up a great ideal and give our whole life to it.
viv11-031-p03.core_idea: Life is short; give it to a great ideal

viv11-032-p01.plain: A person may try to lose himself in the universal, renounce everything, and even forget he is human; yet deep in his heart a soft whisper still tells him: East or West, home is best.
viv11-032-p01.core_idea: Even the renunciate's heart still longs for home

viv11-032-p02.plain: No one arrived in England hating the English more than I did. But the more I lived among them and found the nation’s heart, the more I loved them; now none here loves them more. Go and mix with them.
viv11-032-p02.core_idea: Living among people turned my hatred into love

viv11-033-p01.plain: There can be no friendship without equality, and no equality when one side always teaches and the other always sits at its feet.
viv11-033-p01.core_idea: Friendship needs equality, and equality needs give and take

viv11-033-p02.plain: Intellect is great, but it stops within certain limits. Inspiration comes through the heart, and the heart alone.
viv11-033-p02.core_idea: Inspiration comes through the heart, not intellect

viv11-033-p03.plain: It is people who make money. The whole world has been made by human energy, enthusiasm and faith.
viv11-033-p03.core_idea: Human energy and faith make everything, even money

viv11-033-p04.plain: My Master used to say that whoever thinks himself weak will become weak, and that is true.
viv11-033-p04.core_idea: Think yourself weak and you become weak

viv11-034-p01.plain: Do not be afraid of anything, and you will do wonderful work. The moment you fear, you are nobody. Fear is the main cause of misery and the greatest superstition; fearlessness can bring heaven in a moment.
viv11-034-p01.core_idea: Fear is the root of misery; fearlessness brings heaven

viv11-036-p01.plain: Patanjali's example: a farmer's field sits beside a full reservoir, held back only by a mud wall; break it and water rushes in. The soul already holds power, purity and perfection; once the veil over it is removed, they show.
viv11-036-p01.core_idea: The soul's perfection is already there, only veiled

viv11-036-p02.plain: As the saying goes, if much bathing led to heaven, fish would get there first; if eating vegetables did, cows and deer would arrive first.
viv11-036-p02.core_idea: Outward practices alone do not earn heaven

viv11-037-p01.plain: Even if you are too weak to renounce, do not lower the ideal. Say honestly that you are weak and cannot renounce, but do not be a hypocrite, twisting texts and making clever excuses to fool people.
viv11-037-p01.core_idea: Admit weakness honestly rather than lowering the ideal

viv11-037-p02.plain: Those who are in darkness yet proudly think they know everything try to help others; they wander in crooked ways and, like the blind leading the blind, both fall into the ditch.
viv11-037-p02.core_idea: The proud and ignorant who lead others fall together

viv11-037-p03.plain: You think differently as child, adult and old man; everyone changes. So your individuality is not in body, mind or thought. Beyond them is your Atman, and the Advaitist says this Atman is Brahman itself.
viv11-037-p03.core_idea: Everything about us changes, so where is the self?

extension.text: You were a child and thought in one way, now you are a man and think another way, again you will be an old man and think differently. Everybody is changing. If so, where is your individuality? Certainly not in the body, or in the mind, or in thought. And beyond that is your Atman, and, says the Advaitist, this Atman is the Brahman Itself.

viv11-037-p03.plain_v1: As a child you thought one way, as an adult another, and in old age you will think differently again. Everyone changes, so where is your individuality?

judge_v1.issue: Drops the conclusion that individuality lies in the Atman, which is Brahman; loses the main point.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Omits the answer: individuality lies in the Atman, which is Brahman.

viv11-038-p01.plain: Those whose minds are firmly fixed on the sameness of everything have conquered birth and death in this very life, because God is pure and the same to all; such people are said to live in God.
viv11-038-p01.core_idea: Seeing all as the same is living in God

viv11-038-p02.plain: Everything in this life is full of fear. Only renunciation makes a person fearless.

viv11-039-p01.plain: Each person must follow their own nature, and a teacher who helps along those lines brings progress. Forced onto another path, they lose what they had. Like a river, a life channelled along its course gains force; diverted, it weakens.
viv11-039-p01.core_idea: Let each person grow along their own nature

viv11-039-p02.plain: Not sinning, lying, drinking, gambling or stealing is good, but it is only your duty and earns no praise. You must also serve others; do good to them as you do to yourself.
viv11-039-p02.core_idea: Avoiding wrong is only duty; also do good to others

viv11-040-p01.plain: Do we always tell the truth? People flatter a rich man as a friend of the poor to get something, even if he would harm a poor man at his door. That is plain falsehood, and it pollutes the mind.
viv11-040-p01.core_idea: Flattery is falsehood, and it pollutes the mind

judge.issue: Softens the rich man's cutting a poor man's throat to merely harming him.

viv11-040-p02.plain: Everything in this world, good or bad, belongs to God. Whatever happens in our lives, good or bad, is bringing us to Him.
viv11-040-p02.core_idea: Good and bad alike bring us to God

viv11-041-p01.plain: The world sometimes needs criticism, even fierce criticism, but only for a while. The work that lasts forever is progress and building, not criticism and tearing down.
viv11-041-p01.core_idea: Criticism has its moment; lasting work is building

viv11-042-p01.plain: If someone thinks day and night that they are miserable, low and nothing, they become nothing. Say I am, and you will be; dwell constantly on being nothing, and nothing you will be.
viv11-042-p01.core_idea: You become what you dwell on about yourself

viv11-042-p02.plain: I may be a little bubble and you a towering wave. Never mind: the same infinite ocean of life, power and spirit lies behind both of us, and it is mine as much as yours.
viv11-042-p02.core_idea: Small or great, we share the same infinite ocean

viv11-042-p03.plain: A great sage, dying, asked his mind to remember his mighty deeds and thoughts, not his weaknesses and follies. We all have follies and weaknesses, but remembering your real nature is the only way to cure them.
viv11-042-p03.core_idea: Remember your real nature, not your failings

viv11-042-p04.plain: You are what you make yourselves, by God's grace and your own effort. Merely believing in theories and doctrines will not help you much.
viv11-042-p04.core_idea: You are what you make yourself

viv11-043-p01.plain: Do not rush to copy anyone; imitation is not civilisation. Dressing as a king does not make me one, and a donkey in a lion's skin is no lion. Cowardly imitation never brings progress.

viv11-043-p02.plain: Develop what you have by your own effort; do not imitate, yet take what is good from others. A seed absorbs earth, air and water but does not become them; it grows into a great tree after its own nature.
viv11-043-p02.core_idea: Learn from others but grow after your own nature

viv11-043-p03.plain: If a room has been dark for centuries and we go in crying how dark it is, will the darkness leave? Bring in light and the darkness vanishes at once.
viv11-043-p03.core_idea: Bring light instead of lamenting the darkness

viv11-043-p04.plain: I have never lost faith in people, even at their worst, and wherever I had faith it won out in the end. Have faith in people, whether they seem learned or ignorant, angels or devils.

viv11-045-p01.plain: Only a fool living by the Ganges digs a little well, and so is one who begs God for material things. The devotee should say: Lord, I want nothing from you, but I am ready to give whatever you need.
viv11-045-p01.core_idea: Ask nothing of God; be ready to give

viv11-046-p01.plain: A grain of sand irritates an oyster, which coats it with its own juice to form a pearl. The universe is like that: a pearl we form ourselves. All we get from the outside world is the blow.
viv11-046-p01.core_idea: We make our world from the blows it gives us

fix.display_text: A grain of sand enters into the shell of a pearl oyster, and sets up an irritation there, and the oyster’s body reacts towards the irritation and covers the little particle with its own juice. That crystallises and forms the pearl. So the whole universe is like that, it is the pearl which is being formed by us. What we get from the external world is simply the blow.

viv11-047-p01.plain: A farmer opens a small gate and reservoir water rushes into his field; the power is already there. Likewise every being has behind it a reservoir of infinite strength, purity and bliss, and only our bodies hold it back.
viv11-047-p01.core_idea: Infinite power is already within; the body holds it back

viv11-048-p01.plain: You become whatever you tell yourself; the Buddha said what you think, you are. So do not teach yourself that you are nothing and can do nothing without help from someone above the clouds; you will only grow weaker.
viv11-048-p01.core_idea: Do not teach yourself that you are helpless

viv11-048-p02.plain: If you are going to be rational, be rational all the way; if not, give others the same freedom you ask for yourself.
viv11-048-p02.core_idea: Be consistently rational, or grant others the same latitude

viv11-049-p01.plain: Only the witness truly enjoys. At a wrestling match, who enjoys it more, the wrestlers or the onlookers? The more you are a witness to anything in life, the more you enjoy it.
viv11-049-p01.core_idea: The witness enjoys more than the participant

viv11-049-p02.plain: A wave differs from the ocean only by its form and name, which exist only with the wave; when it subsides, the same water remains. In the same way, Maya is what makes the difference between you and me, between animals and humans, and between gods and humans.
viv11-049-p02.core_idea: Name and form vanish; the underlying reality remains

extension.text: Suppose there is a wave in the ocean. The wave is distinct from the ocean only in its form and name, and this form and this name cannot have any separate existence from the wave; they exist only with the wave. The wave may subside, but the same amount of water remains, even if the name and form that were on the wave vanish for ever. So this Maya is what makes the difference between me and you, between all animals and man, between gods and men.

viv11-049-p02.plain_v1: A wave differs from the ocean only in its form and name, which exist only with the wave. When the wave subsides, the same water remains, though its name and form are gone forever.

judge_v1.issue: Drops the conclusion that Maya is what makes the difference between beings.

judge_v1_rejudged.issue: Omits the conclusion that Maya makes the difference between beings; only the analogy remains.

viv11-050-p01.plain: Through Advaita, know that whoever you hurt, you hurt yourself, because they are all you. You work through every hand, you are king and beggar, ignorant and learned, weak and strong; know this and be compassionate.
viv11-050-p01.core_idea: Whoever you hurt, you hurt yourself

viv11-050-p02.plain: All sins and evils can be summed up in one word: weakness. Weakness drives all wrongdoing, is the source of all selfishness, makes people harm others, and makes them show what they really are not.

viv11-050-p03.plain: I may be a little bubble and you a towering wave, but behind us both is the infinite ocean, Brahman, a store of power we can both draw on freely. So believe in yourself first, then in anything else.
viv11-050-p03.core_idea: Believe in yourself first; Brahman backs us all

fix.display_text: I may be a little bubble, and you may be a wave mountain-high, but know that for both of us the infinite ocean is the background, the infinite Brahman is our magazine of power and strength, and we can draw as much as we like, both of us, I the bubble and you the mountain-high wave. Believe, therefore, in yourselves. The secret of Advaita is: Believe in yourselves first, and then believe in anything else.

viv11-050-p04.plain: Stand up, be bold, and take the blame on your own shoulders. Do not throw mud at others; for all the faults you suffer from, you alone are the cause.
viv11-050-p04.core_idea: Take the blame yourself; stop blaming others

viv11-051-p01.plain: Rise up again, because nothing can be done without renunciation. If you want to help others, your little self must go.
viv11-051-p01.core_idea: To help others, the little self must go

viv11-051-p02.plain: Whether sages blame or praise, whether fortune comes or goes, whether death comes now or in a hundred years, the true sage never takes one false step from the right path.
viv11-051-p02.core_idea: The wise never step off the right path

viv11-051-p03.plain: Bread first, then religion. We stuff starving people with religion, but no doctrine can satisfy hunger.
viv11-051-p03.core_idea: Feed the hungry before preaching religion

viv11-051-p04.plain: You may talk doctrines by the million and have countless sects, but it is all nothing until you have a heart that feels.
viv11-051-p04.core_idea: Doctrines mean nothing without a feeling heart

viv11-052-p01.plain: There the sun does not shine, nor the moon, stars or lightning, let alone this fire. Because He shines, everything shines; through Him everything gives light.

viv11-053-p01.plain: One person may be a little bubble and another a towering wave, but behind both lies the infinite ocean. So there is hope for everyone.
viv11-053-p01.core_idea: One ocean lies behind every bubble and wave

viv11-053-p02.plain: Sooner or later you must learn that you cannot be saved without trying to save your brothers. Combine great idealism with great practicality in your life.
viv11-053-p02.core_idea: Seek others' salvation; join idealism with practicality

viv11-053-p03.plain: The true man is as strong as strength itself, yet has a woman's heart.

viv11-054-p01.plain: Reading many scriptures has made people parrots, not scholars. The true scholar is one who gains divine love from reading even one word of scripture.
viv11-054-p01.core_idea: Love, not book learning, makes one wise

viv11-054-p02.plain: Even with a burning thirst for God, or a Guru to guide you, you cannot reach realisation unless you also practise what you have been taught.
viv11-054-p02.core_idea: Longing and a teacher are not enough without practice

viv11-054-p03.plain: I do not despair at today's degradation; I am full of hope for the future. A seed is transformed and seems destroyed before it grows into a tree.
viv11-054-p03.core_idea: Present decline may be a seed of future greatness

viv11-055-p01.plain: When a grand old building falls into dirt and disrepair, do you clean and repair it, or tear it down for an untested modern plan? True reform means making it ready again by cleaning and repair, not demolishing it.
viv11-055-p01.core_idea: Restore what is good rather than demolish it

viv11-055-p02.plain: Brothers, if you can worship God without form, needing no outward aids, do so; but why condemn those who cannot?
viv11-055-p02.core_idea: Do not condemn those who worship differently

fix.display_text: Brothers, if you are fit to worship God-without-form discarding all external help, do so, but why do you condemn others who cannot do the same?

viv12-001-p01.plain: See and do everything, but do not be attached. Extreme attachment makes you lose self-mastery and become a slave, even to someone you love, and there are higher things than that. Love and do good to all, but stay free.
viv12-001-p01.core_idea: Love and do good, but never be enslaved by attachment

viv12-001-p02.plain: We keep mistaking one thing for another and bring misery on ourselves. Whatever thrills us for a moment we take for the highest good and plunge in, only to find too late it has hurt us, often all our lives.
viv12-001-p02.core_idea: We mistake brief pleasure for the good

fix.display_text: We always take one thing for another, and act upon that, with the result that we bring misery upon ourselves. We take the bad for the good. Anything that titillates our nerves for a moment we think as the highest good, and plunge into it immediately, but find, when it is too late, that it has given us a tremendous blow. Every day, we run into this error, and we often continue in it all our lives.

viv12-001-p03.plain: The great danger is that everyone wants to leap to the highest ideal, but leaping only ends in a fall. We are bound here and must break our chains slowly.
viv12-001-p03.core_idea: Break your chains slowly; do not leap

viv12-001-p04.plain: We forget this world is a means, not an end. If it were the end, we would never die. We see people dying all around us, yet foolishly think we never will, and so take this life as the goal.
viv12-001-p04.core_idea: The world is a means, not the goal

viv12-001-p05.plain: What we are now comes from past practice, and practice will make what we become. One kind of turning brought us here; so turn the other way and get out as soon as you can.
viv12-001-p05.core_idea: Practice made us, and practice can free us

viv12-001-p06.plain: As oil poured from one vessel to another falls in an unbroken stream, and distant bells sound as one continuous note, so the mind should flow toward God in one continuous stream.
viv12-001-p06.core_idea: Let the mind flow to God unbroken

viv12-002-p01.plain: The selfish person will not remember God. The more we go out and do good to others, the purer our hearts become, and God will dwell in them.
viv12-002-p01.core_idea: Doing good purifies the heart for God

viv12-002-p02.plain: The first share of everything belongs to the poor; we have a right only to what is left. The poor, and all who suffer, are God's representatives.
viv12-002-p02.core_idea: The poor come first; they represent God

viv12-002-p03.plain: No virtue is higher than charity. The lowest person is the one whose hand pulls in to receive; the highest is the one whose hand reaches out to give. The hand was made for giving.
viv12-002-p03.core_idea: The hand was made to give

viv12-002-p04.plain: Everyone has their own burden. If you are miserable, try to overcome it and be happy. The weak cannot reach God, so never be weak; you have infinite strength within you, and you need it to overcome anything.
viv12-002-p04.core_idea: God is not reached by the weak; be strong

viv12-002-p05.plain: Too much merriment is always followed by sorrow; tears and laughter are close relatives. People swing between extremes. Keep the mind cheerful but calm, because every excess brings a reaction.
viv12-002-p05.core_idea: Stay cheerful but calm; excess brings reaction

viv12-002-p06.plain: As a schoolboy, a stronger boy snatched my sweets, and I thought him the most wicked boy alive and vowed to punish him. We have both grown up now and are close friends.
viv12-002-p06.core_idea: Childhood grudges look small once we grow

viv12-003-p01.plain: We keep grabbing at things that slip away and reaching for the next, until at last we see clearly and come to God, the only one who truly loves; his love never changes and always welcomes us.
viv12-003-p01.core_idea: Everything slips away except God's unchanging love

viv12-003-p02.plain: We are slaves to the world and our senses, but we should wake up: we are the infinite, all-knowing Spirit that can break every bond, and we reach that power through love.
viv12-003-p02.core_idea: We are infinite Spirit, not slaves to the senses

viv12-003-p03.plain: When misery strikes, when the person we love most dies or what we gave everything for vanishes, a voice in the soul may ask what comes after this.
viv12-003-p03.core_idea: Loss can make the soul ask what comes next

judge.issue: Drops 'cheated the whole world and perhaps our own brother', softening the moral edge.

viv12-003-p04.plain: No amount of reading, talking, intellect or science brings this love; whoever longs for God receives love, and God gives himself to that person.
viv12-003-p04.core_idea: Longing for God, not learning, brings divine love

viv12-003-p05.plain: Every soul will one day become perfect. What we are now comes from what we did and thought before, and what we become will come from what we do and think now.
viv12-003-p05.core_idea: Our present thoughts and acts shape who we become

viv12-004-p01.plain: Books help the mind grow but do almost nothing for the spirit. Reading can fool us into thinking we are spiritually helped, which is why we talk beautifully about spiritual things yet fail when it is time to act.
viv12-004-p01.core_idea: Books feed the intellect, not the spirit

viv12-004-p02.plain: When someone we love dies, we feel the world slipping away and resolve to seek something higher; but within days that feeling fades and we are back where we were.
viv12-004-p02.core_idea: Grief-born resolve to seek the higher soon fades

viv12-004-p03.plain: Truly wanting religion is hard. Religion is not listening to talks or reading books but a constant struggle with your own nature until you win, which may take hundreds of lifetimes, and you must be ready for that.
viv12-004-p03.core_idea: Religion is a lifelong struggle with your own nature

viv12-004-p04.plain: An open heart can learn from brooks and stones; a closed heart sees only brooks and stones.
viv12-004-p04.core_idea: An open heart learns from everything around it

viv12-005-p01.plain: Religion means direct experience, and talking about it is very different from that. Realisation is what you actually perceive in your own soul.
viv12-005-p01.core_idea: Religion is direct inner experience, not talk

viv12-005-p02.plain: It is a mistake to think you can leap straight to the highest state, like a baby expecting to be old overnight. Books, reasoning, doctrines and ceremonies only help; religion itself is direct realisation.
viv12-005-p02.core_idea: Spiritual growth is gradual; religion is realisation
